papers.title: Information Spillovers Across Media Markets: Risk Perceptions and Cyclospora Outbreaks in U.S. Bagged Salads
papers.abstract: From 2018 to 2022, contamination of fresh produce by Cyclospora cayetanensis, primarily affecting bagged salads, caused more than 3,300 outbreak-associated illnesses across the United States. Yet the economic consequences of these outbreaks, and the role of information exposure in shaping consumer responses, remain poorly understood. This study quantifies changes in bagged salad purchases and associated retail losses during six selected large multistate outbreaks occurring from 2018 to 2022 and examines how risk perceptions evolve across outbreak-affected and neighboring regions. Guided by a risk perception framework emphasizing risk proximity and information-driven belief updating, we integrate epidemiologic outbreak data, designated market area (DMA)-level Google Trends search intensity as a geographically granular proxy for information exposure, and NielsenIQ household purchase data. Because DMAs often cross state lines, this design identifies information spillovers to non-outbreak states sharing a media market. A Heckman selection framework accounts for purchase participation and unobserved heterogeneity, while complementary retail scanner data assess whether retailer stocking adjustments contributed to the observed purchase declines. Across the outbreak periods examined in this study, weekly bagged salad purchases declined by an average of 3.89%, implying cumulative retail losses of approximately $373.67 million. Outbreak-specific searches (e.g., “Cyclospora”) were associated with greater perceived risk and larger purchase reductions, while general salad-related searches were associated with smaller reductions. Spillovers across shared media markets further reduced purchases in non-outbreak states by 3.33% per week. Retailer analysis found no statistically significant store-level stocking reductions during outbreak or recall periods, supporting the interpretation that the observed purchase declines were primarily demand-driven. These findings highlight the economic significance of information-driven consumer responses and the importance of timely, accurate, and geographically targeted risk communication during foodborne outbreaks.

papers.title: Toward Understanding Implications of AI‐Powered Intelligent Transportation Systems on Risk Research and Practice
papers.abstract: The rapidly evolving use of artificial intelligence (AI)-powered intelligent transportation systems (ITS) and other emerging technologies in the transportation sector has the potential to deliver unprecedented improvements in safety and efficiency. However, recent research has also raised concerns about the implications of using AI and automation, as these technologies can introduce new, understudied risks to such systems. This perspective article evaluates AI-powered ITS through three lenses: risk assessment, concerning whether current conceptual and methodological tools remain sufficient for these systems; the human element, relating to how analysts and operators interact with AI outputs, including explainable AI (XAI) and human-in-the-loop oversight; and governance, concerning frameworks needed to manage these systems. Across these lenses, the article uses risk characterization as a diagnostic tool for locating where established risk practice must adapt and translates the resulting gaps into specific research directions. Although the practical interpretation and application of fundamental risk concepts may change when viewed through the lens of AI-powered ITS, the work of this article provides a basis for research directions and requirements needed for risk practice to adapt to new and emerging technologies and to support future research and training within the risk analysis community. This perspective will be of interest to risk researchers, practitioners, and policymakers.

papers.title: Human Development and the Architecture of Everyday Worry: Latent Worry Profiles in the World Risk Poll
papers.abstract: Whether public concern about risk rises or falls with national development has been debated for three decades, but the debate has compared countries hazard by hazard, asking how much people worry rather than how worry is organized. We provide a person-centered analysis of everyday worry at global scale, applying latent class analysis to the six-hazard worry battery of the Lloyd's Register Foundation World Risk Poll and linking profiles to the Human Development Index (HDI) in 140 countries (n=139,111$n=139{,}111$; 2023 wave), with the 2021 wave (n=118,703$n=118{,}703$; 119 countries) as an independent replication. Four worry profiles replicate almost exactly across waves, including a configurationally distinct secure-basics profile (15% of respondents) combining low worry about food and water with high worry about crime, severe weather, and traffic. Profile prevalence is consistent with the ordered sequence predicted by a need-priority account of worry allocation: pervasive worry falls from 33% to 13% between low- and very-high-HDI countries, low worry nearly doubles, and the secure-basics profile holds steady across low- and medium-HDI countries before declining at higher development. Traffic accidents are the most intense worry in every tier below very high HDI. These gradients persist after adjustment for self-reported recent harm and demographic composition and are only partly accounted for by the objective hazard environment, though the cross-sectional design cannot separate development from macroregional clustering. Development is associated with the composition of worry, not only its overall level; risk communication may be better matched to a country's worry architecture than to a single global template.

papers.title: Comparing Like With Like in Biological Invasion Risk Analysis
papers.abstract: Biological invasion decision-support methods are often compared under broad labels such as “risk assessment,” even when they perform different functions. This Perspective argues that functional commensurability must be established before methods are compared. In biological invasion risk analysis, screening serves an initial risk identification function, flagging extant or horizon non-native species within a defined risk assessment area for prevention, surveillance, or more detailed evaluation. Comprehensive risk assessment examines entry or introduction, establishment, spread, and their ecological, economic, and socio-cultural consequences in greater detail. Risk management integrates risk with feasibility, cost, effectiveness, legal constraints, and stakeholder values. Impact classification and post-establishment population prioritization may contribute to these functions without being equivalent to them. Published comparisons show how conflating such functions can create false equivalence. The emerging Dispersal-Origin-Status-Impact (DOSI) literature provides an illustrative example through its comparisons with applications of the globally implemented Invasiveness Screening Kit (ISK) decision-support tools: population status and management priority are not the same quantities as prospective invasion risk screening, and species-based screening does not imply coarse spatial resolution. Forty-five peer-reviewed ISK-family studies report local or subnational screenings, including spatial resolutions comparable with or finer than DOSI applications. Valid comparisons require a shared decision objective, explicit spatial and temporal boundaries, independent evaluation evidence, and assessment of uncertainty and the consequences of error. These requirements permit methods to be evaluated for a common use, or combined within adaptive management, without treating disagreement between unlike outputs as evidence of superior performance.

papers.title: An Integrated Risk‐Informed Optimization Framework for Disinformation Interdiction in Coupled Information‐Physical Networks
papers.abstract: The manner in which society consumes and responds to information has significantly evolved in recent years, increasing the potential risk of interacting with, reacting to, and spreading misinformation and disinformation. In this paper, we introduce a novel integrated optimization framework that simultaneously models the dynamics of an information layer (where correct information or false information spreads) and a physical layer (where users interact with a physical infrastructure system). We consider an over-the-horizon problem in which an adversary seeks to disrupt physical infrastructure by spreading false information about its operation and performance, prompting users to behave in ways that degrade system performance. Focusing on public transit, we study how disinformation about station closures alters user behavior and system efficiency, and develop an optimization model to identify effective interdiction strategies that mitigate these impacts. The information layer incorporates personality-driven susceptibility and simulates dis/information diffusion, while the physical layer uses a multicommodity network flow model to capture user movements and expose the effects of disinformation on travel time. Our integrated approach enables the joint analysis of both layers, revealing complex interdependencies that are overlooked when studied separately. A case study of the New York City subway system shows that even limited protective interventions can significantly reduce travel delays. In contrast, unmitigated disinformation can substantially degrade system performance. This research highlights the importance of integrated optimization-based strategies for enhancing the resilience of transportation systems to information-based threats and provides a foundation for future studies on dynamic disinformation influence on physical infrastructure systems.

papers.title: Risk Assessment of an Illegal Laboratory in Reedley, California, Using Geospatial Analysis of Open‐Source Epidemic Intelligence Data
papers.abstract: An illegal laboratory discovered in Reedley, California, in December 2022 was in a warehouse, operating without a license, handling about a thousand transgenic mice, chemicals, and possibly over 20 pathogens, including vials labeled Ebola, which were never tested but destroyed. This study aimed to estimate epidemic signals around the Reedley illegal laboratory using open-source epidemic intelligence data. We utilized data from EPIWATCH, from October 2021 to October 2023, a year prior to and a year after the establishment of the illegal laboratory. The spatial pattern of outbreak signals was analyzed using hotspot analysis, and the distances of outbreak signals from the laboratory were measured. In California, an upward trend in outbreak signals of pathogens associated with the laboratory was noted in December 2022, April 2023, and August 2023. In the hotspot analysis, California and eight other states in the United States (US) were identified as hotspots. Narrative evidence revealed the presence of a sick employee working in the laboratory, whose child also became ill. Changes in disease patterns reported in California or the US in the year following the establishment of the illegal laboratory may or may not be linked to the illegal laboratory. A subsequent illegal lab linked to Reedley was identified in Las Vegas in 2026, highlighting the ongoing threat to biosecurity. EPIWATCH geospatial and temporal analysis can enhance the public health risk assessment of threats associated with illegal laboratories, especially when there is no available testing or reporting.

papers.title: Modeling Exposure–Mortality Relationships for Indoor Heat
papers.abstract: Most individuals spend the majority of their time indoors. However, epidemiological evidence of the association between heat and mortality is dominated by studies using outdoor temperature as a proxy for personal exposure. To demonstrate how an exposure–response relationship between indoor heat and mortality may relate to that between outdoor heat and mortality, we develop a novel mathematical modeling approach. This approachuses the relationship between regional daily average indoor and outdoor temperature to map the exposure–response relationship for outdoor heat, estimated by epidemiological studies, to indoor heat. Due to the modifying effect of buildings on heat exposure, we show that a change in indoor temperature may be associated with a greater change in mortality than an equal change in outdoor temperature. This has implications for researchers seeking to assess the health impact of changes in indoor heat exposure. Furthermore, it provides a new theoretical framework for interpreting potential differences in the temperature-mortality relationship of indoor and outdoor heat exposure in epidemiological studies.

papers.title: Seasonal Multivariate and Spatial Assessment of Heavy Metal Contamination and Associated Ecotoxicological and Human Health Risks in Urban Park Soils: A Case Study From Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
papers.abstract: Urban parks in rapidly developing cities face increasing heavy metal contamination, yet seasonal dynamics remain poorly understood. This study evaluated seasonal variations in heavy metal contamination and associated human health risks in two major parks in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. We analyzed 48 surface soil samples (24 locations × 2 seasons) for eight metals using ICP-OES. Pollution levels were evaluated using indices (EF, Igeo , CF, PER, mHQ, TU, and TRI) and GIS-geostatistics. Sources were apportioned via multivariate analysis and positive matrix factorization (PMF), and health risks to children and adults were simulated using Monte Carlo methods. Al (Go Vap 12,475 ppm; Gia Dinh 13,998 ppm) and Fe (Go Vap 12,324.1 ppm; Gia Dinh 7620.7 ppm) dominated soil composition. In Go Vap, there was an increase in Al, Mn enrichment and Pb spikes (EF = 91.69) in the dry season; Gia Dinh had Cr (EF = 4.43) enrichment in the dry season and higher Mn (EF = 4.19) in the rainy season. PMF identified four sources: traffic solid waste (31.4%), traffic emissions and construction dust (15.8%), natural weathering (20.1%), and redox processes (32.7%). Spatial analysis revealed dry-season high-risk hotspots expanding to 39.41% of Gia Dinh and 36.02% of Go Vap park areas. Cr posed the highest health risk (HQ = 0.53 for children, 0.057 for adults), primarily via ingestion. All risk indices intensified during the dry season (p < 0.05). Dry seasons increase the risk of contamination in tropical urban parks, especially Cr. This study supports seasonal monitoring and enhanced protection for children in monsoon-affected green spaces.

papers.title: Modeling Logical Interdependencies: Quantifying Systemic Risk From Rule‐Governed Actions
papers.abstract: Systemic risk in critical infrastructure is often analyzed through physical, geographic, and cyber interdependencies. Yet infrastructures are also interdependent through the governing rules that organize human action. These rule-mediated connections are a form of logical interdependency, and breakdowns in rule-governed action can create pathways through which disruption spreads. This paper develops a framework for diagnosing and quantifying this underrecognized source of systemic risk. It does so by modeling logical interdependencies as rule-mediated control relations that shape whether interconnected infrastructures remain within safe operating bounds or drift toward failure. Integrating Institutional Grammar, STAMP, and Bayesian inference, the framework translates governing rules into structured control relations, represents them within a socio-technical control architecture, and quantifies how failures in those relations propagate across interconnected infrastructures. We demonstrate the framework through a reservoir system case study centered on Lake Mendocino, California, where safety depends not only on reservoir infrastructure and hydrologic conditions, but also on distributed authority, communication requirements, and operational protocols. The results show that logical interdependencies make non-trivial contributions to modeled systemic risk, with baseline probabilities of 7% for Coyote Valley Dam failure and 3% for downstream community impacts under the modeled conditions. More importantly, the analysis reveals hidden logical risk: rules and control relations that appear routine in normal operation yet become disproportionately important when the Bayesian model traces which factors most strongly contribute to a failure scenario. The paper moves logical interdependencies from a residual conceptual category to a systematically identifiable and quantitatively analyzable pathway of systemic risk.

papers.title: Inseparability in Disaster Risk Science: Accounting for Coupled, Co‐Evolving Systems
authors: Alexandre Dunant, Stefan Hochrainer‐Stigler, Liz J Olaya Calderon, Ryan M. McGranaghan, Reinhard Mechler, Massimiliano Pittore, Sara M. Constantino, Silvia De Angeli, Marleen C. de Ruiter

Guillaume Falmagne, J. Camilo Gomez‐Zapata, Stefan Kienberger, Elco Koks, Elisabeth H. Krueger, Shahar Livne, Dora Elia Ramos Muñoz, Robert Šakić Trogrlić, PiaJohanna Schweizer, Thi Thu Ha Vo, Haorui Wu, Anqi Zhu
papers.abstract: Contemporary risk landscapes are shaped by systemic phenomena—compound disasters, cascading failures, non-stationarity, and cross-domain crises—that challenge conventional frameworks. While the classical risk equation (Risk = Hazard × Vulnerability × Exposure) remains a useful heuristic, it relies on a separability assumption that breaks down in feedback-rich, co-evolving systems. This failure reflects a familiar diagnosis: risk can be mistaken for a complicated problem, decomposable and optimizable, when it is a complex one, characterized by emergence and adaptation. Our contribution herein is not this distinction but its analytical consequence. Drawing on an interdisciplinary workshop on systemic risk and resilience, we propose inseparability as a foundational premise for disaster risk science. Hazard, exposure, and vulnerability might be better understood as dynamically coupled processes rather than separable variables. We derive implications across four axes: reframing vulnerability as a non-ergodic system property; addressing cross-scale dynamics; shifting from risk control to adaptive management; and treating knowledge co-production as a scientific necessity.

papers.title: Ambient Air Pollution Health Impacts in High‐Income Countries, Part II: A Case Study in the United Arab Emirates
papers.abstract: Ambient air pollution poses major global public health risks, particularly in rapidly developing regions, including the Arabian Gulf. This study estimates the disease burden attributable to anthropogenic air pollution (particulate matter [PM] and ozone) in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, for 2019–2022 and compares findings to previous estimates for 2008. Burdens were calculated using updated air quality, population, and health incidence data for 2019–2022 along with concentration–response functions from recent epidemiologic evidence. Results show that Abu Dhabi's investments in air quality management have paid off in preventing air quality from deteriorating as much as would be expected given the doubling of the population between 2008 and 2022. However, epidemiologic evidence gathered during this period indicates that PM exposure has stronger negative effects on mortality risks than previously thought. As a result, estimated deaths attributable to anthropogenic ambient air pollution increased between 2008 and 2022, from 231 (90% uncertainty interval [UI]: 59–427) to 1249 (90% UI: 507–2169). Total hospital visits attributable to PM and ozone exposure also increased. These increases reflect combined effects of population growth, higher pollutant exposures, improved medical record-keeping, and updated evidence on health risks. Urban centers, with higher pollutant concentrations and population densities, experience the highest risks, highlighting the need for targeted interventions to address air pollution hotspots. This work provides policymakers with up-to-date insights on the health impacts of ambient air pollution and underscores the importance of continued investments in air quality management in Abu Dhabi.

papers.title: Enterprise Architecture Threat Modeling for Cybersecurity Risk Management
papers.abstract: Organizations invest heavily in cybersecurity capabilities, yet the relationship between deployed defensive portfolios, practitioner judgments of coverage, and empirically observed adversary behavior remains difficult to assess. This study examines that relationship by integrating practitioner elicitation with threat-informed cybersecurity architecture analysis. A model-derived analytical baseline was constructed using the Cybersecurity Architecture Review (CAR) methodology aligned with MITRE ATT&CK version 17, quantifying protect, detect, and respond coverage for 12 commonly deployed cybersecurity capability categories. Survey data from 65 cybersecurity practitioners were used to characterize capability portfolios, perceived coverage, and factors influencing capability-selection decisions. Results show uneven modeled coverage across the ATT&CK lifecycle and substantial functional overlap among capability categories. Across 910 respondent-tactic observations, practitioner-estimated coverage exceeded corresponding respondent-specific modeled coverage by approximately 27 percentage points on average, although the magnitude and direction of perception-model divergence varied by tactic. Most subgroup comparisons by professional role, responsibility, and experience did not identify statistically significant differences, while government respondents exhibited slightly higher mean divergence than nongovernment respondents in one pairwise comparison. Capability-selection decisions reflected multiple organizational and external influences, with formal internal threat modeling reported less frequently than peer practices, regulatory or compliance requirements, independent research, and analyst or consultant reports. The findings demonstrate how threat-informed architecture analysis can complement practitioner judgment by making modeled coverage, gaps, overlap, and divergence explicit within organizational cybersecurity risk governance.

papers.title: AccES: A Framework for Predicting Building‐Level Loss of Accessibility to Essential Services Post‐Disasters Based on Publicly Available Information
papers.abstract: Natural hazards significantly disrupt access to essential services, affecting individuals' capacity to withstand and recover from such events. However, existing hazard resilience models often fail to account for the interdependencies among essential services and lack the spatial resolution needed to assess accessibility loss at the building level. This study introduces the Predicting Loss of Access to Essential Services (AccES) framework—a novel, data-driven, and people-centered approach that uses publicly available information to evaluate accessibility following a natural hazard event. The framework integrates open-source datasets with local stakeholder knowledge to develop spatially explicit models of interconnected infrastructure networks, including power, water, and communication networks, along with their dependent service facilities such as hospitals, childcare centers, and grocery stores. Accessibility loss is assessed by evaluating the disruptions to infrastructure networks and service facilities, estimating (1) the probability that individual buildings lose access to infrastructure services and (2) the expected increase in travel distance to the nearest operational service facility. To demonstrate the framework's utility, a case study was conducted in Cayey, Puerto Rico, simulating the impacts of a Category 2 tropical cyclone. Results highlight spatial disparities in accessibility loss, with rural and socially vulnerable areas facing greater burdens. AccES advances hazard resilience modeling by providing a scalable, equity-oriented tool to support data-informed decision-making for both pre-disaster planning and post-disaster response.

papers.title: Interactions Among Three‐Tier Factors of Community Safety Resilience: A Dual‐Perspective Analysis
papers.abstract: Enhancing community safety resilience (CSR) is critical for sustainable urban development. Disregarding the complex interactions among CSR factors may cause imbalanced resilience building, limiting a community's capacity to respond to uncertain disasters. This study aims to identify principal CSR factors and examine their interaction mechanisms in the context of Chinese urban communities. We identified 101 factors spanning government, community, and personal tiers. Their interactions were assessed via expert elicitation and analyzed using directed weighted network theory and a modified susceptible-infectious-recovered model. The factor interaction network exhibits a sparse, highly modular, core-periphery structure with small-world and scale-free properties. Community-level governance and infrastructure, together with personal-level physiological and psychological factors, serve as both hubs and intermediary bridges. Government-level top-level design, organizational leadership, and support and investment act as primary drivers, critical in initiating and mitigating risk propagation. Fundamental risk mitigation, especially under dual perturbations, depends on government action, whereas community-level factors are vital for localized response. These findings provide an analytical foundation for prioritizing interventions and designing system-sensitive strategies to enhance CSR.

papers.title: The Distinct Roles of Anger and Hope in PFAS Risk Processing: Integrating Mixed Emotional Appeals and Efficacy Information into the EPPM
papers.abstract: Guided by the Extended Parallel Process Model (EPPM), this study examines the distinct persuasive mechanisms of mixed emotional appeals and efficacy information in the context of environmental risk communication (per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances, PFAS). Results of a 3 (emotional appeals: fear/fear + anger/fear + hope) × 2 (efficacy information: low/high) between-subjects experiment (N = 405) in China revealed that adding anger to fear appeals significantly increased perceived threat, whereas adding hope enhanced perceived self-efficacy. Although providing high-efficacy information enhanced perceived efficacy, it led to a minor reduction in perceived threat. Notably, the interaction analyses showed that high-efficacy information increased response efficacy most strongly in the fear + anger condition. In contrast, fear + hope appeals enhanced self-efficacy even when efficacy information was low. Furthermore, only perceived threat and response efficacy emerged as significant predictors of preventive behaviors. Theoretical implications for expanding the EPPM to include mixed emotions and practical implications for designing PFAS risk messages are discussed.

papers.title: Socio‐Technical Risk‐Informed AI‐Driven Automation Trustworthiness Evaluation (ST‐RATE): Part 1‐Conceptualization
papers.abstract: The growing integration of artificial intelligence (AI)-driven technologies into nuclear power plant (NPP) operations and maintenance holds significant potential to enhance safety, operational efficiency, and reliability. However, deploying such AI-driven automation technologies in high-consequence settings requires a rigorous, traceable, and risk-informed evaluation of their trustworthiness. Although researchers across various domains have proposed definitions and metrics for AI-driven automation trustworthiness, no agreed-upon formal or quantitative method exists that is suitable for the highly regulated nuclear sector. To address this gap, this paper, the first in a two-part series, presents three contributions: (I) a cross-disciplinary literature review that categorizes existing definitions and evaluation methodologies for AI-driven automation trustworthiness and identifies their inherent limitations with respect to applicability in the nuclear domain; (II) develops a new definition of AI-driven automation trustworthiness as “the degree of confidence that the AI-driven automation system will function as expected across its conditions of use” to address the limitations identified in Contribution I; and (III) building on the new definition, conceptualizes the Socio-Technical Risk-informed AI-driven Automation Trustworthiness Evaluation (ST-RATE) methodology, grounded in three foundational pillars: (a) risk-informed performance expectations, (b) socio-technical context across operational conditions, and (c) uncertainty-based trustworthiness evaluation. While developed primarily for the nuclear domain, the definition and ST-RATE methodology has the potential to be adapted for other safety-critical domains with appropriate modifications. The ST-RATE methodological framework is operationalized and demonstrated through an AI-driven automated firewatch case study in a companion paper (Companion paper Part 2, 2025). ST-RATE is the first-of-its-kind methodology that enables risk-informed and uncertainty-based quantification of trustworthiness despite limited empirical data and without over-reliance on subjective expert judgment, addressing the key limitations of existing approaches identified in the literature review.

papers.title: Explainable Machine Learning for Risk‐Driven Forecasting of Global Food Commodity Prices: Geopolitical, Logistic, and Energy Drivers
papers.abstract: Escalating geopolitical tensions, supply chain disruptions, and energy market volatility have intensified global food price instability, posing serious risks to food security. To address this challenge, this study proposes an explainable forecasting framework that integrates historical price dynamics with external drivers, applied to five essential food commodities, olive oil, eggs, chicken, beef, and bread, over the period 1990–2023. The analysis examines how logistics efficiency, energy costs, and geopolitical uncertainty relate to food prices through complex, nonlinear relationships. Going beyond conventional models, the proposed nonlinear autoregressive neural network with exogenous inputs (NARX) captures these dynamics while preserving explainability: through an ablation‐style comparison against a baseline autoregressive model, it systematically evaluates alternative panels of exogenous inputs to identify those with the greatest forecasting contribution. The results show that the predictive relevance of exogenous panels varies across commodities and evaluation metrics, and underscore the value of transparent, multidimensional analysis for improving food price forecasting and understanding price dynamics in an increasingly uncertain global context.

papers.title: End-stage renal disease in the World Trade Center Clinical Centers of Excellence General Responders
papers.abstract: Objectives Hazardous environmental exposures, including those experienced by responders to the 11 September 2001 attacks on the World Trade Center (WTC), can increase the risk of end-stage renal disease (ESRD). This cohort study compared ESRD in the WTC Health Program Clinical Centers of Excellence General Responders (CCEGR) with that of the US general population. We also investigated whether ESRD risk was associated with WTC exposures among the CCEGR. Methods ESRD case status (2002–2021) was confirmed by matched combinations of name, date of birth and (if appropriate) death, sex and social security numbers (as available) with the United States Renal Data System. All-cause ESRD was compared between the CCEGR and the US general population using an indirect age and sex standardised-incidence ratios (SIR). Covariate-adjusted multivariable Cox proportional hazards models assessed the associations of ESRD with four measures of WTC exposure between 2002 and 2021; sensitivity analyses were conducted. Results CCEGR-to-US SIR was 0.64 (95% CI 0.57 to 0.72). ESRD hazard ratios (HR) were 1.24 (95% CI 0.94 to 1.65) comparing high/very high with low/intermediate WTC exposures and 1.23 (95% CI 0.93 to 1.62) comparing responders reporting and not reporting WTC dust cloud exposure. The sensitivity analysis HRs were very similar. Conclusions CCEGR ESRD was significantly lower than expected compared with the general population. While not significant, the HRs indicate that WTC dust cloud exposure may increase CCEGR ESRD risk. A pooled or future assessment would increase statistical power to more definitively determine the association of WTC dust cloud exposure and ESRD.

papers.title: Wearable-assessed sleep in Arctic industrial shift workers: effects of shift type, chronotype and season
papers.abstract: Objectives To determine how sleep timing, quality and duration change across consecutive morning, free days and night shifts among industrial workers in an Arctic environment, and to compare these sleep characteristics between seasons with extreme photoperiods. Methods This observational crossover study included 111 process operators at a high-latitude (71°N) industrial plant in Norway, followed during light and dark photoperiod seasons. Of these, 81 participants participated in both seasons. Sleep was measured daily using sleep diaries and a smart ring. Participants worked a rotating schedule comprising seven consecutive morning shifts, four free days and seven consecutive night shifts. Linear mixed-effects models were used to examine the effects of shift type, season, chronotype and consecutive workdays on sleep parameters. Results Sleep timing and duration varied markedly by shift type. No overall seasonal effects were observed, although sleep onset and mid-sleep were delayed after the first morning shift during the dark season. Late chronotypes showed later sleep timing on free days and slept longer after night shifts. The probability of short sleep (<6 hours) was higher on both morning and night shifts than on free days. Conclusions Both morning and night shifts were associated with shorter sleep than free days, with the greatest reduction after morning shifts. Despite extreme variations in seasonal photoperiod, season had limited influence on sleep among Arctic shift workers, which was primarily determined by work schedules and chronotype.

papers.title: Allied health care trajectories for workers’ compensation claims for injuries of the shoulder and low back pain: state sequence analysis
papers.abstract: Objectives This study aimed to identify distinct typologies of allied healthcare and their associated factors among workers with accepted workers’ compensation claims for shoulder injuries and low back pain. Methods This retrospective cohort study used data from the Victorian and South Australian workers’ compensation authorities. The cohort included 4317 workers with accepted workers’ compensation claims for shoulder injuries or low back pain from January to December 2022. State sequence analysis identified distinct care typologies based on the type of allied health providers encountered monthly. Results Of the 4317 injured workers included, 34.1% had shoulder injuries and 65.9% had low back pain. Three distinct care typologies emerged: Typology 1 (Sustained Physiotherapy) was the most common (51.8%), characterised by delayed care initiation (median 53 days post-injury). Typology 2 (Early—Short-Term Care) constituted predominantly physiotherapy (39.1%) with early (median, 30 days post-injury) and shorter-term care (median, 9 days). Typology 3 (Diverse Care) represented the smallest typology (9.1%) and was characterised by frequent transitions between care provider type. Compared with the Sustained Physiotherapy typology, younger workers, those with traumatic injuries, workers in South Australia and those who initiated care earlier were more likely to belong to the Early—Short-Term Care typology. Conclusion Allied healthcare trajectories differed significantly over the first year after injury, influenced by worker characteristics, injury type, jurisdiction and the type and timing of initial care provider. Further research is needed to scrutinise implications for work disability and return to work outcomes.

papers.title: Disparities in healthy working life expectancy among economically active individuals at age 50 by employment type and occupation
papers.abstract: Objectives This study analysed the healthy working life expectancy among economically active individuals to examine the differences in working duration and healthy years by employment type and occupational category in South Korea. Methods By using data from the Korean Longitudinal Study of Aging 2006–2022, this study analysed 5925 economically active individuals aged 50 and older. Multistate models were employed to estimate and decompose life expectancy into healthy/unhealthy and working/non-working states by using Interpolated Markov Chain software. Occupational category and employment type were determined on the basis of participant status at age 50. Occupations were classified into manual and non-manual according to the Korean Standard Classification of Occupations. Wage employment included regular, temporary and daily paid work whereas non-wage employment included self-employment and unpaid family work. Results Non-wage workers had a significantly longer WLE than wage workers; however, this was largely due to continued work in poorer health. Conversely, wage workers experience substantially longer periods of healthy retirement. Manual workers exhibited longer total working years but shorter healthy working lives and retirement periods than non-manual workers. Conclusions Non-wage and manual workers in South Korea remain in the labour force longer but at the cost of poorer health and shorter healthy postretirement years. Therefore, current labour market structures may exacerbate health inequalities in later life. Policies should shift their focus from simply extending working duration to improving the health and quality of working life of workers.

papers.title: Association between occupational LiFePO 4 exposure and cardiac autonomic function: a cross-sectional study of cathode material production workers
papers.abstract: Objectives Lithium (Li) and iron (Fe) are the primary components of LiFePO4 (LFP), a cathode material used in lithium-ion batteries. Both elements have attracted attention due to their cardiovascular toxicity. This study aims to investigate the effects of the emerging nanomaterial LFP on the autonomic nervous function of workers’ hearts. Methods The heart rate (HR) and heart rate variability (HRV) indicators of 318 LFP production workers were collected using a dynamic ECG monitor, and the urine Li, whole blood Fe, and serum ferritin levels of the workers were measured. A covariate-adjusted linear model was employed to examine the association between metal exposures and cardiac function indicators. Furthermore, interaction effects of metal exposures were explored, and a stratified analysis was performed based on the influencing factors of HRV. Results In the covariate-adjusted linear model, per doubling of urinary Li was related to a 2.28 (95% CI 1.25 to 3.33) beats per minute increase in HR and a 5.98% (95% CI −9.87% to −1.85%) reduction in SD of normal-to-normal intervals (SDNN). Meanwhile, each twofold increase in Fe exposure markers was associated with a decrease of 22.62% (95% CI −32.87% to −10.75%) in SDNN, 58.53% (95% CI −77.62% to −23.16%) in high-frequency power and 57.37% (95% CI −74.83% to −27.80%) in total power, respectively (all PFDR<0.05). In addition, there is a positive interaction between whole blood Fe, urinary Li and increased HR (β>0, Pinteraction=0.036). Conclusions Our study suggests that metal exposures in LFP production workers are associated with increased HR and impaired autonomic nervous system function.

papers.title: Impacts of working from home on sedentary behaviour, physical activity and diet in the post-pandemic era: a within-subject measures study in hybrid workers
papers.abstract: Objectives Hybrid working has increased significantly, contributing to concerns about potential negative impacts of working from home (WFH) on sedentary behaviour, physical activity and dietary behaviours, yet limited research has examined these behaviours within hybrid workers in the post-pandemic context. This cross-sectional study compared sedentary behaviour, physical activity and dietary intake between home working and office working days in a sample of hybrid workers. Methods Sedentary behaviour, physical activity and dietary intake were measured over eight consecutive days using a thigh-worn accelerometer (activPAL micro 3) and diet diary (Nutritics app). Waking and working hours and work location (home/office) were recorded in a daily log. Activity-related and dietary behaviours were compared between working locations using linear mixed models, adjusting for covariates. Results Of 111 hybrid workers, 99 provided valid activPAL data (64% female; mean (SD) age: 35 (13) years; body mass index: 24.8 (4.6) kg/m2). Sedentary time did not differ significantly between work locations (p=0.818). Time spent standing (189 min/day vs 206 min/day, p=0.007), stepping (91 min/day vs 105 min/day, p<0.001) and daily step counts (7519 steps/day vs 9303 steps/day, p<0.001) were significantly lower on WFH days. A subsample (n=40, 83% female) provided dietary data; no differences were seen in total energy intake, proportions of macronutrients contributing to total energy intake and snacking (p>0.05) across working locations. Conclusions WFH was associated with reductions in physical activity. Tailored behaviour change interventions are needed to target these important health-related behaviours in this, now common, working environment.

papers.title: 合成气燃爆特性及其惰化抑爆研究综述
papers.journal_publisher: 中国职业安全健康协会
papers.abstract: 为系统总结合成气燃爆危险性及惰化抑爆技术进展,基于近20年国内外文献,归纳分析合成气点火敏感性、爆炸动力学、反应机制及抑爆方法。首先,总结爆炸极限、最小点火能(MIE)和点火延迟时间(IDT)等参数变化特征,分析H2含量、温度、压力和湍流的影响;其次,综述爆炸压力、压升速率、层流燃烧速度及火焰传播行为,讨论组分比例、边界条件和空间结构的作用;再次,从反应动力学角度归纳H2/CO氧化的主要反应路径及关键自由基作用,分析多因素耦合下微观机制与宏观特征的关联;最后,总结N2/CO2惰化、细水雾、化学抑爆剂及复合抑爆技术,比较不同方法的适用条件。研究表明:H2含量升高通常增强反应活性并提高燃爆危险性;CO2整体惰化效果优于N2;复合抑爆体系因多机制协同获得更好的综合防控效果。当前研究在多因素耦合机制、统一评价体系、预测模型普适性和工程验证方面仍存在不足,未来应加强多场耦合研究,建立标准化评价体系,推动防控技术向智能化和工程化发展。

papers.title: 液体燃料浸润不同颗粒级配黄土床燃烧与火蔓延特性研究
papers.journal_publisher: 中国职业安全健康协会
papers.abstract: 为有效防治液体燃料泄漏引发的土壤环境火灾,并推进灾后环境去污化处理,探究液体燃料浸润多孔介质条件下颗粒级配对燃烧蔓延行为的影响特征,以0号柴油浸润黄土床为研究对象,开展不同颗粒级配条件下的燃烧蔓延试验;测量并分析黄土床结构参数、内部温度、燃烧速率及火蔓延速率等特征参数,探讨颗粒级配对浸润燃烧蔓延过程的影响机制。结果表明:颗粒级配通过改变黄土床孔隙率、干堆积密度、颗粒接触条件及孔隙连通特征等结构参数,影响液体燃料浸润黄土床的燃烧蔓延行为。随着添加颗粒粒径增大,黄土床内部孔隙尺度和传热机制发生变化,床层内部传热逐渐由固相骨架导热向自由对流换热转变,从而强化热量传递能力并提高内部温度水平。平均燃烧速率与黄土床孔隙结构密切相关,其中,基质颗粒粒径db=0.116 mm系列工况燃烧速率随添加颗粒粒径da增加整体呈下降趋势,而db=1.800 mm和db=4.375 mm系列工况则呈先增大后减小的变化特征,其变化主要受传热强化与燃料输运能力变化的共同作用。火蔓延速率随添加颗粒粒径增大整体表现出先减小后增大的变化趋势,并存在临界粒径。引入有效颗粒粒径后建立火蔓延速率预测模型,该模型在有效粒径较小的情况下具有较好的预测精度。

papers.title: 复合改性干水抑制H2/TiH2混合爆炸效果研究
papers.journal_publisher: 中国职业安全健康协会
papers.abstract: 金属氢化物固态储氢具有高能量密度优势,但生产过程中易形成金属氢化物粉尘/H2气粉两相混合体系,爆炸风险极高。为高效抑制金属氢化物粉尘/H2气粉两相混合物爆炸,基于惰性稀释-物理降温-化学阻断的思路,提出一种新型全氟己酮(C6F12O)与碳酸钾(K2CO3)复合改性干水(PC-PMDW),采用密闭爆炸管道系统,对比研究质量分数为40%~100%的PC-PMDW与单一K2CO3改性干水(PC-DW)的抑爆性能。结果表明:PC-PMDW抑爆效果显著优于PC-DW,质量分数为100%时,爆炸压力降幅达70.27%,平均火焰传播速度降幅达91.08%,并且火焰已无法传播至管道末端。结合爆炸产物微观结构和产物成分测试,分析其抑制作用主要为C6F12O和水蒸发吸热、K2CO3热解释放CO2稀释可燃气体、活性钾化合物与含氟自由基捕获H、O、OH等关键自由基以及包覆隔氧的协同效应,从而削弱了热反馈并中断爆炸链式反应。
papers.citation_text: 裴蓓, 吕航, 周磊, 路长, 纪文涛, 阚强. 复合改性干水抑制H2/TiH2混合爆炸效果研究[J]. 中国安全科学学报, 2026, 36(9): 17. DOI: 10.16265/j.cnki.issn1003-3033.2026.09.0592.

papers.title: EMC电解液蒸气对锂电池热失控产物爆炸特性的影响研究
papers.journal_publisher: 中国职业安全健康协会
papers.abstract: 为明确高温电解液蒸气与锂电池热失控气体混合爆炸特性,采用20 L球形爆炸测试装置系统测试不同荷电状态(SOC)锂离子电池热失控气体与碳酸甲乙酯(EMC)蒸气混合体系,并结合计算流体力学(CFD)仿真与化学动力学理论,深度剖析混合体系的爆炸演化特性。结果表明:高温具有物理稀释与化学动力学增强的双重效应。在热力学层面,高燃烧热的EMC蒸气与100% SOC气体混合产生显著的能量叠加,使最大爆炸压力Pmax达到最高;在动力学层面,EMC高温裂解生成的含氧自由基加速了核心链支化反应,导致低SOC气体的最大压力上升速率跃升超240%。此外,微观反应的加速进一步促进宏观流体失稳,体现出潜在的物理-化学耦合特征。
papers.citation_text: 张英, 彭子聪, 李琪, 张楚然, 韩靖皓, 陈月. EMC电解液蒸气对锂电池热失控产物爆炸特性的影响研究[J]. 中国安全科学学报, 2026, 36(9): 26. DOI: 10.16265/j.cnki.issn1003-3033.2026.09.0044.

papers.title: 正置与倒置方向下大容量三元锂电池热失控特性研究
papers.journal_publisher: 中国职业安全健康协会
papers.abstract: 为揭示不同放置方向对大容量三元锂(NCM)电池热失控特性的影响,对135 Ah方壳NCM电池开展正置与倒置放置方向下的过热热失控试验。首先,对比分析不同放置方向下电池的热失控触发、温度与电压响应及内部热失控传播特性;然后,分析射流温度、质量损失、热释放及产烟特性;最后,从热失控触发、蔓延及射流喷射危害3个方面选取8项特征参数,构建基于雷达图的热失控危害评估模型。研究表明:与正置放置相比,倒置放置下电池的热失控触发时间由1 032.5 s延长至1 093.0 s,但当热失控发生后,最高表面温度、最大温升速率和热失控传播速率分别提高14.3%、27.7%和27.6%,最大射流温度提高110.1 ℃。2种放置方向下总放热量及总产烟量没有明显区别,倒置放置虽然提高了电池的热失控触发阈值,但会显著增强热失控后的危害程度,其整体热失控危害性高于正置放置。
papers.citation_text: 范传刚, 尚佳亮, 潘振飞, 施存祥, 罗团团, 黄沛丰. 正置与倒置方向下大容量三元锂电池热失控特性研究[J]. 中国安全科学学报, 2026, 36(9): 35. DOI: 10.16265/j.cnki.issn1003-3033.2026.09.0239.

papers.title: NH4NO3热分解反应动力学模型
papers.journal_publisher: 中国职业安全健康协会
papers.abstract: 为深入揭示NH4NO3的热分解机制,基于热重(TG)试验数据与化学反应神经网络(CRNN)算法,构建2个适用于NH4NO3热分解反应的动力学模型,即3-1模型(3组物质和1个反应)和4-4模型(4组物质和4个反应),预测NH4NO3的TG曲线和热分解过程的物质演化,推测反应路径与中间产物。结果表明:3-1模型得到活化能为98.49 kJ/mol,与试验值基本一致;基于4-4模型构建的反应网络,识别出2条初始反应路径,对应活化能分别为98.02 kJ/mol和139.43 kJ/mol,整个热分解过程涉及NH4+和NO3-间的离子键断裂、氢转移反应、自催化反应及产物间的相互作用,NO2作为关键中间产物参与多条后续反应路径,最终生成NO2、N2O、NO、N2、O2和H2O等气态产物。
papers.citation_text: 纪文涛, 卢雨琴, 郭佳俊, 王燕, 张婧月, 许亚北. NH4NO3热分解反应动力学模型[J]. 中国安全科学学报, 2026, 36(9): 44. DOI: 10.16265/j.cnki.issn1003-3033.2026.09.1424.

papers.title: Na2CO3-5A分子筛改性复合粉体抑制H2/NH3/空气爆炸试验
papers.journal_publisher: 中国职业安全健康协会
papers.abstract: 为保障氢氨燃料的安全应用,制备Na2CO3-5A分子筛复合粉体,并研究其抑爆性能。利用扫描电子显微镜(SEM)、激光粒度分析、热重分析(TGA)和差示扫描量热(DSC)表征复合粉体特征;通过爆炸抑制试验中火焰形态、火焰长度和超压评估粉体抑爆性能,分析燃料中氢气体积分数、复合粉体组分(用复合粉体中Na2CO3的质量比表征)与质量浓度对H2/NH3/空气爆炸的影响。结果表明:所制备的复合粉体表现出优异的结构和热性能;复合粉体对H2/NH3/空气混合物表现出优越的爆炸抑制能力,表现为火焰传播速度和超压降低,爆炸火焰持续时间和达到最大超压的时间延长;对于所有H2/NH3/空气混合物,随着Na2CO3质量比和复合粉体质量浓度的增加,粉体抑爆性能先增强后减弱,性能最佳时Na2CO3质量比和复合粉体质量浓度分别为60%和100 g/m3。
papers.citation_text: 郑凯, 周辰, 孙煜炜, 吴镐南, 赵宇阳, 申帅杭. Na2CO3-5A分子筛改性复合粉体抑制H2/NH3/空气爆炸试验[J]. 中国安全科学学报, 2026, 36(9): 52. DOI: 10.16265/j.cnki.issn1003-3033.2026.09.0314.

papers.title: 古柏表层可燃物热解特性及火灾危险性研究
papers.journal_publisher: 中国职业安全健康协会
papers.abstract: 为实现古柏林的火灾风险评估与防火管控,以古柏树皮、树叶和树枝为研究对象,开展工业分析和空气气氛下的热分析试验,研究不同可燃物的组成特征、热失重过程、放热行为及升温速率对热解特性的影响;采用等转化率法分析主热解反应区的动力学特征,并以平均表观活化能、总放热量和峰值热流为评价指标,利用熵权法判定不同可燃物的火灾危险性。研究结果表明:树皮、树叶、树枝3种可燃物均呈脱水、快速失重、燃尽的阶段特征,其主失重区为200~500 ℃,主要放热峰集中在300~460 ℃,放热主要来自挥发性产物及残余炭在空气中的氧化过程。树皮灰分为21.78%、热解残余率在18%~24%,热解推进受阻;树叶平均表观活化能最低(164.03 kJ/mol),更易发生热解反应;树枝总放热量为5 796.33 J/g,持续供热能力更强。火灾危险性为树枝>树叶>树皮。
papers.citation_text: 赵婧昱, 明汉奇, 宋佳佳, 帅星宇, 张嬿妮, 邓军. 古柏表层可燃物热解特性及火灾危险性研究[J]. 中国安全科学学报, 2026, 36(9): 61. DOI: 10.16265/j.cnki.issn1003-3033.2026.09.0279.

papers.title: 基于COMSOL的受限空间内氢气泄漏扩散分析与危险区域划分
papers.journal_publisher: 中国职业安全健康协会
papers.abstract: 为提高氢能应用场景的风险防控,通过 COMSOL Multiphysics 软件模拟受限空间内氢气泄漏扩散过程,构建二维几何模型,系统研究不同泄漏孔径、风速、障碍物高度及障碍物与泄漏孔间距下的氢气质量浓度分布特性,绘制质量浓度分布图及等值线图,揭示氢气泄漏扩散特征;并基于氢气爆炸极限划分燃爆危险区域,量化危险范围随时间的变化特征。研究结果表明:泄漏孔径越大,氢气云团体积越大,t=15 s 时 40 mm 孔径的水平扩散距离较 20 mm孔径增加约 2 m,危险性显著提升;障碍物可改变扩散路径并抑制垂直传播,4 m 高障碍物使垂直扩散距离较无障碍物时缩短1.5 m,但过高障碍物可能导致局部高浓度积聚。
papers.citation_text: 穆仕芳, 王中兰, 尚如静, 纪文涛, 王燕. 基于COMSOL的受限空间内氢气泄漏扩散分析与危险区域划分[J]. 中国安全科学学报, 2026, 36(9): 71. DOI: 10.16265/j.cnki.issn1003-3033.2026.09.0879.

papers.title: 基于多尺度特征融合与动态注意力的火灾探测算法
papers.journal_publisher: 中国职业安全健康协会
papers.abstract: 为降低复杂场景下火灾探测漏报率并提高烟火目标抗干扰识别能力,提出基于深度学习目标检测框架的火灾探测算法。首先,以YOLOv8n为基准网络,在特征金字塔下采样阶段引入小波变换卷积(WTConv)模块,保留火焰边缘和烟雾纹理的高频细节;其次,在特征融合阶段构建多核轻量化Inception模块(PKLBlock),通过多分支卷积与上下文锚点注意力进行多尺度特征融合;然后,在检测特征层纳入非局部注意力(NLAttention)模块,通过动态注意力机制建立烟火目标与周围区域间的长距离依赖关系;最后,采用自建烟火图像数据集开展消融试验,对比分析并评价算法性能。结果表明:该算法的精确率、召回率、F1及交并比阈值为0.5时的平均精度均值(mAP)@0.5分别为93.46%、88.48%、90.90%及92.04%,较YOLOv8n基准算法分别提高5.24%、2.12%、3.62%及3.86%,推理速度为31.2帧/s。该算法能实时检测火焰与烟雾目标,为视频监控场景下火灾早期预警提供算法支持。
papers.citation_text: 李冬, 霍一诺, 杨先志, 汪锐, 刘玉智, 王静舞. 基于多尺度特征融合与动态注意力的火灾探测算法[J]. 中国安全科学学报, 2026, 36(9): 78. DOI: 10.16265/j.cnki.issn1003-3033.2026.09.0630.

papers.title: 基于局部应用灭火系统的喷射气体冲力模型
papers.journal_publisher: 中国职业安全健康协会
papers.abstract: 为解决局部应用灭火系统在扑救B类平面火灾时,喷射气体冲力兼具高效压火与诱发飞溅双重作用的安全技术问题,构建气体冲力预测模型并开展试验研究。首先,基于阵列式动态压力测量的气体冲力测试装置,精准量化喷嘴下方气体冲力场的空间分布与瞬态演化特征;其次,基于试验数据,建立综合喷射压力与时间的冲力预测模型;然后,构建包含压火与灭火2阶段的综合效能模型,基于火羽流理论建立火焰升力计算模型,确立喷射气体冲力大于火焰升力的临界灭火判据;最后,提出中心飞溅的表面张力判据与边缘溢出的几何形态判据,量化安全喷射的冲力阈值。结果表明:所建模型与装置可精准预测灭火所需的临界冲力与诱发飞溅的安全阈值,灭火成功发生在冲力峰值释放期及衰减初期,与理论判据预测一致;飞溅预测结果与试验观测结果吻合,验证了双重判据的有效性。
papers.citation_text: 马建琴, 杨帆, 王皓轩, 赵青松. 基于局部应用灭火系统的喷射气体冲力模型[J]. 中国安全科学学报, 2026, 36(9): 85. DOI: 10.16265/j.cnki.issn1003-3033.2026.09.0240.

papers.title: 定向泄爆管道结构对掺氢天然气火焰传播及超压的影响
papers.journal_publisher: 中国职业安全健康协会
papers.abstract: 为降低掺氢天然气管道爆炸事故危害,提升输气管道安全水平,通过自主搭建的管道爆炸试验平台,系统对比掺氢天然气,即CH4/H2/空气混合物在无泄爆管道、水平泄爆管道和60°分岔泄爆管道3种条件下的爆炸特性,重点分析不同定向泄爆管道结构对火焰传播特性和预混管道内爆炸超压的影响。研究结果表明:与无泄爆管道的开放空间条件相比,在定向泄爆约束条件下,泄爆管道内发生的剧烈二次爆炸,致使预混管道内爆炸超压与火焰传播速度显著提升;与水平定向泄爆相比,分岔定向泄爆入口处的分岔结构削弱了泄放气体的流速,使火焰锋面传播至泄爆管道的时间延长,推迟了火焰速度和爆炸超压达到峰值的时间;相较于水平定向泄爆管道,分岔定向泄爆管道能够有效降低最大火焰传播速度、最大爆炸超压及最大压力上升速率,降幅分别为9%、30%和24%。
papers.citation_text: 阳旭峰, 蒋保平, 杨文, 张坤, 张玉春. 定向泄爆管道结构对掺氢天然气火焰传播及超压的影响[J]. 中国安全科学学报, 2026, 36(9): 94. DOI: 10.16265/j.cnki.issn1003-3033.2026.09.2107.

papers.title: 基于工艺参数驱动的连续式反应器防爆韧性评估
papers.journal_publisher: 中国职业安全健康协会
papers.abstract: 为预防连续式反应器在运行过程中因热失控而发生的爆炸事故,提出一种融合动态模拟与韧性评估的反应器爆炸事故防控方法。首先,基于反应器运行特性及热失控机制,明确温度、压力等关键工艺参数,系统识别潜在干扰事件;其次,利用Aspen Hysys软件开展动态模拟,分析不同干扰事件下反应器关键工艺参数时变特征,在此基础上,考虑工艺参数多维性与时变特征,基于最优最劣算法(BWM)构建工艺参数驱动的反应器系统韧性评估模型,综合评价反应器防爆韧性;最后,以乙烯与苯制乙苯连续式反应器为例,验证该方法的准确性和适用性。研究结果表明:相较于反应器压力和出口流量,反应器温度受进料温度阶跃变化的影响最为敏感;进料温度的阶跃变化会对反应器系统性能和韧性产生显著的非线性影响,当进料温度分别升高12.5%和62.5%时,反应器系统性能分别降至0.9和0.46,对应的系统韧性分别为0.88和0.82;通过提高反应器防爆韧性,可将关键工艺参数控制在安全阈值之内,从而预防爆炸事故发生。
papers.citation_text: 孙浩, 黄锦, 师吉浩, 王付宇, 戚萌. 基于工艺参数驱动的连续式反应器防爆韧性评估[J]. 中国安全科学学报, 2026, 36(9): 103. DOI: 10.16265/j.cnki.issn1003-3033.2026.09.0029.

papers.title: 不同约束下磷酸铁锂电池过充热失控特性研究
papers.journal_publisher: 中国职业安全健康协会
papers.abstract: 为降低锂离子电池过充引发的热失控燃爆风险,完善夹具约束、空间受限与点火条件的耦合调控机制,以314 Ah方形磷酸铁锂电池为研究对象,通过调节“夹具约束—空间受限—点火条件”三因素开展试验,系统探究0.5 C过充工况下电池热失控的现象演化、温度响应及电压变化特征。结果表明:无约束工况下,电池膨胀不受限导致安全阀失效,直接引发爆炸,爆炸前开放/受限空间的表面峰值温度分别为50.78 、54.06 ℃,爆炸冲击力可突破初始物理边界;约束工况下,安全阀正常开启,热失控以烟气喷射或喷射火形式释放能量,开放空间约束点火工况的电池背面峰值温度达458.93 ℃,显著高于受限空间约束点火工况的291.13 ℃;受限空间内未点火时烟气因密度较大在下部积聚,点火后形成高度1.5 m的剧烈喷射火,火焰峰值温度达701.87 ℃;电压演化呈现“上升—平台—陡升—回落”特征,无约束工况因结构破坏缺失完整回落过程。
papers.citation_text: 杨帆, 白盼星, 平小凡, 张存富, 曹曦, 杨宇轩. 不同约束下磷酸铁锂电池过充热失控特性研究[J]. 中国安全科学学报, 2026, 36(9): 111. DOI: 10.16265/j.cnki.issn1003-3033.2026.09.0508.

papers.title: 防火密封胶理化性能、热解和燃烧特性研究
papers.journal_publisher: 中国职业安全健康协会
papers.abstract: 为提高防火封堵材料的防火特性,以防火密封胶为研究对象,进行常规理化性能测试,并通过热重-红外光谱联用试验以及锥形量热仪试验揭示其微尺度-实验室尺度的热解和燃烧特性,探究防火密封胶在氮气和空气2种气氛中的热解行为和不同热辐射通量下的燃烧特性。结果表明:微尺度氮气氛围热解过程可较为明显地针对聚磷酸铵、三聚氰胺、丙烯酸3种物质划分为3个阶段,而空气氛围燃烧过程中氧气的存在促进聚磷酸铵和三聚氰胺反应阶段的融合;温度在850 K之前,氮气氛围下反应生成气体产物以氨气为主,而空气氛围下生成的气体产物同时伴随较多的氨气、二氧化碳和水;温度在850 K之后,2种氛围下生成的气体产物均为二氧化碳和水;实验室尺度的锥形量热仪试验中辐射热通量越大,点燃时间越短,有害气体生成速率和峰值越高,计算得到的火灾危险性评价指数也进一步表征更高的火灾危险性。
papers.citation_text: 张良, 欧伟镭, 张金成, 周熹, 刘薇, 丁彦铭. 防火密封胶理化性能、热解和燃烧特性研究[J]. 中国安全科学学报, 2026, 36(9): 120. DOI: 10.16265/j.cnki.issn1003-3033.2026.09.1312.

papers.title: 环保型纳米颗粒对泡沫稳定性及抑制性能的影响
papers.journal_publisher: 中国职业安全健康协会
papers.abstract: 为提高高倍泡沫抑制液化天然气(LNG)等低温液体泄漏扩散和池火燃烧的应急处理能力,选取3种天然来源、可降解的环保型纳米颗粒,分析不同颗粒质量分数下泡沫溶液的起泡性和稳定性,以及纳米颗粒抑制低温液体蒸发的控制效果。研究表明:随着纳米颗粒质量分数增加溶液的起泡性均逐渐下降,泡沫析液速度呈先增加后下降的趋势,泡沫溶液的半衰期随木质素颗粒质量分数为0.1%时达到最大随后呈下降趋势,而泡沫的稳定性随纳米纤维和晶须质量分数的增加而增加。添加木质素泡沫的尺寸增大速度较快,而在纳米纤维和晶须作用下,随着时间增加泡沫尺寸增加幅度较小。泡沫抑制低温液体蒸发呈现快速蒸发、稳定蒸发和蒸发下降3个阶段,添加纳米颗粒可延长低温液体的维持时间,从而有利于抑制液体的蒸发。
papers.citation_text: 张亦翔, 曹诗琪, 冯世龙, 蒋华义. 环保型纳米颗粒对泡沫稳定性及抑制性能的影响[J]. 中国安全科学学报, 2026, 36(9): 128. DOI: 10.16265/j.cnki.issn1003-3033.2026.09.0045.

papers.title: 防护墙存在条件下环境风对 LPG 球罐泄漏扩散的影响研究
papers.journal_publisher: 中国职业安全健康协会
papers.abstract: 为揭示防护墙存在条件下环境风对液化石油气(LPG)球罐泄漏扩散行为的作用特征,基于FLACS软件建立球罐区三维数值模型,以实际球罐区典型泄漏场景为基础,设置不同风向和风速工况,模拟 LPG 泄漏后气云在防护墙内外的扩散与积聚过程;通过对比不同工况下气云最大扩散距离、典型区域LPG体积分数以及等效可燃气云体积的时变特征,系统分析环境风与防护墙耦合作用下可燃气云危险区域的演化特征。研究结果表明:LPG泄漏扩散过程由泄漏初期的射流动量主导逐步转变为环境风场控制,防护墙与环境风的耦合作用显著改变气云扩散路径、LPG体积分数分布及危险区域范围;逆风条件下,环境风削弱气云的轴向输运能力,并在防护墙阻隔作用下诱发气云回流与积聚,燃爆风险显著高于顺风及侧风工况;逆风条件下,低风速(约2 m/s)时气云积聚最为显著,等效可燃气云体积达到全部模拟工况的最大值;随着风速增大,湍流掺混与稀释效应增强,气云扩散范围及可燃体积整体减小。
keywords: liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) spherical storage tank
papers.citation_text: 黄元洁, 林冬, 韩林序, 张娣娜, 杨国梁, 翟旭. 防护墙存在条件下环境风对 LPG 球罐泄漏扩散的影响研究[J]. 中国安全科学学报, 2026, 36(9): 136. DOI: 10.16265/j.cnki.issn1003-3033.2026.09.0331.

papers.title: 现场制备防灭火稠化浆体悬浮性能研究
papers.journal_publisher: 中国职业安全健康协会
papers.abstract: 为解决传统黄土防灭火浆体易沉降、堵管路、堆积失效的工程难题,提升稠化浆体悬浮稳定性,对黄土颗粒开展力学分析,探明搅拌时间、搅拌速度、颗粒粒径通过改变颗粒间作用力影响悬浮特性;结合极差、方差、回归及响应面分析,明确因素主次、最优参数区间,并通过现场注浆监测验证参数实用性。研究结果表明:浆体搅拌时间A和浆体搅拌速度B会使稠化浆体剪切稀化,从而改变稠化浆体三维网状结构及分子间的缠结作用;黄土颗粒大小C会影响黄土颗粒在浆体中的比表面积、力学作用和聚团行为,三者共同影响浆体稠度和悬浮性能;A为5 min,B为1 000 r/min,C为140目时,稠化浆体静态悬浮率最优,达到82.5%;各因素对静态悬浮率δ影响的主次排序为B>A>C,搅拌速度是影响稠化浆体静态悬浮率的重要因素;影响稠化浆体材料悬浮效果的因素最优范围为4.3 min≤A≤5.9 min、B=1 000 r/min、108目≤C≤167目,分析结果与极差方差分析结果基本一致;现场注浆过程中的监测及注浆结果验证了实验室得出的最优制备参数对于现场注浆效果具有较好的指导作用。
papers.citation_text: 邵淑珍, 施式亮, 王磊, 鲁义, 邢舜博, 田帅. 现场制备防灭火稠化浆体悬浮性能研究[J]. 中国安全科学学报, 2026, 36(9): 147. DOI: 10.16265/j.cnki.issn1003-3033.2026.09.1421.

papers.title: 尺度及油水厚度对原油储罐沸溢行为的影响
papers.journal_publisher: 中国职业安全健康协会
papers.abstract: 为揭示尺度及油水厚度对原油储罐沸溢行为的影响,设计并搭建包含4种尺度储罐的试验平台,系统开展不同尺度与油水厚度下原油储罐沸溢试验,分析沸溢时间和行为特征、油温分布与热波传播速率、热辐射强度以及质量相关参数,建立热波传播速率与质量燃烧速率的关系式,并评估现有沸溢时间预测模型的适用性。研究结果表明:沸溢时间随储罐尺度的增大呈线性增长趋势,而热波传播速率则表现为非线性递增,相对尺度为66.7%时,热波传播速率达全尺度试验的85.4%,沸溢安全距离亦随储罐尺度的增大显著增加;在沸溢行为方面,小尺度试验主要表现为连续喷射,而大尺度试验则呈现出翻腾式溢出和蔓延燃烧等特征;在大尺度下,油水厚度对同一水平面的油温影响不显著,但随油层厚度增加和水层厚度减少,沸溢时间延长,溢出燃料占剩余燃料的比例增加,沸溢强度增加,其中油层厚度对沸溢强度的提升更显著。
papers.citation_text: 李樾杨, 李明泽, 荆琦, 李云涛, 栾国华, 李鑫. 尺度及油水厚度对原油储罐沸溢行为的影响[J]. 中国安全科学学报, 2026, 36(9): 157. DOI: 10.16265/j.cnki.issn1003-3033.2026.09.1122.

papers.title: 基于多组分小分子烃的燃烧反应简化模型及仿真
papers.journal_publisher: 中国职业安全健康协会
papers.abstract: 为快速准确评估易燃易爆化学品燃烧火灾事故后果,首先,利用全自动热裂解仪(Py)与气相色谱-质谱(GCMS)联用装置,通过快速升温热裂解试验重现易燃易爆化学品的燃烧反应过程;然后,获取其小分子中间产物及其比例系数,构建简化模型;最后,耦合至Fluent模拟软件中,仿真分析正庚烷等石油基液态烃类燃料的燃爆过程。研究结果表明:正庚烷热裂解产物受裂解时长、升温速率影响显著,受裂解温度影响较小。其中,600 ℃为正庚烷稳定燃烧的临界点,该温度及以上时裂解产物组分含量基本保持恒定,在升温速率1 000 ℃/s、裂解时长8 s时,裂解最充分,产物以C3、C4、C5烷烃与烯烃为主,是构建正庚烷燃烧反应简化模型的核心组分;通过仿真对比基于正标准燃料(PRF)燃烧反应机制发现,烯烃类简化模型的火焰形状、CO/CO2等特征气体分布云图相似度最高,混合类简化模型的火焰几何参数匹配度最优,但烷烃类简化模型在火焰分布及特征气体输运扩散方面存在显著偏差。
papers.citation_text: 陈健, 钱雯静, 沈淑怡, 陈思凝, 周侠, 郭耸. 基于多组分小分子烃的燃烧反应简化模型及仿真[J]. 中国安全科学学报, 2026, 36(9): 167. DOI: 10.16265/j.cnki.issn1003-3033.2026.09.0335.

papers.title: 正丁醇逆流流淌火扩散行为及稳定燃烧特性研究
papers.journal_publisher: 中国职业安全健康协会
papers.abstract: 为研究不同泄漏条件下逆流流淌火扩散行为及燃烧特性,基于100 cm × 20 cm × 8 cm不锈钢流淌槽试验平台,利用蠕动泵精准控制泄漏速率(9~650 mL/min),开展正丁醇逆流流淌火试验,采用高帧率相机记录火焰蔓延动态,结合电子天平、热电偶及数据采集系统同步采集质量损失速率及温度场演化数据。结果表明:泄漏速率由40 mL/min增至120 mL/min时,油层增厚降低基底传导与辐射透射损失,热量积聚导致火焰蔓延速度增大;泄漏速率进一步增至 560 mL/min 时,高速流动的燃料引发强烈的强制对流冷却效应,抵消油层保温作用,导致蔓延速度显著下降;单位面积质量损失速率在低流量(60 mL/min)、中等流量(120~160 mL/min)及高流量(290~650 mL/min)下分别呈4阶段演化特征;基于能量守恒计算的稳定燃烧阶段单位面积质量损失速率与试验值的相对误差在±28%以内;随泄漏速率进一步增加,强制对流热损失在总能量平衡中的权重从28%提升至57%。
papers.citation_text: 李然然, 岳志强, 杜道全, 王雪, 李满厚. 正丁醇逆流流淌火扩散行为及稳定燃烧特性研究[J]. 中国安全科学学报, 2026, 36(9): 178. DOI: 10.16265/j.cnki.issn1003-3033.2026.09.0346.

papers.title: 隧道流淌火蔓延燃烧行为与烟气演化特性全尺寸试验
papers.journal_publisher: 中国职业安全健康协会
papers.abstract: 为揭示公路隧道流淌火灾的灾变机制、弥补全尺寸试验数据不足,在长100 m、宽10.5 m、高7.5 m的全尺寸公路隧道内,开展不同燃料类型(正庚烷、乙醇)和泄漏速率(34~59 mL/s)下的流淌火试验,分析燃烧直径、火焰高度、燃烧速率、顶棚烟气温度及烟气蔓延速度的演化特性。结果表明:流淌火灾燃烧直径呈典型“蔓延-回缩-准稳定燃烧”3阶段发展过程,火焰高度与燃烧直径间存在线性关系;正庚烷流淌火灾的稳定阶段燃烧速率高于乙醇,分别为0.055~0.063、0.039~0.050 mm/s;顶棚烟气温度变化趋势与燃烧直径一致;各工况下烟气蔓延速度为0.4~0.71 m/s,与泄漏速率正相关;稳定阶段顶棚最高温升与流淌火灾热释放速率呈线性相关;无量纲温升随无量纲距离的增大呈指数衰减,且衰减速度低于现有模型预测值。
papers.citation_text: 马翰超, 翟旭, 张一辰, 吕君可, 肖建峰, 黄弘. 隧道流淌火蔓延燃烧行为与烟气演化特性全尺寸试验[J]. 中国安全科学学报, 2026, 36(9): 185. DOI: 10.16265/j.cnki.issn1003-3033.2026.09.0328.

papers.title: 无人机载荷约束下干粉-泡沫联用抑灭火效能研究
papers.journal_publisher: 中国职业安全健康协会
papers.abstract: 为解决系留式消防无人机(UAV)在高层建筑火灾救援中破拆玻璃后易诱发回燃并转捩为轰燃这一难题,提出“干粉-泡沫”联用抑灭火策略。搭建全尺寸火灾试验平台,考虑无人机的载荷约束,通过系统改变干粉质量(1.5~4 kg)和泡沫流量(0.5~2 L/s),获取顶棚烟气层温度和火焰高度等火场参数数据;构建抑灭火效能评价体系,量化分析不同干粉-泡沫用量对抑灭火效能的影响。研究结果表明:不同干粉-泡沫用量工况均可有效抑制回燃转捩,干粉-泡沫联用抑灭火的协同作用机制为“初期干粉快速抑制-后期泡沫长效冷却”;通过效能评价分析得出,增加干粉质量可提升抑火效能,但超过3 kg后提升幅度衰减至5.6 %;低流量泡沫(<1.5 L/s)会严重衰减降温效能并增加复燃风险;3 kg干粉与2 L/s泡沫的联用方案在抑火效能(0.074 m/s)和降温效能(3.14 ℃/s)上达到最优。
papers.citation_text: 李治含, 张国维, 李彬, 于龙飞, 刘湘斐. 无人机载荷约束下干粉-泡沫联用抑灭火效能研究[J]. 中国安全科学学报, 2026, 36(9): 193. DOI: 10.16265/j.cnki.issn1003-3033.2026.09.0880.

papers.title: 弱重力运动条件下正庚烷燃烧特征
papers.journal_publisher: 中国职业安全健康协会
papers.abstract: 为探究飞机起落过程中弱重力运动条件对油池火燃烧的影响,首先,搭建15~45°斜面试验平台,模拟飞机起降复合弱重力工况,搭配不同尺寸方形油池,借助传感器与高速摄像采集加速度、火焰形态、燃料燃烧时长等数据;其次,观察下滑过程火焰变化,划分出火焰稳定、快速倾斜、振荡稳定3个阶段,分析斜面倾角、油池大小对燃料燃烧速率、火焰倾角和高度的影响,理清重力与水平惯性力共同作用下火焰变形、高度下降的内在特征;最后,依托层流滞止层理论做等效简化,分别建立燃烧速率、火焰倾角、火焰高度同重力、水平加速度的定量关联模型。结果表明:下滑状态下正庚烷的燃烧速率要高于静止状态,正庚烷质量损失速率随下滑角度的增大先增大后减小,在25~35°间达到峰值;随着油池尺寸的增加,正庚烷火焰倾角对重力和水平加速度的变化敏感程度上升,而正庚烷火焰高度对重力和水平加速度的敏感程度则变弱。
papers.citation_text: 张茂林, 黄鑫, 赵梦珂. 弱重力运动条件下正庚烷燃烧特征[J]. 中国安全科学学报, 2026, 36(9): 202. DOI: 10.16265/j.cnki.issn1003-3033.2026.09.1543.

papers.title: C-SAT氢气射流火焰长度预测模型验证及性能评估
papers.journal_publisher: 中国职业安全健康协会
papers.abstract: 针对传统火焰模型在考虑氢气浮力效应及低密度特性方面存在不足导致火焰长度预测偏差的问题,以碳中和安全评估工具(C-SAT)中的氢气射流火焰长度预测模型为对象,开展模型验证与性能评估。基于多组公开发表的氢气射流火焰试验数据,对C-SAT内置的5种虚拟喷嘴模型(Y/O、Birch、Birch2、E/M、Molkov模型)进行预测精度对比与筛选评估;并对比分析最优模型与过程危害分析软件工具(PHAST)中美国石油协会(API)推荐的计算模型和锥模型。结果表明:Y/O模型在4种喷嘴模型中综合表现最优,其安全因子、二因子比例、平均相对偏差和几何平均偏差分别为1.077、100%、-0.068和0.934;C-SAT的几何平均偏差(0.934)和平均相对偏差(-0.068)均优于API模型(0.744,-0.292)及锥模型(1.132,0.122)。
keywords: safety assessment tool for carbon neutrality (C-SAT)
papers.citation_text: 朱坤龙, 胡辉, 王智, 张彬. C-SAT氢气射流火焰长度预测模型验证及性能评估[J]. 中国安全科学学报, 2026, 36(9): 210. DOI: 10.16265/j.cnki.issn1003-3033.2026.09.0320.

papers.title: 阻火器孔径比对汽油蒸气-空气预混火焰传播特性的影响研究
papers.journal_publisher: 中国职业安全健康协会
papers.abstract: 为探究阻火器孔径比对汽油蒸气-空气预混火焰淬熄特性的影响,开展可视化汽油蒸气-空气预混气体阻火试验,利用高速相机和数据采集器记录火焰传播过程及参数变化,研究蜂窝状阻火器孔径比α(0~0.060)对火焰传播形态、火焰传播速度、超压及温度变化特性的影响。结果表明:孔径比对爆炸超压与温度分布具有显著影响;α ≤ 0.027时,阻火器能完全抑制火焰传播,但诱发长持时反向振荡火焰脉动,反向火焰振幅随孔径比增大而减小;α ≥ 0.033时,阻火器增强湍流,火焰传播加速,管道下游速度峰值随孔径比增大而增大;阻火成功时仅出现单一超压峰值(较无阻火器管道降低约78%),下游温度始终低于50.00 ℃;阻火失败呈3阶段压力特征,最大超压峰值和下游温度峰值的到达时间分别缩短约45%和48.57%。

papers.title: 110 kV地下变电站主变压器室爆炸及泄压材料试验
papers.journal_publisher: 中国职业安全健康协会
papers.abstract: 为解决现有泄压模型对110 kV地下变电站主变压器室适用性差的问题,采用FLACS数值模拟方法,计算不同泄压面积下的最大爆炸泄放压力;基于NFPA 68模型,提出适用于高阻塞变压器室的改进爆炸压力计算公式;并开展爆炸泄放试验,测试石膏板、铝镁锰板和充气混凝土3种泄压材料的破裂特性。结果表明:爆炸泄放压力随泄压面积增大呈非线性衰减,泄压面积由0增至9 m2时,泄放率达67.41%,继续增大泄压面积则泄压效率增益显著降低;控制最大爆炸泄放压力低于10 kPa至少需泄压面积3.13 m2,为保证建筑结构完整性,建议泄放面积为5~10 m2;3种隔墙材料中,12 mm厚石膏板破裂压力最低(约2.6 kPa),泄压效果最优。
papers.citation_text: 余森, 张长帅. 110 kV地下变电站主变压器室爆炸及泄压材料试验[J]. 中国安全科学学报, 2026, 36(9): 225. DOI: 10.16265/j.cnki.issn1003-3033.2026.09.2110.

papers.title: 城市灭火救援指挥作战大模型构建与应用
papers.journal_publisher: 中国职业安全健康协会
papers.abstract: 为破解城市灭火救援指挥依赖人工经验与静态规则导致的信息感知滞后、多源数据融合难、流式处理时延高、多任务协同低效等问题,构建城市灭火救援指挥作战大模型系统。以应急管理久安大语言模型(LLM)为基座,融合消防行业高质量语料,采用增量预训练、监督微调与知识蒸馏策略打造专属大模型;引入状态空间模型(SSM)设计渐进式增量分析算法,构建基于模型上下文协议(MCP)与黑板共享机制的多智能体协同架构,经全局状态驱动完成异构工具链自主调用。结果表明:系统接警意图理解准确率达96.5%,接处警平均耗时由45 s缩短至35 s;首字响应延迟降至310 ms,长序列处理显存峰值由82 GB降至24 GB;黑板机制使预案编排交互规模降低约45%,灾情研判与风险预警延迟压缩至毫秒级。该训练体系可注入垂直领域知识并压缩模型参数规模;支持灾情文书及多模态流数据的实时研判与风险动态预警,满足火场实战秒级响应要求;分布式多智能体架构可支持去中心化业务协同,大幅降低系统延迟与词元(token)消耗。
papers.citation_text: 王晓璐, 王飞, 郭玮, 尚星位, 金颖. 城市灭火救援指挥作战大模型构建与应用[J]. 中国安全科学学报, 2026, 36(9): 231. DOI: 10.16265/j.cnki.issn1003-3033.2026.09.0342.

papers.title: 基于融合预测改进自编码的高层建筑电气火灾预警
papers.journal_publisher: 中国职业安全健康协会
papers.abstract: 为解决高层建筑配电系统中配电箱异常状态识别精度不足的问题,提出一种融合预测任务的改进自编码器模型。首先,基于自主研发的多参数监测装置,采集三相电压、电流、剩余电流、中性线电流及设备温度等多维时序数据,并通过最大-最小归一化方法消除量纲差异;其次,在模型构建中,采用双向门控循环单元(BiGRU)捕捉数据的前后向长期依赖关系,结合缩放点积注意力机制(SDA)强化关键时间步信息,并利用卷积层与通道注意力机制提取多特征间的局部关联特征;然后,模型采用对称式编码-解码结构,通过拼接编码与解码阶段的BiGRU隐藏状态,构建“重构-预测”双任务学习框架,精准预测下一时刻电气参数;最后,通过预测误差的评分函数量化序列异常程度。结果表明:模型的均方根误差(RMSE)、平均绝对误差(MAE)和决定系数R2分别为0.000 9、0.017 8和0.731 3;相比XGBoost、GRU和Transformer等模型,MAE和R2指标均表现出较好的预测结果,并对剩余电流渐变漂移、温度异常升高和电流突变扰动等异常特征产生相应的异常评分响应。
papers.citation_text: 李闯闯, 招嘉怡, 王白根, 程坤, 李彬, 苏盛. 基于融合预测改进自编码的高层建筑电气火灾预警[J]. 中国安全科学学报, 2026, 36(9): 240. DOI: 10.16265/j.cnki.issn1003-3033.2026.09.1987.

papers.title: 松针堆积密度与洒水覆盖水平条件下地表火阻隔效果研究
papers.journal_publisher: 中国职业安全健康协会
papers.abstract: 为评估森林灭火中隔离带的阻隔能力,以马尾松枯落松针为对象,搭建地表火蔓延试验平台,设置6组洒水覆盖水平及3种堆积密度,研究隔离带对火蔓延阻隔效果。结果表明:根据火焰蔓延过程及内部温度的分布,洒水隔离带的阻隔结果可分为阻隔成功和阻隔失效,其中,能否成功阻隔与燃料底部阴燃的传播过程密切相关。实际阻隔效果与洒水覆盖水平和燃料床堆积密度密切相关,阻隔成功的条件为洒水覆盖水平足以维持隔离带内部冷却与湿润作用,并抑制燃料床底部阴燃传播及后续复燃。覆盖水平越大,内部含水率高,能有效抑制内部阴燃传播,阻隔效果越好。当堆积密度分别为33.33、42.85和 100 kg/m3 时,阻隔成功临界洒水覆盖水平分别为 3.0、2.0和 1.0 L/m2。燃料床堆积密度越大,阻隔效果越好,这主要是因为大堆积密度下,孔隙率小,供氧条件差。同时,燃料床堆积密度会改变火蔓延过程中火焰长度和倾角,最终影响隔离带后方的辐射强度。
papers.citation_text: 孔维珖, 潘宇, 张金莲, 郭伟华, 赵金龙. 松针堆积密度与洒水覆盖水平条件下地表火阻隔效果研究[J]. 中国安全科学学报, 2026, 36(9): 248. DOI: 10.16265/j.cnki.issn1003-3033.2026.09.0419.

papers.title: 基于多模态生理指标融合的消防员体力疲劳状态分析
papers.journal_publisher: 中国职业安全健康协会
papers.abstract: 为精准分析消防员体力疲劳状态,降低训练损伤风险、提升应急救援效能,首先,以 18 名消防员为研究对象,通过日常训练诱导体力疲劳,结合主观问卷得分与时间感知平均相对误差验证疲劳诱导有效性;然后,采集疲劳前后心率变异性(HRV)、眼动、皮电、肌电4类生理指标,经功效分析、t 检验、秩和检验及BH矫正筛选显著差异指标,并采用最小冗余最大相关(mRMR)算法,完成核心特征优选;最后,基于多模态融合策略构建单、双、三、四模态疲劳状态分析模型,并采用逻辑回归(LR)、K近邻(KNN)、支持向量机(SVM)、自适应提升(AB)、随机森林(RF)5种机器学习算法,开展分析验证。结果表明:心率变异性(HRV)为最优单模态分析指标;多模态融合分析效果显著优于单一模态,肌电、HRV、眼动三模态为最佳融合组合;逻辑回归模型识别准确率达91.4%、平均准确率为88.7%,可高效精准判定消防员体力疲劳状态。
papers.abstract_en: To accurately identify physical fatigue in firefighters, lower training injury risks, boost emergency rescue efficiency, 18 firefighters were selected as research subjects. Physical fatigue was induced via routine training. The effectiveness of fatigue induction was verified with subjective questionnaire scores and the mean relative error of time perception. Four types of physiological signals, including heart rate variability(HRV), eye movement, electrodermal activity(EDA) and electromyography (EMG), were synchronously collected before and after fatigue. Fourteen significantly different indicators were screened via power analysis, t-test, rank-sum test and Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) correction. Core features were optimized and selected using the minimum Redundancy Maximum Relevance (mRMR) algorithm. Single-modal, dual-modal, trimodal and four-modal fatigue recognition models were built under the multimodal fusion strategy. Recognition verification was implemented by five algorithms: Logistic Regression (LR), K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Adaptive Boosting (AB) and Random Forest (RF). Result shows that heart rate variability (HRV) serves as the optimal single-modal recognition indicator. Multimodal fusion delivers obviously better recognition performance than the single-modal approach. The trimodal combination of EMG + HRV + eye movement acts as the optimal fusion scheme. The Logistic Regression model achieves a recognition accuracy of 91.4% and an average accuracy of 88.7%. It can judge firefighters' physical fatigue states efficiently and accurately.
papers.title_en: Analysis of firefighters' physical fatigue based on fusion of multimodal physiological indicators
papers.citation_text: 管浩森, 郑欣, 王焕. 基于多模态生理指标融合的消防员体力疲劳状态分析[J]. 中国安全科学学报, 2026, 36(9): 256. DOI: 10.16265/j.cnki.issn1003-3033.2026.09.0265.

papers.title: 基于改进SBR-YOLOv11n的受限空间火灾探测模型
papers.journal_publisher: 中国职业安全健康协会
papers.abstract: 针对受限空间火灾中火焰亮度低、目标小、易受干扰等问题,在YOLOv11n模型基础上,提出一种改进的受限空间火灾探测模型SBR-YOLOv11n。在骨干网络部分,将部分标准卷积层替换为空间深度转换卷积(SPDConv)层,解决模型在低亮度下火焰特征容易丢失的问题;在颈部网络部分,引入双向特征金字塔网络(BiFPN)模块,通过双向连接与可学习权重机制提升小目标火焰特征的融合效果;此外,采用倒置残差块注意力机制(iRMB),对动态火焰特征进行自适应加权,提高模型探测动态火焰的鲁棒性。结果表明:SBR-YOLOv11n模型各项评价指标达到最优,与YOLOv11n模型相比,精确率(P)、召回率(R)、平均精度均值(mAP@0.5和mAP@0.5:0.95)分别提升5.27%、3.81%、4.17%和3.03%,达到84.94%、83.83%、84.63%和62.97%,检测帧数(FPS)为75 帧/s。SBR-YOLOv11n模型满足受限空间火灾快速与精准探测需求,适用于受限空间火灾探测。
papers.abstract_en: Aiming at the problems of low flame brightness, small target and easy interference in confined space fires, an improved confined space fire detection model SBR-YOLOv11n was proposed based on YOLOv11n model. In the backbone network part, some standard convolution layers were replaced by Space to Depth Convolution (SPDConv) layers to solve the problem that the flame features were easy to lose under low brightness. In the neck network part, the Bidirectional Feature Pyramid Network (BiFPN) module was introduced to improve the fusion effect of small target flame features through bidirectional connections and learnable weight mechanisms. In addition, the Inverted Residual Mobile Block (iRMB) was used to adaptively weight the dynamic flame features to improve the robustness of the model to dynamic flame detection. Experimental results show that the SBR-YOLOv11n model has the best evaluation indexes. Compared with the YOLOv11n model, Precision (P), Recall (R), mean Average Precision (mAP@0.5) and mAP@0.5:0.95 are increase by 5.27 %, 3.81 %, 4.17 % and 3.03 % respectively, reaching 84.94 %, 83.83 %, 84.63 % and 62.97 %, with a detection speed of 75 Frames Per Second (FPS). The SBR-YOLOv11n model meets the needs of rapid and accurate fire detection in confined space and is suitable for fire detection in confined spaces.
papers.title_en: Fire detection model in confined space based on improved SBR-YOLOv11n
papers.citation_text: 李聪, 许文博, 滕文飞, 汪陈徽, 吴建松. 基于改进SBR-YOLOv11n的受限空间火灾探测模型[J]. 中国安全科学学报, 2026, 36(9): 263. DOI: 10.16265/j.cnki.issn1003-3033.2026.09.1007.

papers.title: 洪涝灾害“ 车辆-无人机-冲锋舟” 协同应急救援任务规划研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为解决洪涝灾害初期内部陆路失效、灾情信息不完备条件下的协同救援任务规划问题,提出“车辆-无人机-冲锋舟”两阶段协同应急救援任务规划方法。首先,以无人机扫描最大完工时间最小为目标,采用加权Voronoi 图划分扫描区域,以补偿车辆投送造成的无人机异步启动,并根据任务耗时标准差对区域权重进行调整;待无人机完成灾区扫描并获取完整可航行信息后,以水上救援完工时间最小为目标,构建需求可拆分、多趟次冲锋舟路径模型,并采用自适应大邻域搜索算法(adaptive large neighborhood search,ALNS)求解。研究结果表明:同控制点下,加权方案将无人机任务耗时标准差由0. 341 min 降至0. 007 min、极差由0. 808 min 降至0. 018 min;最大投送启动时差由8. 644 min 增至25. 933 min 时,普通Voronoi 图方案的任务耗时标准差增至6. 586 min,而加权方案保持在0. 006~0. 008 min。水上阶段资源增加呈边际收益递减,冲锋舟数量对救援效率饱和点的影响总体高于受灾点数量。研究结果可为洪涝灾害应急装备配置与任务调度提供定量参考。
papers.abstract_en: In order to address coordinated rescue mission planning under disrupted internal road access and incomplete disaster information in the early stage of flood disasters,a two-stage coordinated emergency rescue mission planning method integrating vehicles,unmanned aerial vehicles ( UAVs),and rescue boats is proposed. First,with the objective of minimizing the maximum UAV scanning completion time,a weighted Voronoi diagram is employed to partition the scanning area so as to compensate for asynchronous UAV deployment caused by vehicle delivery,while the regional weights are adjusted according to the standard deviation of mission duration. After the UAVs complete disaster-area scanning and obtain complete navigability information, a split-demand,multi-trip rescue-boat routing model is formulated to minimize the water-rescue completion time and is solved using an adaptive large neighborhood search (ALNS) algorithm. Results show that the weighted scheme reduces the UAV mission-time standard deviation from 0. 341 to 0. 007 min and the range from 0. 808 to 0. 018 min. When the maximum deployment-start gap increases from 8. 644 to 25. 933 min,the standard Voronoi deviation rises to 6. 586 min,whereas the weighted scheme remains at 0. 006-0. 008 min. Increasing water-rescue resources shows diminishing marginal benefits,and rescue-boat quantity has a greater overall influence on the rescue-efficiency saturation point than affected-site quantity. The method can provide quantitative support for emergency equipment allocation and mission scheduling in flood disasters.
papers.title_en: Research on vehicle-UAV-rescue-boat collaborative emergency rescue mission planning under flood disasters

papers.title: 割理及地应力对黔西煤层气水平井井壁稳定影响研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为进一步明确黔西地区煤层气水平井井壁稳定性的影响因素,基于离散元理论研究井筒方位、割理角度、割理密度、地应力对煤层气水平井井壁稳定性的影响。研究结果表明:随着割理角度增大,井壁稳定性先逐渐降低而后逐渐增强,破裂压力先减小后增大,割理角度对煤层破裂压力影响明显。随着割理密度逐渐增大,井壁稳定性逐渐变差,破裂压力逐渐减小,井壁越容易被压开。受割理影响,井周最大位移位置不对称,井周首先发生破坏的位置发生偏转。正断型地应力条件下,随着水平向地应力比值增大,井壁稳定性逐渐变好。走滑型地应力条件下,随着水平地应力比值的增大,井壁稳定性逐渐变差。研究结果可为黔西地区煤层气水平井安全高效钻井方案的制定提供参考。

papers.title: 盘扣式模板支架承载性能与失稳机制试验研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为明确盘扣式模板支架承载性能与失稳机制,保障现浇混凝土工程施工安全,通过开展立杆连接形式与斜杆布置方式对盘扣式模板支架承载性能的影响试验,揭示不同结构形式下架体失稳机理。以单跨两步盘扣式单元架为研究对象,设置6 种不同立杆连接与斜杆布置工况,开展竖向加载试验,系统对比分析各工况的失效模式、极限承载力、延性性能及应变分布特征。研究结果表明:盘扣式模板支架失效以立杆失稳破坏为主,水平杆与斜杆主要起约束立杆侧向变形的作用;立杆连接形式与斜杆布置方式对架体承载性能具有显著影响,采用对接立杆对称斜杆体系的架体承载性能最优;立杆连接套管可有效提升架体延性性能。研究结果可为盘扣式模板支架施工安全设计与安全评估提供参考。
papers.citation_text: 赵川, 张凌博, 孙宜松, 刘京红, 郭群录. 盘扣式模板支架承载性能与失稳机制试验研究[J]. 中国安全生产科学技术, 2026, 22(预出版): 1-7.

papers.title: 城市更新视角下地震薄弱区韧性评估研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为实现城市更新背景下地震薄弱区韧性的量化评估,采用贝叶斯网络(Bayesian network,BN)与韧性要素等级法结合的方法,构建多地震情景下融合建筑群损伤、人员伤亡和恢复时间的韧性评估框架,分析建筑群损伤及空间韧性特征,并以北京市某历史街区为例开展实证研究。研究结果表明:不同地震情景下建筑群损伤呈现明显非线性特征,空间分布表现为由西北向东南逐渐加重的规律;罕遇地震下,一星级韧性等级建筑占比约73%,三星级韧性等级建筑占比约3%,韧性等级分布与恢复时间等级具有较高一致性;相较于人员伤亡,恢复时间对整体韧性的影响更为显著。研究结果可为地震薄弱区更新改造中的韧性提升及防灾规划提供参考。

papers.title: 影响吹吸式通风系统捕集效率的关键参数的研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为提高平行流吹吸式通风系统对气载污染物的控制效果,采用实验测试与CFD数值模拟相结合的方法,研究吹吸流量 比、罩口间距及法兰宽度对捕集效率的影响规律。研究结果表明:吹吸流量比对系统捕集性能影响最为显著,当吹吸流量比K= 1.7时,系统捕集效率较高,且气流组织较为合理;罩口间距次之,当罩口间距比d/c=2时流场组织较为稳定且捕集效率较高;相 较于吹吸流量比与罩口间距,法兰宽度L影响较弱,L=0.14 m时可以有效削弱无效气流。研究结果可为平行流吹吸式通风系统 的优化设计提供参考。

papers.title: 安全观视域下安全工程人才培养演化路径研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为满足新时代国家安全和社会稳定对高素质、创新型安全工程人才的迫切需求,探索提出安全观视域下安全工程人才培养的演化路径。针对安全工程教育中当前存在的学科壁垒高、价值缺位与认知错位、价值理性与工具理性割裂等现实困境,构建以安全观为引领、以元素挖融为基础、以师生互馈为关键、以科研塑造为动力、以社会锻造为支撑、以实践反哺为落脚点的6级演化路径。研究结果表明:安全观引领可分解为国家立场、人民中心与系统思维3个维度; 元素挖融构建安全理论的4层递进结构,实现“价值—知识—技术—行动”的贯通; 师生互馈构建螺旋式互馈模型,提出过程性评价、360度互馈评价等方法; 科研塑造促进“价值传导链”与“能力提升链”融合,培养系统分析与问题解决能力; 社会锻造推动3重身份转变,构建“目标链—资源链—评价链”体系; 实践反哺破解“三脱节”困境,促进从理论到实践的闭环运行。研究结果可为推进新时代安全工程人才培养高质量发展提供理论思路与现实借鉴。

papers.title: 城市轨道交通运输能力与客流需求匹配性评价方法研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为识别城市轨道交通运输能力与客流需求不匹配引发的拥挤、滞留和局部过载风险,构建城市轨道交通供需匹配性综合评价方法。基于数量匹配性、质量匹配性和结构匹配性3个维度,从线路、换乘站和网络3个层次建立评价指标体系,选取能力利用率、满载率分布熵、拥挤度等指标表征供需匹配状态,采用乘法合成法计算综合匹配度,并对上海轨道交通开展实证分析。研究结果表明:高峰时段运能供需矛盾最为突出,线路层面表现为列车能力利用时空分布不均,换乘站层面表现为线间运力不协调与站台负荷偏高,网络层面表现为断面客流负载分布不均。研究结果可为城市轨道交通供需失衡识别、安全风险预警和运营组织优化提供方法支撑。

papers.title: 基于N-K-SNA的高原山区城市交通事故风险耦合分析
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为揭示高原山区城市轿车交通事故多风险因素耦合作用机理,识别关键风险因素,基于云南省2015—2023年231起事故案例,采用结构化内容编码方法提取人、车、路、环境4类20项风险因素,融合N-K风险耦合模型与社会网络分析(social network analysis,SNA)构建风险耦合分析框架,计算不同耦合类型风险值,并结合风险网络中心度与可达性对关键因素进行修正识别。研究结果表明:风险耦合值随参与因素数量增加而升高,四因素耦合值为0.056 98,高于三因素和双因素耦合值; 修正后陡坡路段为核心源头风险,高速行驶、恶劣天气、交叉路口、刹车疲软和弯曲路段等因素传导作用较强。研究结果可为高原山区城市轿车事故风险识别与精准防控提供参考。

papers.title: 基于初战需求的县域消防救援装备可达性研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为提升县域消防救援资源配置合理性,构建1种融合实时路况与初战消防装备需求的消防救援可达性分析模型。基于兴趣点与历史火灾数据确定消防救援需求点,匹配其最低消防装备需求,调用在线地图API仿真各消防站车辆至需求点的行程时间。以湖南省永州市某县为例,共获取813 585条数据。研究结果表明:区域总体消防救援装备可达性评分为52.97,但不同类型需求点差异显著。高层建筑可达性最佳(79.54分),数量最多的农村自建房可达性评分偏低(40.26分),加油加气/充电站和工厂评分最低。总体平均行程时间为1 128.74 s,按优、良、中、差等级划分,占比依次为14.75%,40.92%,25.81%,18.52%,可达性呈现显著昼夜周期性波动,早晚交通高峰期明显下降。研究结果可为消防救援装备空间配置的优化提供参考。

papers.title: 高密度医疗空间疏散瓶颈识别与优化策略研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为提升高密度医疗空间在突发事件下的安全韧性与疏散效率,利用AnyLogic平台开展数值模拟,探索空间拓扑与个体协同行为对疏散动力学的耦合影响。以南京鼓楼医院急诊科为建模对象,考虑复杂人群特征并引入非匀速社会力算法与群体互助协作逻辑构建高保真疏散模型。通过时空热力图动态识别拥堵演化区域,并定量分析通道宽度与互助行为概率对整体疏散效率的影响机制。研究结果表明:中央出口宽度从2.8 m优化至4.0 m时产生非线性流量增益,能有效缓解结构性拥堵瓶颈; 敏感度分析发现,互助概率的区间约为0.4～0.6时是实现弱势群体保护与系统疏散能效的最优配置。研究结果提出的空间改造和行为干预双维度策略,可为医院急诊科应急疏散方案的优化提供科学参考。

papers.title: 面向家庭应急场景的物资储备推荐研究

papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为解决家庭应急物资储备信息不对称与供需不匹配的突出问题,提升家庭应急场景下物资储备的响应能力与配置效率,提出1种面向家庭应急场景的物资储备推荐方法。首先,通过家庭应急场景要素分析,构建融合突发事件、场景数据、应急任务、应急产业多维关系的知识图谱; 其次,在此基础上提出考虑家庭特征和个性化网页排名的改进推荐算法,实现对家庭应急场景数据的物资偏好推荐; 最后,设计1个家庭应急物资储备推荐系统,并以家庭火灾为例验证改进算法的可行性。研究结果表明:相较于基准算法,引入家庭特征后的推荐结果更符合家庭应急场景下的实际需求。研究结果可为面向家庭的应急物资储备决策提供参考。

papers.abstract: 针对震后应急药品配送中设施容量动态衰减、多目标冲突及需求紧迫度差异大等问题,提出1种卡车-无人机协同的应急选址-路径优化方法。构建动态紧迫度评价体系,引入余震风险指数与药品到达反馈因子,实现紧迫度实时修正; 建立以经济性、公平性、风险性最小化为目标的多目标优化模型,考虑配送中心容量动态衰减等约束; 设计混合多策略大邻域搜索算法(HMS-LNS); 以2025年西藏定日6.8级地震为背景进行算例分析。研究结果表明:动态方案较静态方案经济性指标降低0.125%,公平性指标降低17.82%,风险性指标降低0.65%; HMS-LNS最优解为30 302.55,标准差为2.28,优于ACO、禁忌搜索、NSGA-Ⅱ、ALNS等算法; 参数敏感性分析验证算法稳定性,标准函数测试显示求解精度较ALNS、DE、PSO、GA等提升2～6个数量级。研究结果可为震后应急药品高效配送提供决策支持。

papers.title: 基于三维模型的应急管理信息化标准体系成熟度评估与实证研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为科学评估我国应急管理信息化标准体系的成熟度水平并识别体系结构性短板,基于国内外应急管理标准化研究现状与实践经验,凝练出治理协同困境、互操作性断层、成熟度发展失衡、实施效能评估缺失4大核心问题,构建“结构维度-分析维度-实证维度”三维研究模型,采用层次分析法(analytic hierarchy process,AHP)确定指标权重,融合极差归一化法建立成熟度评估模型,以某省应急管理综合应用平台为验证载体开展模型有效性检验。研究结果表明:该平台标准体系成熟度等级为集成级(62.45分),实施效能校验结果(良效,71.06分)与成熟度评价高度一致,验证了评估模型的可靠性,但标准布局不均衡、跨部门数据共享存在断层、跨部门统筹协同机制薄弱等问题依然存在,实证结论与理论归纳的4大核心问题高度吻合。研究结果可为应急管理信息化标准体系的量化诊断、短板溯源及优化路径构建以及跨部门应急标准化治理工作提供参考。

papers.title: 智慧城市建设对城市灾害应急能力的影响研究——基于174 个城市的实证检验
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为探究智慧城市建设是否影响城市灾害应急能力,基于我国2007—2019年174个地级市的面板数据,利用双重差分法(DID)评估智慧城市建设对城市灾害应急能力的政策效应。研究结果表明:智慧城市建设显著促进城市灾害应急能力的发展,对临灾预警能力、灾中处置能力、灾后恢复能力的影响显著为正,对灾前准备能力则无显著影响; 智慧城市建设可通过技术创新提升城市灾害应急能力; 相较于西部和科教水平较高城市,智慧城市建设对东部、中部以及科教发展水平较低城市的影响更为显著。研究结果可为因地制宜推进智慧城市建设与应急管理融合、提升城市灾害应急管理效能提供理论参考。

papers.title: 暴雨内涝情景下应急医疗设施可达性时空演化研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为研究暴雨内涝情境下医疗急救设施可达性的空间响应特征,基于InfoWork集成汇流模型(InfoWorks ICM)、增强型两步移动搜索法(E2SFCA)与时空立方体模型(STC),提出了“内涝-路网-医疗”动态耦合评估框架的方法,研究1～100 a暴雨重现期情景下医疗急救可达性的时空变化。研究结果表明:医疗可达性随降雨强度增强呈非线性下降,当暴雨重现期达到50 a及以上时,路网功能退化进一步加剧,医疗可达性下降速率由0.38%/a增至1.20%/a(R2=0.97); 空间上,中心城区路网密集区可达性降幅为12.6%,外围低洼区降幅为37.8%,东部区域形成连片低可达性区域; 道路等级优先策略在修复10%受损路段后,其可达性恢复效率较故障类型优先策略提升约18.7%。研究结果可为城市内涝防灾规划、应急医疗资源优化配置及道路应急保障提供量化分析依据和技术支撑。

papers.title: 面向城市交通应急的空地协同路径寻优技术研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为更有效利用已有交通组织条件完成城市交通应急诱导,借助低空视角连通域与形态学分割物体图像检测技术对道路交通流进行协同全时捕捉和应急能力分析,生成空地协同寻优算法(A-GCO)。A-GCO提出路段容量饱和度阈值概念作为应急通行判定标准,构建基于路网自然绿波寻优算法模型,实现城市道路应急保障需求。以Z市某区域为例,提取路网几何信息并初选潜在的7条通行路径,通过路段容量分析、区域节点自然绿波寻优分析。研究结果表明:A-GCO算法选出最短用时路径3(用时237 s),Dijkstra算法、改进Dijkstra算法寻优结果均为路径7(用时245 s),A-GCO算法在路径寻优效果上更具可靠性和稳定性。研究结果可为现代城市数字交通应急响应提供建设思路。

papers.title: 受限姿势下电缆沟检修人员疲劳特征与风险分级研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为评估电缆沟检修人员在受限姿势下的疲劳状态,以半跪姿和全蹲姿下电缆剥皮为典型工况,采集32名检修人员的心电(electrocardiogram,ECG)和表面肌电(surface electromyogram,sEMG)信号,筛选7项核心生理特征,构建全局响应量FG、肌群疲劳度Fm、肌群过载量Om、肌群过载构成比Pm、肌群过载构成主导度Dp和疲劳残余率Rres等状态参数,并建立低、中、高3级疲劳风险分级。研究结果表明:2种姿势均可引起FG升高,全蹲姿FG高于半跪姿,且中后期累积更明显,右侧冈下肌和股四头肌为主要过载肌群,全蹲姿更易形成右侧冈下肌与股四头肌的多肌群并发过载。半跪姿的过载构成则由早期股四头肌占优逐渐转为右侧冈下肌占优; 短时恢复后检修人员仍存在整体和局部疲劳残余。在风险分级方面,所确定阈值具有较好的稳定性,相邻等级区分明确。跨受试者验证及Borg的自觉疲劳分级量表(rating of perceived exertion,RPE)外部参照结果表明,所建疲劳状态参数体系能够反映不同姿势下的疲劳程度、主要过载肌群及恢复状态。研究结果可为电缆沟检修人员的疲劳预警、姿势调整和休息安排提供量化参考。
papers.citation_text: 单雪垠, 刘振国, 李晓光, 于海, 王建. 受限姿势下电缆沟检修人员疲劳特征与风险分级研究[J]. 中国安全生产科学技术, 2026, 22(9): 121-129. DOI: 10.11731/j.issn.1673-193x.2026.09.015.

papers.title: 我国医疗卫生机构安全生产法规标准体系结构特征及优化路径研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为分析我国医疗卫生机构安全生产法规标准体系结构特征及存在问题,采用统计分析方法研究医疗卫生机构安全生产法规标准的层级结构、领域分布和技术标准体系特征,通过层次分析法(AHP)与模糊综合评价相结合的方法,构建法规标准体系成熟度评价模型,并提出优化路径。研究结果表明:我国已形成以《中华人民共和国安全生产法》为核心、行政法规和部门规章为支撑、技术标准为保障的多层级法规标准体系; 层次分析法—模糊综合评价模型结果显示,我国医疗卫生机构安全生产法规标准体系总体处于基本成熟阶段,但法规协调性、专门化技术标准建设及动态更新能力仍有待提升。研究结果可为医疗卫生机构安全生产法规标准体系优化提供科学参考。

papers.title: 燃料类型和燃烧尺寸对电缆隧道温度与烟气分布影响研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为研究地下电缆隧道内液体火灾的燃烧特性,建立缩尺寸FDS电缆隧道模型,通过改变油池直径和燃料类型,开展隧道油池火火灾数值模拟研究。基于模拟结果,分析火羽流纵向温度、隧道顶棚温度和典型气体体积分数(O2,CO)的分布变化情况。研究结果表明:在稳定燃烧阶段,正庚烷池火的火羽流纵向平均温度和隧道顶棚平均温度整体高于柴油池火。油池直径较大时,火羽流纵向平均温度随测点高度增加出现先上升后下降的趋势。正庚烷和柴油池火的顶棚平均温度差与油池直径呈正相关。t=400 s时,在顶棚气体体积分数与油池直径关系曲线中,随油池直径增大,各测点曲线间的相对间距有增大趋势,且正庚烷池火较柴油池火增大趋势更明显。正庚烷池火纵截面的高温区域明显大于柴油池火高温区域。当油池直径增大到0.6 m时,油池火纵截面的高温区域均明显扩大,此时离隧道顶棚最近的2层电缆桥架均处于300 ℃及以上的温度范围,电缆被引燃的风险高。研究结果可为地下电缆隧道的消防设计和应急救援提供参考。

papers.title: 基于YOLOv12-ASFM 的基建核电站非常规视域火灾风险自适应监测技术研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为解决高湿、强光反射及多尺度动态目标并存条件下传统目标监测算法易出现误判、漏判,以及烟雾与水雾混淆、安全帽反光和车辆灯光易被误判为火源等问题,提高基建核电站复杂施工场景下火灾风险监测的准确性,提出1种面向非常规视域的火灾风险自适应监测方法。基于实际核电站施工现场构建包含12 479张图像的多场景数据集,涵盖火源、烟雾、水雾、施工人员、安全帽、机械设备及车辆灯光等7类目标; 以YOLOv12为基线模型,引入自主设计的自适应场景感知特征调制模块(adaptive scene-aware feature modulation,ASFM),通过对中间特征进行场景相关性动态调制,增强复杂施工环境下关键风险目标的特征表达能力,并采用Inner-IoU损失函数优化边界框回归,提高小目标及重叠目标的定位精度。研究结果表明:YOLOv12-ASFM模型的精确率(P)、召回率(R)、mAP@0.5和mAP@0.5:0.95分别达到83.4%,77.3%,81.3%和54.6%,较基线模型YOLOv12分别提高18.7,23.7,20.7和19.4百分点。所提方法能够增强复杂施工环境下火源和烟雾的识别能力,减少水雾、反光及车辆灯光等干扰因素引起的误判。研究结果可为基建核电站施工现场火灾风险智能监测与预警提供技术参考。

papers.title: 基于模糊贝叶斯网络的飞机货舱火灾误报事件影响因素分析
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为识别飞机货舱火灾探测系统误报的关键影响因素,优化探测系统参数与运行维护策略,降低误报导致的运行风险及经济损失,本文基于2002—2025年飞机货舱火灾误报事件数据,分析误报发生原因,结合事故树分析与模糊贝叶斯网络构建货舱火灾误报影响因素分析框架,并采用后验概率推理与敏感性分析方法识别关键风险因素。研究结果表明:高湿/冷凝水、维护不当、超寿命未更换、电路故障及探测器布局不合理是导致飞机货舱火灾误报的主要影响因素,其中维护不当和超寿命未更换对误报风险的影响最为明显,后验概率分别为3.71%和2.43%,据此提出相应的风险防控措施。研究结果可为飞机货舱火灾误报风险评估与防控提供理论支撑,为提升飞机火灾探测系统可靠性及民航运行安全水平提供参考。

papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为应对应急通信场景下无人机集群面临的恶意干扰与通信链路间歇中断问题,保障异步拒绝服务攻击(asynchronous denial-of-service,DoS)下的协同安全性,提出基于分布式动态事件触发机制的鲁棒协同控制方案。该方法不依赖邻居连续状态信息或全局拉普拉斯矩阵特征值,通过设计动态触发阈值与异步攻击适配控制器,有效节省通信资源并增强系统抗攻击能力,并通过仿真验证该方法在模拟应急通信恶劣条件下的有效性与鲁棒性。研究结果表明:所设计控制器能够保证闭环系统渐近稳定,在DoS下实现无人机集群的弹性协同,同时严格排除芝诺行为。研究结果可为复杂通信环境下无人机集群的安全协同控制提供理论参考。

papers.title: 多阶段密实充填协同承载机制及围岩变形规律研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为探明“三下”压煤密实充填中“煤柱-充填体”置换的协同承载机理及围岩变形规律,采用理论解析、数值模拟与现场实测相结合的方法,研究四阶段回采覆岩内力演化,利用FLAC3D揭示多轮次采充扰动下应力迁移与塑性区演化时空特征,并依托工程背景进行监测验证。研究结果表明:协同承载的本质是恒定载荷在变刚度地基上的动态分配; 置换的第3阶段为危险期,煤柱垂直应力集中系数达1.80,诱发15 m范围内剪切塑性区贯通; 第4阶段置换后系统均质化重构,覆岩最大沉降245.57 mm。实测验证了围岩变形呈“微扰-激增-趋稳”演化路径,印证了第3阶段剧烈的矿压显现。研究结果可为绿色开采中围岩的精准控制提供参考。

papers.title: 基于非迭代Green-FOSM方法的隧道围岩空间变异性随机场模拟与稳定性分析
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为了表征隧道穿越高位岩质顺层地层时围岩力学参数的空间变异性并量化其不确定性,解决顺层板岩在强降雨作用下参数变异导致的收敛性问题。提出1种改进的非迭代Green-FOSM方法,通过构建关联节点位移与应变的矩阵避免迭代,并将该方法应用于强降雨入渗与排水2种工况下的结构稳定性分析。研究结果表明:非迭代版本的计算速度较原迭代方法最高提升200倍,可处理超过10 000个随机变量(原方法上限为3 000); 所得位移与应变统计结果与蒙特卡洛模拟高度吻合,耗时仅为后者的1/50; 考虑参数空间变异性后,关键场量较确定性计算结果波动幅度达±30.6%。研究结果可为隧道穿越复杂地层时的围岩稳定性评估及支护设计提供参考。

papers.title: 软岩影响下岩层变形行为与钻井套管剪切应力分布特性
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为探明采动影响下软岩对岩层变形行为及地面钻井套管剪切受力的影响规律,采用硬-软-硬复合岩体单轴压缩实验与宏观采动数值模拟相结合的方法,探讨软岩抗压强度与厚度对层间剪切滑移行为的作用机制,并研究了采动应力场下软岩区域钻井套管最大剪切力的演化特征。研究结果表明:复合岩体变形经历压实、软岩膨胀和层间滑移3阶段,低厚度试样因塑性带受限表现出特有的脆性破坏特征; 层间滑移量随软岩强度增加呈线性减小,随厚度增加突破空间限制阈值后呈非线性突增; 受层间刚度差异影响,套管最大剪应力随软岩体积模量增加呈指数规律迅速衰减,随厚度增加而持续增大。研究结果可为瓦斯抽采井穿越软弱夹层段的井身结构优化提供力学理论与量化设计指导。
