papers.title: 基于修正水力边界的水下泥水盾构开挖面支护压力下限研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为解决水下泥水盾构开挖面失稳风险控制研究中,现有计算方法因简化水力边界条件而导致结果偏差的问题,依托江阴靖江长江隧道工程,基于极限分析上限法,构建考虑实际水力边界及地层特征的开挖面旋转破坏机制模型。该模型依据有效应力原理,通过修正地下水做功功率项,摒弃与实际工况不符的开挖面自由排水假设,同时将计算结果与现有理论方法所得结果及工程实测数据对比分析。研究结果表明:本文所建模型有效克服自由排水假设偏差及主动土压力理论计算结果偏于危险的局限,所得临界值可合理界定现场实测泥水压力的安全裕度。研究结果可为软弱富水地层泥水盾构开挖面支护压力下限的设定提供量化依据。
papers.citation_text: 田亮, 霍梦喆, 夏元友. 基于修正水力边界的水下泥水盾构开挖面支护压力下限研究[J]. 中国安全生产科学技术, 2026, 22(9): 47-54. DOI: 10.11731/j.issn.1673-193x.2026.09.006.

papers.title: 不同加载速率下煤样力学特性、破坏模式及能量演化规律研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为揭示加载速率对煤样力学响应及能量演化的调控机制,以某矿3号煤层中等变质焦煤为研究对象,开展0.05,0.1,0.5,1.0,5.0 mm/min 5种加载速率下的煤样单轴压缩试验,分析加载速率对煤样力学特性、破坏模式及能量演化规律的影响。研究结果表明:随加载速率提升,煤样应力-应变曲线压密、屈服阶段缩短,弹性变形特征更突出,峰后脆性破坏特性加剧,呈现由延性向脆性破坏转变的规律; 煤样峰值强度、弹性模量随加载速率升高整体增大,峰值应变呈降低趋势。高加载速率条件下煤样储能性能更优,破坏瞬间能量集中释放,耗散能显著增大。宏观破坏模式随加载速率提升,由低速加载下的多裂纹弥散延性破碎,转变为高速加载下的单主裂纹突发脆性劈裂破坏。研究结果可为深部巷道差异化支护设计、合理采掘速率选取及冲击地压防控提供参考。
papers.citation_text: 车禹恒. 不同加载速率下煤样力学特性、破坏模式及能量演化规律研究[J]. 中国安全生产科学技术, 2026, 22(9): 40-46. DOI: 10.11731/j.issn.1673-193x.2026.09.005.

papers.title: 多级单轴循环荷载条件下砂岩和花岗闪长岩的力学特征
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为揭示软岩与硬岩在循环荷载作用下的变形响应及疲劳损伤差异,以细粒砂岩和弱蚀变花岗闪长岩为研究对象,开展不同最大应力水平、应力幅值和加载频率条件下的多级单轴循环压缩试验,并结合超声波波速测试分析岩石损伤演化特征。研究结果表明:砂岩应力-应变滞回环呈“松散-致密-松散”3阶段演化特征,而花岗闪长岩主要表现为“致密-松散”两阶段模式; 最大应力水平和应力幅值增大均会加快残余应变累积,缩短疲劳寿命,且横向残余应变增长速率高于轴向残余应变增长速率; 低频加载条件下岩石微裂纹具有更充分的扩展时间,损伤发展更快,疲劳寿命更短; 循环加载后P波和S波波速均不同程度下降,表明超声波波速可用于表征循环荷载下岩石损伤累积过程。2类岩石在循环荷载作用下的破坏模式与单调加载条件下的破坏模式存在差异,并受应力水平、应力幅值和加载频率共同控制。研究结果可为不同岩性岩石工程在循环扰动作用下的疲劳损伤评价提供参考。
papers.citation_text: 张洪涛, 王进波, 杨晓伟, 李艳杰. 多级单轴循环荷载条件下砂岩和花岗闪长岩的力学特征[J]. 中国安全生产科学技术, 2026, 22(9): 30-39. DOI: 10.11731/j.issn.1673-193x.2026.09.004.

papers.title: 预热煤体在不同液氮冻结时间下微观特征研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为研究液氮冻结作用对煤体微观孔隙结构的影响,选取不同初始温度的煤样在液氮中溶浸不同时间,采用核磁共振(nuclear magnetic resonance,NMR)技术测量煤样溶浸前后的孔隙信号强度,分析其孔隙发育状况。研究结果表明:随着煤样初始温度升高及冻结时间延长,孔隙信号强度增强,吸附孔比例下降,渗流孔比例上升,孔隙连通性有效改善; 煤样的总孔隙度、残余孔隙度、有效孔隙度及其占比均随初始温度升高和冻结时间延长而增大,但残余孔隙度占比和T2截止值下降; 经Coates渗透率模型计算,液氮冻结处理后煤样渗透率显著提高,且初始温度越高、冻结时间越长,渗透率提升越明显。研究结果可为揭示液氮致裂煤体的微观损伤演化机理及建立宏观渗透率与微观孔隙参数的定量关系模型提供参考。
papers.citation_text: 王晓琪, 李龑斐, 张闯, 马恒, 王东莳, 董建军. 预热煤体在不同液氮冻结时间下微观特征研究[J]. 中国安全生产科学技术, 2026, 22(9): 22-29. DOI: 10.11731/j.issn.1673-193x.2026.09.003.

papers.title: 高海拔螺旋瓦斯隧道最小施工通风量计算模型研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为明确高海拔螺旋瓦斯隧道施工过程中瓦斯扩散运移特征及最小通风需求,分析曲率半径、海拔高度、瓦斯涌出量及风管参数对隧道瓦斯体积分数分布的影响。基于计算流体力学方法建立高海拔螺旋瓦斯隧道施工通风数值模型,采用多工况数值模拟、正交试验和多元线性回归方法,研究瓦斯运移规律,并构建最小施工通风量预测模型。研究结果表明:瓦斯体积分数沿远离掌子面方向呈先降低后回升并趋于稳定的变化特征; 随着曲率半径增大,隧道内涡流数量及影响范围减小,瓦斯更易稀释排出; 海拔高度H升高会显著增大瓦斯体积分数,H=5 km时稳定体积分数约为H=0 km时的1.69倍; 随着瓦斯涌出量增大,瓦斯体积分数达到稳定所需扩散距离由5 m增至25 m; 风管风速V对瓦斯体积分数影响最显著,其次为风管直径,V=7 m/s时稳定体积分数约为V=27 m/s时的3.64倍。基于曲率半径、海拔高度、瓦斯涌出量和风管风速建立的最小施工通风量计算模型,可计算最大瓦斯体积分数不超过0.5%时所需的最小供风量。研究结果可为高海拔螺旋瓦斯隧道施工通风参数设计和瓦斯安全控制提供定量参考。
papers.citation_text: 李琦, 曹宇翔, 唐玉秋, 雷朋, 李敏. 高海拔螺旋瓦斯隧道最小施工通风量计算模型研究[J]. 中国安全生产科学技术, 2026, 22(9): 12-21. DOI: 10.11731/j.issn.1673-193x.2026.09.002.

papers.title: 顺层钻孔孔周瓦斯渗流特性及有效抽采半径随时间演化规律研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为解决煤矿顺层钻孔瓦斯抽采中有效抽采半径难以精确测定、布孔缺乏理论支撑的工程难题,以山西某矿8号煤层瓦斯抽采为工程背景,采用抽采量法与数值模拟相结合的方法,开展孔周煤体瓦斯渗流特性研究,确定不同预抽时间下的有效抽采半径。研究结果表明:在孔径113 mm、抽采负压不低于13 kPa的条件下,有效抽采半径1.0,1.5,2.0 m的预抽时间为30,50,60 d; 有效抽采半径随抽采时间呈现对数函数增长关系,数值模拟与实测结果吻合良好; 揭示孔周煤体瓦斯渗流特性及有效抽采半径随时间的变化规律。研究结果可为顺层钻孔的优化布置提供理论支撑与工程指导。
papers.citation_text: 范鹏程, 杨硕, 胡通, 马钰琛, 温志辉. 顺层钻孔孔周瓦斯渗流特性及有效抽采半径随时间演化规律研究[J]. 中国安全生产科学技术, 2026, 22(9): 5-11. DOI: 10.11731/j.issn.1673-193x.2026.09.001.

papers.title: 不同变质程度煤孔隙及表面微结构特征测试与分析
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为揭示不同变质程度煤的孔隙结构及表面微观结构演化规律,选取褐煤、烟煤和无烟煤为研究对象,采用低温液氮吸附、傅里叶变换红外光谱(FTIR)及固体13C核磁共振(13C-NMR)测试技术,分析孔隙结构、官能团及碳骨架特征与煤样变质程度的关联。研究结果表明:随煤变质程度升高,孔隙结构由中小孔主导向微孔主导转变,孔隙形态由开放向半封闭—封闭结构演化; 含氧官能团和脂肪结构逐渐减少,芳香结构缩合程度提高; 孔隙结构参数与表面官能团及碳骨架结构参数表现出一致的演化趋势,表明煤化过程中孔隙细化、封闭化与芳香结构缩聚、脂肪侧链脱除及含氧官能团减少之间具有协同演化特征。研究结果可为深入认识煤微观结构演化机制及煤层瓦斯赋存与运移规律提供理论参考。
papers.citation_text: 潘丽萍, 赵延霞, 杨硕, 温志辉. 不同变质程度煤孔隙及表面微结构特征测试与分析[J]. 中国安全生产科学技术, 2026, 22(10): 5-12. DOI: 10.11731/j.issn.1673-193x.2026.10.001.

papers.title: 化学品泄漏事故现场应变程序
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术

papers.abstract: 目的:通过对华东、东北、华北、西南4个地区4个省市的1个地方国有集团公司、16个地方国有煤矿的调查,了解我国地方国有煤矿的职业危害现状。方法:通过现场调查的方法,抽取4个省市的1个地方国有集团公司16个地方国有煤矿,对其职业危害防治管理、职业危害监测、职业危害防护及健康监护等方面进行调查。结果:被调查的地方国有煤矿47.06%有职业危害防治领导机构;采煤工作面总尘浓度平均超标10.7倍,呼尘浓度平均超标4.6倍;职业健康监护岗前体检100%,离岗体检为0,专家抽检尘肺病检出率5.12%。结论:我国地方国有煤矿职业危害防治管理水平参差不齐,作业场所粉尘浓度超标,尘肺病危害比较严重。

papers.title: Real-Time Visibility Enhancement in Fire Scenes Using Edge-Guided Physical Smoke Removal
papers.abstract: The degradation of visibility caused by fire and smoke severely hinders surveillance, leading to delayed decision-making and rescue operations during disasters. Existing smoke and haze removal approaches often struggle with dynamic lighting, heavy smoke, and real-time processing requirements, as they either rely on physical models or deep learning (DL) methods. The enhanced images thus suffer from loss of edge details and over-enhancement in some cases. To address these difficulties, a novel Dark Channel Edge Enhancement Pipeline with CLAHE Fusion (DEEP-CF), a hybrid framework that integrates physics-based and edge-preserving enhancement methods through a multi-stage fusion, is proposed. DEEP-CF uses luminance-based dark channel estimation, edge-aware guided filtering, adaptive rescaling, and dual-stage fusion with CLAHE to enhance both contrast and structure. The implementation ensures real-time performance by leveraging GPUs and achieves up to 44 FPS on 640x480 resolution video streams. Qualitative and quantitative evaluation on the ’Indoor Fire Smoke Dataset’ and real-world scenes demonstrate competitive perceptual quality, smoke intensity reduction, and structural and edge detail preservation compared to other traditional models and improved downstream object detection performance. The results on the evaluation metrics of BIQME, BRISQUE, NIQE, CFI, PSNR, SSIM, EPI, and VIF establish the proposed DEEP-CF pipeline as a favorable perceptual quality enhancer and a computationally efficient, balanced solution for visibility enhancement in dynamic fire and smoke scenes.

papers.title: 甲烷-氢气混合射流火焰燃烧特性试验研究
papers.abstract: 在“双碳”目标背景下，掺氢天然气输送技术已成为能源结构调整的重要研究方向。通过试验探究了甲烷-氢气混合气体的燃烧特性，重点分析了不同掺氢比例对射流火焰温度、尺寸及燃烧时间的影响规律。使用电火花点燃不同体积分数的甲烷与氢气混合气，利用多通道火焰捕捉相机进行记录。结果表明：体积分数为5%～30%的氢气掺入使火焰最高温度从992.0℃提高至1 021℃,提升了3.0%;氢气体积分数增加至80%和100%时，火焰温度明显增高；甲烷体积分数为80%时，稳定燃烧阶段平均火焰高度峰值为44.39 cm;氢气体积分数的增加能够缩短燃烧时间；纯甲烷火焰前期呈现蓝色，后期呈现橙红色，而随着氢气体积分数的增加混合气体火焰颜色逐步由蓝变红。研究结果可为天然气掺氢输送优化设计提供试验数据参考。
papers.citation_text: 沙海伟, 韩倩倩. 甲烷-氢气混合射流火焰燃烧特性试验研究[J]. 安全与环境学报, 2026, 26(6). DOI: 10.13637/j.issn.1009-6094.2025.0996.

papers.title: 天然气喷射火致并行管道失效的热力机制与安全阈值研究
papers.abstract: 针对天然气管道泄漏燃烧对并行管道的影响和破坏问题，基于小孔泄漏和多物理场耦合理论建立并行管道燃烧流场和管道模型，通过Fluent软件进行模拟仿真分析。通过改变并行间距及并行管道壁厚、管径和管输压力，模拟分析不同因素下管道最大等效应力的变化趋势和屈服压力安全值，再对4种因素的影响结果进行敏感性分析。结果表明：为防止并行管道失效，管道间距应保持4.62 m及以上，管道壁厚需保持在27.48 mm及以上，管径需控制在648.5 mm及以下，管输压力需保持在9.96 MPa及以下。影响因素影响度从高到低依次为并行间距、壁厚、管径及管输压力。从输气管道安全性的角度来讲，并行管道敷设应该优先考虑增加并行间距，其次为增加管道壁厚和减小管径，最后可以适当地减小管输压力。

papers.title: 电动汽车全尺寸火灾蔓延特性试验及模拟研究
papers.abstract: 电动汽车火灾安全问题日益凸显，起火后蔓延路径尚不明晰。为此，通过试验和数值模拟研究了外部过热条件下电动汽车火灾燃烧特性及蔓延路径。结果表明，电池包起火后会出现拉弧现象，且早期动力电池热失控及底盘塑料部件熔融滴落形成的油池火标志着整车火灾进入了加速发展阶段，火灾蔓延路径主要是电池包—后轮—前轮—乘客舱—后备箱—前引擎舱。基于试验数据，利用火灾动力学仿真软件搭建了全尺寸电动汽车模型，数值模拟结果与试验结果吻合较好。整车峰值热释放速率为7.88 MW,可近似模拟70 kWh左右的整车火灾。研究结果有助于充分理解电动汽车火灾发展过程，相关试验数据及数值模型可为后续充电站火灾特性研究提供数据支持及参考。

papers.title: 基于视觉的航空医学应急救援心肺复苏操作姿态评价算法
papers.abstract: 我国的航空医学应急救援人才短缺，航空医学应急救援训练装备落后。针对航空医学应急救援模拟训练关键问题，即心肺复苏(Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation, CPR)按压动作识别精度低，提出一种基于视觉的训练操作姿态识别模型。通过人体姿态关键点提取，并进行时域均值填充和平滑处理，完成数据预处理，之后提出训练姿态识别模型，进行心肺复苏按压姿态识别。该模型在双向门控循环单元(Bi-directional Gated Recurrent Unit, BiGRU)网络基础上加入卷积神经网络(Convolutional Neural Network, CNN),并添加注意力机制，使模型更关注动作本身，减小动态环境等因素的干扰。试验结果表明，此模型的姿态识别准确率达到93%,高于其他模型，可以满足需求。

papers.title: 暴雨灾害下长输管道风险因子的双阶皮尔逊筛选方法
papers.abstract: 暴雨天气下构建科学有效的长输管道受灾风险因子体系，对风险诊断与预测具有重要意义。针对相关研究的不足，设计了双阶皮尔逊关联的风险因子筛选方法。在初选阶段，采用皮尔逊相关矩阵和变异系数双重准则，降低候选风险因子间信息冗余，形成初选风险因子体系；在终选阶段，设计信息冗余贡献度算法，循环计算初选风险因子的信息冗余贡献度指数，筛选对整体相关性贡献较小的风险因子，构建终选风险因子体系。为验证方法的有效性，选取K-中心和K-均值聚类算法对比。结果表明：所提方法的风险因子信息解释强度为1.033,累计信息贡献率达89.9%,显著高于K-中心聚类算法(1.007,51.2%)和K-均值聚类算法(1.057,53.7%)。该方法可为暴雨天气下长输管道风险预测与预警提供有力支持。
papers.citation_text: 黄星, 周鸿娇. 暴雨灾害下长输管道风险因子的双阶皮尔逊筛选方法[J]. 安全与环境学报, 2026, 26(6). DOI: 10.13637/j.issn.1009-6094.2025.1057.

papers.title: 台风暴雨诱发滑坡-泥石流发生时序研究
papers.abstract: 在全球气候变化导致台风频率和强度增加的背景下，我国东南沿海地区台风极端降雨诱发的地质灾害问题愈加突出。台风暴雨引发的滑坡、泥石流灾害常以灾害链的形式出现，但二者之间的发生时序及影响机制尚未被系统认识和量化分析。以2019年台风“利奇马”在浙江省岛石镇某典型小流域内引发的滑坡-泥石流灾害链为研究对象，在野外调查和室内渗透试验的基础上，通过构建台风暴雨入渗-产流-斜坡稳定性分析时序模型，得出了不同斜坡结构参数组合下的坡体稳定性演化规律和小流域内滑坡-泥石流的发生时序及斜坡失稳机制。结果显示，台风暴雨作用下研究流域内滑坡与泥石流的发生在时序上存在紧密联系，形成了“滑坡坡体饱和—水力侵蚀—泥石流”和“泥石流流动—沟道侵蚀—滑坡”2种链生灾害模式。该研究结果对于全球变化影响下我国东南沿海地区的地质灾害风险早期预警、风险评价与预测预报具有参考价值。

papers.title: 重庆市坡面型泥石流发育分布规律及成因机制
papers.abstract: 坡面型泥石流具有突发性和群发性，极端降雨条件下可造成严重的人员伤亡与财产损失。为厘清重庆市坡面型泥石流的发育分布规律及成因机制，以重庆近20年来7次具有代表性的区域暴雨事件为研究对象，基于历史高分辨率遥感影像解译获得401处典型坡面型泥石流样本，结合统计分析、沟道形态识别与斜坡地貌过程分析，系统研究其空间分布特征、易发沟道类型及形成演化过程。结果表明：重庆市坡面型泥石流多发育于坡面切沟和小型冲沟内，其形成受降雨、地形坡度和覆盖层物质条件共同控制；强降雨诱发的地表暴流与壤中暴流为坡面型泥石流启动提供主要水动力，陡峭坡度促进势能向动能转化，高渗透性浅层覆盖物经软化、冲刷和快速侵蚀后成为主要物源；植被林冠截留和根系加固总体上对坡面型泥石流的形成具有抑制作用。研究成果可为重庆市坡面型泥石流早期识别、风险区划、监测预警和防治工程部署提供参考。

papers.title: 走滑断层活动性对坪定—化马断裂带滑坡空间分布的影响
papers.abstract: 青藏高原东北缘构造运动活跃，发育大量活动断裂带，断裂带内滑坡呈明显聚集性分布，且近年来复活成灾频繁。由于走滑断层不同区段的蠕滑活动性难以区分，鲜有研究定量探讨断层蠕滑活动性与断裂带内滑坡空间发育的关系。以青藏高原东北缘坪定—化马活动断裂带为例，综合运用水系形态分析、光学遥感影像目视解译与合成孔径雷达干涉测量技术，分析了断裂带不同区段断层活动性对历史滑坡及活动滑坡空间发育的影响。结果表明：坪定—化马断裂带活动性自西北向东南逐渐增强，据此将断层划分为锁固段、过渡段和蠕滑段；锁固段、过渡段和蠕滑段的历史滑坡空间发育密度分别为17.9%、26.5%和20.6%，活动滑坡空间发育密度分别为9.9%、13.2%和15.2%，表明随着断层蠕滑活动性自西北向东南增强，滑坡（尤其是活动滑坡）的空间发育密度总体呈递增趋势；其主要原因为断层活动性差异导致构造破碎程度升高、水力侵蚀增强、滑坡趋于频发，该正反馈机制长期控制着滑坡发育的时空格局。该研究可为类似活动断裂带的滑坡风险评估与防灾减灾提供依据。

papers.title: 粤北地区非滑坡样本选择策略分析与滑坡易发性评价
papers.abstract: 滑坡易发性评价是地质灾害风险评估的关键环节，其结果准确性直接关系区域防灾减灾成效，而非滑坡样本选择是影响评价精度的核心因素。为量化粤北地区非滑坡样本选择策略的效果，收集当地历史滑坡目录数据，选取12个滑坡致灾因子，采用低坡度区域选取法、信息量法、物理模型法和缓冲区法4种非滑坡样本选择策略，结合轻量级梯度提升机（light gradient boosting machine,LightGBM）、支持向量机（support vector machine,SVM）和逻辑回归（logistic regression,LR）3种机器学习模型开展了耦合对比分析，筛选出适合粤北地区的滑坡易发性评价方案。结果表明：(1)非滑坡样本选择策略是影响模型性能的关键因素，信息量法凭借其基于历史统计规律的科学性，能最有效地构建高质量非滑坡样本；(2)LightGBM模型展现出最优的预测能力，是研究中最优的滑坡易发性预测模型；(3)特征重要性分析揭示，降水和土壤类型是粤北地区滑坡的主控因素；(4)基于最优组合（信息量法-LightGBM）的滑坡易发性评价结果显示，滑坡高易发区集中在梅州市全域、韶关市北部和清远市西部。通过多模型验证完成了非滑坡样本选择策略分析与滑坡易发性评价，可为当地防灾减灾提供技术支持。

papers.title: 考虑年平均降雨量空间差异的奉节县滑坡易发性评价
papers.abstract: 滑坡灾害是我国西南山区最为频发的自然灾害之一，其形成机制复杂且受多重因素控制。为提高滑坡易发性预测精度，以重庆市奉节县为研究区，将基于1960—2015年气象站资料构建的年平均降雨量作为影响因子，开展考虑其空间差异的滑坡易发性评价。首先，选取11个滑坡影响因子（高程、坡度、坡向、平面曲率、剖面曲率、地层岩性、年平均降雨量、距河流距离、距道路距离、土地利用类型、归一化植被指数）；然后，剔除冗余因子，引入长短期记忆网络（long short-term memory,LSTM）、循环神经网络（recurrent neural network,RNN）、卷积神经网络（convolutional neural network,CNN）和深度神经网络（deep neural network,DNN）4种典型深度学习模型，构建滑坡易发性评价模型；最后，将上述一级学习器集成为Stacking集成模型，并基于自然断点法生成滑坡易发性分区图。结果表明：Stacking模型在精度和空间识别能力上均优于单一模型，受试者工作特征（receiver operating characteristic,ROC）曲线下面积（area under the curve,AUC）达到0.891，滑坡比率为5.06。研究结果可为融合深度学习与年平均降雨量空间信息的区域滑坡易发性评价提供参考。
papers.citation_text: 蒋宏伟, 吴佳易, 刘梦杰, 李世豪, 周浩, 吴月旭, 李小双. 考虑年平均降雨量空间差异的奉节县滑坡易发性评价[J]. 安全与环境工程, 2026, 33(4): 54-65. DOI: 10.13578/j.cnki.issn.1671-1556.20251112.

papers.title: 融合机器学习和SHAP可解释分析的河南省滑坡灾害易发性评价
papers.abstract: 机器学习模型已广泛应用于区域滑坡灾害易发性评价，但相关研究多聚焦不同模型预测精度的对比，对模型内部机制学习复杂地质环境非线性效应的能力和易发性概率密度分布合理性的系统分析不足。以河南省为研究区，引入多种典型机器学习模型开展滑坡灾害易发性评价，在系统对比其预测性能的基础上，利用沙普利可加性解释（Shapley additive explanations,SHAP）方法定量刻画模型对不同评价因子的非线性响应特征，并通过分析易发性概率密度分布，讨论不同模型输出结果的集中性、离散性及其与区域工程地质背景的对应关系，进而形成对模型结果合理性的全面评价。结果表明：极限梯度提升（extreme gradient boosting,XGBoost）算法与随机森林（random forest,RF）模型具备较高的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（area under the receiver operating characteristic curve,AUC）和平均精确率（average precision,AP），且其SHAP色带分布范围更广，对异常高值特征的敏感性较强；易发性概率密度分布呈指数分布特征，与研究区总体地貌以缓坡、剥蚀丘陵为主的背景相吻合，且能有效圈定高易发单元。该研究为基于机器学习模型的滑坡灾害易发性评价结果的合理性分析提供了新的思路与方法。
papers.citation_text: 周瑞平, 赵胜楠. 融合机器学习和SHAP可解释分析的河南省滑坡灾害易发性评价[J]. 安全与环境工程, 2026, 33(4): 66-77. DOI: 10.13578/j.cnki.issn.1671-1556.20251154.

papers.title: 甘肃积石山M_s6.2地震同震地质灾害风险评价
papers.abstract: 积石山县M_s6.2浅源地震及余震诱发了大量地质灾害，造成了重大人员伤亡和经济损失。为减轻同震地质灾害对人民生命财产安全的威胁，选取高程、坡度、坡向、工程地质岩组、距震中距离、地震动峰值加速度6个评价因子，采用频率比模型衡量各评价因子分级对同震地质灾害的影响程度，并基于加权信息量模型评价了震区同震地质灾害危险性；通过将人员、建筑物和交通设施易损性按权重叠加，建立了同震地质灾害承灾体易损性评价模型，并利用风险等级判断矩阵分析了震区同震地质灾害风险。结果表明：(1)极高危险区和高危险区面积之和占震区总面积的38.38%，主要分布在岩性软弱、坡度较低的低中山河谷地区；受试者工作特征(receiver operating characteristic curve,ROC)曲线下面积(area under the curve,AUC)值为0.87，表明危险性评价精度较高。(2)极高易损区和高易损区面积分别占震区总面积的16.29%和25.34%，区内建筑面积较大。(3)极高风险区和高风险区面积分别占震区总面积的11.65%和27.95%，区内人口较密集；中风险区和低风险区分别占震区总面积的33.37%和27.03%，区内人口相对稀疏。针对不同风险分区提出了相应的防治措施，对地质灾害排查防治工作具有参考意义。

papers.title: 不同降雨工况下粤东北山区龙川县地质灾害风险评价
papers.abstract: 为有效支撑粤东北山区地质灾害“隐患点+风险区”双控管理工作，科学推进受威胁区域避让搬迁与地质灾害综合治理，开展典型山区县不同降雨工况下的地质灾害风险评价研究十分必要。以河源市龙川县为研究区，基于1∶10 000精细化地质灾害调查数据，选取高程、坡度、坡向、工程地质岩组、距构造距离、距河流距离、植被覆盖度、土地利用类型8个评价因子，依托ArcGIS平台，采用信息量法开展了地质灾害易发性评价。在此基础上，进一步考虑24 h累计降雨量100、250 mm和72 h有效降雨量240 mm共3种降雨工况，开展了地质灾害危险性评价，并结合龙川县人口、建筑物、交通设施和经济等承灾体的易损性，讨论了3种降雨工况下该地区的地质灾害风险。结果表明：(1)3种降雨工况下，各风险区的斜坡单元面积均随风险等级升高而降低。(2)24 h累计降雨量100 mm工况下，灾害点数量随风险等级升高而减少，低风险区占主导，其面积占比达75.58%、灾害点数量占比达67.60%;24 h累计降雨量250 mm工况下，中风险区灾害点数量占比最大，达49.13%，且极高与高风险区面积及灾害点数量显著增加；72 h有效降雨量240 mm工况下，中风险区灾害点数量占比同样最大，为50.47%。(3)随着24 h累计降雨量从100 mm增至250 mm，极高和高风险区的面积、灾害点数量及其占比显著增加；72 h有效降雨量240 mm工况下的风险响应强度介于2种24 h累计降雨量工况之间。该研究结果可为粤东北山区典型县域国土空间规划、村镇规划与建设、重大工程选址等工作提供依据。

papers.title: 输电线路塔基地质灾害风险评估进展——基于CiteSpace的文献计量分析
papers.abstract: 输电线路塔基地质灾害严重威胁区域电力安全。为系统揭示输电线路塔基地质灾害风险评估领域的研究现状、热点及演化趋势，以2010年1月1日至2025年5月30日中国知网和Web of Science核心合集收录的78篇相关文献为数据来源，采用文献计量方法并借助CiteSpace软件，分析了发文量趋势、发文机构以及关键词共现、聚类和时间演化特征。结果表明：该领域年度发文量总体呈先增长后趋于稳定的变化特征；研究机构具有一定的区域集聚性，但国内外机构之间的合作仍不充分；研究内容主要集中于滑坡易发性与风险评价、地质灾害监测与识别、风险评估及气象诱因研究等方面；研究方法正由传统的地理信息系统空间叠加和模糊综合评价逐步向多源监测、机器学习及智能混合模型方向发展。现有研究在动态致灾过程、多灾种耦合机制、数据完整性、模型可解释性及工程适用性等方面仍存在不足。未来应加强多源监测数据融合，推动人工智能与传统地学方法的协同应用，构建面向复杂环境的动态化、智能化风险评估体系，为输电线路塔基地质灾害防控提供理论依据和技术支撑。

papers.title: SBAS-InSAR与GNSS技术耦合的青藏高原塘麦村滑坡形变监测分析
papers.abstract: 为提升高海拔复杂地形区滑坡形变识别能力，以青藏高原塘麦村滑坡为例，集成多源监测技术，系统揭示其形变特征及影响因素。基于2020年1月至2024年12月获取的Sentinel-1A影像数据，采用小基线集干涉测量（small baseline subset interferometric synthetic aperture radar,SBAS-InSAR）技术反演地表形变信息，结合全球卫星导航系统（global navigation satellite system,GNSS）监测与无人机（unmanned aerial vehicle,UAV）影像进行交叉验证，并引入气象资料探讨滑坡变形影响机制。结果表明：塘麦村滑坡在雷达视线（line of sight,LOS）方向的年均形变速率范围为-11.67～8.56 mm/a（负值表示沉降），最大累计沉降量达55.61 mm，整体呈持续变形特征；M3与M7监测点形变显著且邻近公路，具有较高失稳风险；SBAS-InSAR与GNSS监测结果一致性良好（r>0.90,RMSE<3 mm）,UAV影像进一步验证了滑坡前缘与后缘的显著变形区。进一步分析表明，在地形地质条件与工程扰动背景下，降雨入渗与气温变化对滑坡变形演化具有一定影响。SBAS-InSAR技术在高海拔强起伏地区表现出良好的适用性，可为青藏高原滑坡监测与风险防控提供技术支撑。
papers.abstract_en: To improve landslide deformation identification in high-altitude areas with complex terrain, this study takes the Tangmai landslide on the Qinghai-Xizang Plateau as a case study and integrates multi-source monitoring techniques to systematically investigate its deformation characteristics and influencing factors. Based on Sentinel-1A image data acquired from January 2020 to December 2024, the small baseline subset interferometric synthetic aperture radar(SBAS-InSAR) technique was applied to retrieve surface deformation information. GNSS monitoring and unmanned aerial vehicle(UAV) imagery were combined for crossvalidation, and meteorological data were introduced to explore the influencing mechanisms of landslide deformation. The results show that the average annual deformation rate in the radar line-of-sight(LOS) direction ranges from-11. 67 to 8. 56 mm/a(negative values indicate subsidence), with a maximum cumulative settlement of 55. 61 mm, indicating a state of continuous deformation. Among the monitoring points, M3 and M7 exhibit pronounced deformation and are located close to the highway, suggesting a relatively high instability risk. The SBAS-InSAR and GNSS monitoring results exhibit good agreement, with correlation coefficients r>0. 90 and RMSE <3 mm. UAV imagery further confirms significant deformation zones at the leading and trailing edges of the landslide. The analysis indicates that under the background of topographic and geological conditions and engineering disturbances, rainfall infiltration and temperature variations have certain influences on the evolution of landslide deformation. The SBAS-InSAR technique demonstrates good applicability in high-altitude areas with strong topographic relief and can provide reliable technical support for landslide monitoring and risk mitigation on the Qinghai-Xizang Plateau.

papers.title: 极近距离煤层开采再生顶板稳定性评价模型构建与应用
papers.abstract: 针对极近距离煤层下行开采时再生顶板稳定性影响下煤层安全高效开采的核心问题，研究再生顶板稳定性评价理论与方法，以保障矿井的安全生产。构建了涵盖再生顶板自身因素、地质环境因素和开采扰动因素3个准则层及岩性组合、压实胶结时间等8个指标的综合评价指标体系。提出了一种层次分析法(Analytic Hierarchy Process, AHP)-熵权组合赋权与逼近理想解排序法(Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution, TOPSIS)相耦合的评价模型，通过组合赋权法均衡主客观权重以科学确定指标影响程度，利用TOPSIS法计算各评价对象的相对接近度，以此量化稳定性。基于ArcGIS平台采用反距离权重(Inverse Distance Weighting, IDW)法实现了再生顶板稳定性的空间可视化表达并提出分区管理对策。以胜利煤矿层间距极小(平均1.45 m)的14、15煤层为工程背景进行应用研究，分析方法的可操作性与科学性。结果表明：(1)岩性组合是影响再生顶板稳定性的主导因素，其权重高达0.543;(2)再生顶板稳定性可划分为4个等级，研究区15煤层再生顶板稳定区(Ⅰ级)和较稳定区(Ⅱ级)占比达80%,整体稳定性较好；不稳定区(Ⅲ级)与极不稳定区(Ⅳ级)主要分布于水文地质条件复杂、有少量断层、岩性组合差且胶结时间短的区域；(3)经相似回采工作面验证，模型评价结果与现场实际吻合度达80%。构建的评价模型与方法能有效实现对极近距离煤层再生顶板稳定性的评价与空间预测，研究结果可为类似条件下煤层安全开采提供理论依据和技术支持。

papers.title: 混合动力机车内燃动力包灭火系统设计与有效性验证
papers.abstract: 内燃动力包是混合动力机车的关键动力总成，一旦起火，若不加以抑制，势必会扩大为严重的安全事故。为有效提高混合动力机车内燃动力包的防火性能，对动力包灭火系统设计方法、探测器选型与布置方法、管路计算与校核方法和灭火性能试验方法进行了研究。系统设计包括系统的设计准则和工作原理。所用探测器分为棒状定温探测器和红外火焰探测器两种，分别介绍了探测器工作原理，通过火灾动力学模拟工具(Fire Dynamics Simulator, FDS)校核定温棒状探测器探测性能，通过视角分析评估红外火焰探测器布置的合理性。对于管路计算与校核，推荐了两种方法：基于流体流动微分方程和Fluent中的流体体积(Volume of Fluid, VOF)模型计算方法。基于流体流动微分方程的计算方法是通过连续性方程计算过程中点状态下末端喷头压力与过程中点压力关系，基于Fluent中的VOF模型计算方法是通过有限元手段计算灭火介质在钢瓶、管路和喷头中的流动瞬态。介绍了动力包灭火系统的灭火性能试验验证方法，重点介绍了火源设置：喷射火和油池火。两种火源关键表征参数分别是喷射流量和油盘面积。试验验证表明，系统火灾报警时间为5 s,明火扑灭时间为9 s。所设计的灭火系统具有良好的火灾探测性能和灭火性能，研究结果对混合动力机车的防火安全设计具有一定参考价值。

papers.title: 甘肃省突发水污染风险分区研究
papers.abstract: 甘肃省是长江、黄河及黑河上游的重要水源涵养区，有效管控其水生态环境风险意义重大。环境风险分区是环境风险管理的基础，也是有效工具。研究在现有网格环境风险场评估方法的基础上，首次引入环境风险控制机制因素，开展甘肃省突发水污染风险分区，结果显示：(1)高风险区占全域0.4%(1 565.6 km~2),较高风险区占0.7%(3 170.4 km~2),中风险区占2.6%(11 032.9 km~2),低风险区占96.3%(409 658.2 km~2);(2)从地市级空间格局来看，高风险区主要分布在兰州市中部及西部、白银市中部、酒泉市中部及东南部、嘉峪关市中部、张掖市中部、天水市中部、陇南市东北部等地；(3)从重点河流沿岸分布来看，高风险区主要分布在黄河干流兰州段、白银段，湟水河兰州段，渭河天水段，疏勒河酒泉段、黑河酒泉段、张掖段，嘉陵江陇南段，泾河平凉段；(4)从各流域与地市叠加风险来看，黄河干流水系兰州段、湟水河水系兰州段、渭河水系天水段、嘉陵江水系天水段及陇南段、黑河水系嘉峪关段及张掖段、石羊河水系金昌段的风险相对较高。研究结果可为甘肃省突发水污染风险防控提供决策支撑。

papers.title: 基于RF特征优选的SSA-SVM的铁路桥涵洪灾风险评价方法研究
papers.abstract: 随着我国西部铁路线路的建设，运营铁路线路的洪灾风险问题也不断突出，急需减小洪灾风险且提高防洪减灾效率。针对河西走廊漫流区铁路桥涵洪灾，研究基于麻雀搜索算法(Sparrow Search Algorithm, SSA)优化支持向量机模型(Support Vector Machine, SVM)以开展洪灾风险评价。首先，针对致灾因子、孕灾环境、承灾体(桥涵),搜集11个山洪影响因素；其次，采用随机森林(Random Forest, RF)算法进行重要度排序，并选出7个主要的影响因素作为模型特征值；再次，运用SSA算法优化SVM模型参数，建立基于麻雀搜索算法优化的支持向量机风险评价模型；最后，选取准确度、精确度、召回率和F_(1-score)共4个指标，将SSA-SVM模型与传统SVM模型、粒子群优化算法(Particle Swarm Optimization, PSO)优化SVM模型、鲸鱼优化算法(Whale Optimization Algorithm, WOA)优化SVM模型进行对比分析。研究结果显示：构建的SSA-SVM洪灾风险评价模型验证集的精确度、F_(1-score)分别为96.67%、96.91%,而且明显优于SVM、PSO-SVM、WOA-SVM模型，不仅能够实现铁路桥涵洪灾风险综合评价效能，还能为类似山洪风险评价提供决策支持。
keywords: 麻雀搜索算法优化支持向量机模型

papers.title: 基于SVR插补高缺失率的地下水水质监测数据插补研究
papers.abstract: 地下水水质监测数据常由多种原因导致缺失，严重影响数据分析与水质评价的准确性。研究以华北某石化区多年季度监测数据为例，针对高锰酸盐指数、pH值、总硬度和锰质量浓度4个关键水质指标具有污染指示意义但存在高缺失率的问题，提出一种基于滑动窗口的支持向量回归(Support Vector Regression, SVR)插补方法。通过分阶段网格搜索与5折交叉验证优化模型超参数，并将插补结果与常规线性插值方法进行对比。结果显示，SVR模型在高锰酸盐指数、pH值和总硬度的插补精度上均优于线性插值，表明其适用于样本量小、缺失率高、连续缺失多的水质时间序列数据；锰质量浓度受检出限影响其插补效果略低于线性插值，未来需单独分析该类缺失问题。研究为地下水监测数据缺失值处理提供了可靠的新方法，具有较强的实际应用价值。

papers.title: 环境中N-(1,3-二甲基丁基)-N′-苯基-对苯二胺及其醌的去除研究进展
papers.abstract: N-(1, 3-二甲基丁基)-N′-苯基-对苯二胺[N-(1, 3-dimethylbutyl)-N′-phenyl-p-phenylenediamine, 6PPD]是橡胶轮胎生产中广泛使用的抗老化剂。随着橡胶产业的快速发展，6PPD及其氧化产物6PPD-醌[N-(1, 3-dimethylbutyl)-N′-phenyl-p-phenylenediamine quinone, 6PPD-Q]在环境中的暴露水平持续升高，已成为备受关注的新型污染物。6PPD和6PPD-Q均具有生物毒性，可通过环境介质、食物链等多种途径威胁生态系统和人类健康。因此，开发高效去除技术已成为环境科学领域的研究热点之一。通过概述6PPD与6PPD-Q的基本毒性情况，系统综述目前主要的去除策略，分析不同方法的处理效果。尽管现有研究已为6PPD和6PPD-Q的污染治理提供了多种可行方案，但在实际应用中仍存在明显局限、二次污染风险以及成本较高等问题。未来的研究可重点关注高效生物降解技术的开发、多技术协同优化体系的构建以及借助大数据深入解析其在环境中的迁移与转化规律，从而推动更经济、绿色、高效的污染治理体系的开发，为生态环境修复与人类健康保障提供理论依据和技术支撑。

papers.title: 数据驱动的机械伤害事故致因机理差异化研究
papers.abstract: 为揭示不同类型机械伤害事故致因机理的差异，基于2003—2023年的340份机械伤害事故报告，采用改进的人因分析与分类系统模型识别人、机、环、管4个维度的34项致因因素，应用Apriori挖掘因素间强关联规则，并构建贝叶斯网络模型进行反向推理与敏感性分析，以明确不同伤害类型的关键致因路径。结果表明：不同伤害类型事故致因机制存在明显差异，事故起数最多的挤压类事故主要受到环境嘈杂、信息传递不到位及违规探入、进入设备内部的影响；操作失误在大部分事故类型中占主导作用。根据关键致因路径结合本质安全理念，制定了现代安全理念下的靶向干预措施，以促进机械相关行业安全绩效。

papers.title: “新质生产力驱动的矿山安全与绿色转型技术”专题序言
papers.abstract: 矿业是国民经济的基础产业,安全与绿色是矿山高质量发展的根基与底线。矿山作为能源与基础原材料供应的核心领域,正面临资源渐趋枯竭和生态环境约束持续趋紧的双重严峻挑战。因此,统筹高水平矿山安全与高质量绿色转型,不仅是打破传统矿业发展瓶颈的必由之路,更是新时代矿业可持续发展的根本保障。在这一历史进程中,以先进科技为支撑的矿山安全与绿色转型技术,在防范化解重大系统性风险、守护生态红线方面发挥着至关重要的作用。

papers.title: Understanding the reliability of railway turnouts using long-term historical data: A mixed-effects modelling approach
papers.abstract: Turnout failures disrupt railway traffic and undermine the punctuality and attractiveness of rail transport. This makes improving their reliability a priority and requires a clear understanding of the relevant influencing factors. Mechanistic studies that currently underpin this understanding have difficulty reflecting real-world operating conditions. Their complexity and computational cost lead to factors being examined individually under simplifying assumptions. This creates a knowledge gap regarding how multiple factors jointly influence turnout reliability under real-world conditions. This study uses 16.5 years of historical data from the Swedish railway network and applies a generalized linear mixed-effects modeling approach to assess the combined effect of turnout physical characteristics, operational factors, and weather on reliability. The results show that physical characteristics dominate and provide empirical evidence that turnout reliability decreases with age and turnout movements. Remarkably, turnout movements are more relevant than the number of trains; curved turnouts are less reliable (except when built with timber sleepers), and the inherent reliability varies among turnouts. Weather is shown to have a mixed influence: cold and snow increase the failure hazard, whereas precipitation decreases it. The results of this study can be used to inform turnout maintenance planning, as well as act as feedback to mechanistic studies.

papers.title: 基于风险演化势能驱动的主动配电网储能预防性调度方法
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为解决高比例分布式新能源接入后主动配电网存在的电压越限、线路过载及储能响应滞后等问题,提出一种基于风险演化势能驱动的储能预防性调度方法。首先,以节点电压偏差、线路负载率和新能源波动为基础构建多维运行风险指标,并引入风险增长率与风险加速度表征风险演化过程,构建以风险加速度为核心表征的二阶动态风险演化势能,用于刻画风险由当前状态向未来恶化趋势的变化特征; 其次,将风险支撑指数与条件风险价值嵌入模型预测控制滚动优化框架,建立兼顾运行经济性与安全裕度的储能调度模型; 最后,基于IEEE 33节点典型工况开展对比分析。研究结果表明:所提方法能够在风险上升初期提前调整储能充放电策略,在中午光伏高峰和傍晚负荷高峰场景下分别将节点最小电压提高至0.995 标幺值(per unit,p.u.)和0.992 p.u.,将最大线路负载率降低至0.79和0.81,并保留更高的储能荷电状态(state of charge,SOC)裕度。该方法能够增强主动配电网对风险演化过程的前瞻性识别能力和预防性调节能力。研究结果可为高比例分布式新能源接入场景下的储能优化调度提供参考。
papers.citation_text: 李征明, 殷艺铜, 孙柏林. 基于风险演化势能驱动的主动配电网储能预防性调度方法[J]. 中国安全生产科学技术, 2026, 22(10): 214-220. DOI: 10.11731/j.issn.1673-193x.2026.10.026.

papers.title: 综合调控策略下城市无人机冲突解脱路径规划
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为解决城市无人机多机飞行冲突问题,提出基于改进型麻雀搜索算法(multi-strategy sparrow search algorithm,MSSA)的多策略融合路径规划模型。采用MSSA为每个无人机规划基准飞行路径,引入最近点距离和最近点时间指标进行风险预测,实时计算任意无人机对的最接近点位置的出现时间和两机距离。基于构建的冲突风险矩阵,可实时给出改航和调速策略。设置2个复杂度的二维场景进行仿真实验,并与MSSA以及其他3种群智能算法+调速进行比较实验,从总任务完成时间、机间最小间距和冲突违规次数3个方面对比,以验证算法有效性。研究结果表明:综合调控策略(MSSA+调速)在场景1中的总任务完成时间、机间最小间距和冲突违规次数分别为87 s、33.49 m和0次; 场景2中的总任务完成时间、机间最小间距和冲突违规次数分别为79 s、36.07 m和0次,在2个场景中综合调控策略在间距保持、任务执行效率以及冲突解脱有效性方面均优于对比算法。研究结果可为城市无人机多机实时飞行冲突判断与解脱路径规划提供参考。

papers.title: 教室内人员在障碍物影响下的疏散研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为研究教室内环境因素及行人身体素质水平对应急疏散的影响,基于元胞自动机模型,对行人数量、跨越能力、障碍物个数、障碍物摆放方式进行模拟。研究结果表明:疏散时间在不同障碍物类型中呈“慢-快-慢”分布; 障碍物下的疏散时间相比于无障碍物下的整体疏散时间增加9.67%～27.9%; 提高人员跨越能力有利于教室疏散; 当障碍物个数大于20,疏散时间会随障碍物通过的难度而增加; 障碍物摆放在教室的左右两侧的疏散效率相比于前后摆放提高3.33%～25.8%。研究结果可为中小学教室疏散通道设计、障碍物布置规范制定及应急演练方案优化提供参考。

papers.title: 基于局部密度自适应的HM-NF耦合疏散模型研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为了克服单一疏散模型在计算效率与行为真实性之间的固有矛盾,解决传统模型切换生硬、适配性差的问题,提出1种元胞自动机与社会力模型耦合的疏散模型。提出基于Voronoi图的各分区人群密度计算方法,避免传统密度计算帧间波动; 构建以局部密度为输入的非线性sigmoid函数,动态分配行人所受元胞自动机(cellular automata,CA)规则与社会力模型(social force model,SFM)力的耦合权重,实现低密度区、高密度区及中密度过渡区的自适应耦合; 研究速度及位置更新机制,实现基于耦合权重的速度矢量合成,保证个体轨迹连续性。研究结果表明:低密度场景下,提出的HM-NF模型疏散效率与CA模型相当,较SFM模型提升了66.1个百分点; 中密度场景下,HM-NF模型疏散效率较CA模型和SFM模型分别提升12.2个百分点和35.3个百分点; 高密度场景下,HM-NF模型疏散效率较CA模型和SFM模型分别提升5.1个百分点和17.8个百分点。研究结果可为大规模人群疏散的精细化仿真提供技术支撑与方案参考。

papers.title: 基于SOR-TPB理论的居民安全韧性社区建设意愿驱动机制研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为有效发挥居民在安全韧性社区建设中的积极性,构建“SOR-TPB”理论框架,采用结构方程模型(structural equation model,SEM)和模糊定性比较分析(fuzzy-set qualitative comparative analysis,fsQCA)方法,探究安全韧性社区建设中居民参与意愿的影响机制。研究结果表明:社区安全环境、社区政策宣传和社区互动质量等外部刺激因素,以及行为态度、知觉行为控制和主观规范等内部驱动因素,均能正向影响居民参与意愿; 风险感知能够显著调节居民行为态度对参与意愿的影响,但对知觉行为控制的调节效应并不明显; 组态分析识别出7条驱动居民高参与意愿的多效协同路径,按照核心条件的差异可归纳为“环境主导驱动型”“政策主导驱动型”“感知主导驱动型”3类。研究结果可为安全韧性社区建设的实践推进与政策优化提供理论参考。

papers.abstract: 为揭示城市轨道交通暴雨灾害链跨层演化机理并辨识关键传导路径,构建本体约束大语言模型与复杂网络相结合的分析框架。基于“物理环境-系统功能-管理响应”3层架构构建城轨暴雨灾害本体,采用本体约束大语言模型与复杂网络相结合的方法,对89个独立灾害事件开展三元组抽取、知识图谱构建和实体归一化,形成包含36个核心机理节点和107条关系标记有向边的核心机理网络,并进一步开展路径识别。研究结果表明:三元组抽取结果人工核验精确率为98.3%; 暴雨是主要上游扰动源,倒灌、积水和设备故障是关键传导节点,暂停服务和乘客滞留是主要后果节点; 主导演化路径集中于“气象扰动-物理侵入与积水-设施或运营后果”主干结构,“倒灌-积水”为关键桥接链段; 9种参数组合下候选路径整体排序的Spearman相关系数为0.832～1.000,核心演化骨架总体稳定。研究结果可为城轨暴雨灾害链机理认识、关键链段识别及分层风险治理提供参考。

papers.title: 地铁车站双向通道行人交互风险识别与分级
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为识别地铁车站双向通道高峰期近距交汇、紧密跟驰和路径绕行等局部受扰行为,提出基于视频轨迹的行人交互风险识别与分级方法。基于监控视频,采用YOLOv8s行人检测模型与ByteTrack多目标跟踪算法提取行人轨迹,并经单应性变换映射至地面坐标系; 从“空间约束-交互状态-行为响应”角度构建速度、同向横向间距、纵向跟随距离、对向最小横向间距和路径偏移度等5项微观指标; 采用四分位距(interquartile range,IQR)识别异常样本,并基于K-means聚类划分3类相对风险等级; 并以上海地铁9号线某站晚高峰数据为例进行实证分析。研究结果表明:高风险样本主要表现为对向空间受限、路径偏移增强和纵向距离压缩,受扰样本占比随风险等级升高而增加。研究结果可为通道运行监测、客流组织优化和风险预警提供参考。
papers.citation_text: 邓捷, 颜声平, 闫冰, 朱锦华. 地铁车站双向通道行人交互风险识别与分级[J]. 中国安全生产科学技术, 2026, 22(10): 163-170. DOI: 10.11731/j.issn.1673-193x.2026.10.020.

papers.title: 驾驶员面部多特征融合疲劳检测研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 针对现有疲劳驾驶检测误报率高、稳定性和鲁棒性较差等问题,提出1种基于贡献度分析的驾驶员面部多特征融合疲劳检测方法。用C++开源工具包Dlib提取面部关键点,经人工修正后,训练YOLO11n-pose实现复杂场景下面部关键点的轻量化检测。再利用检测结果计算眼睛、嘴巴与头部的疲劳特征指标,训练门控循环单元(GRU)捕捉驾驶员疲劳与清醒状态下各指标时序信息的变化。最后采用基于梯度的沙普利加和解释算法(SHAP)分析特征贡献度,量化短时指标,加权得到面部多特征融合指标,计算验证集疲劳状态,并与原状态标签对比,检验SHAP加权融合模型效果。研究结果表明:YOLO11n-pose关键点检测精确率可达99.8%,GRU验证集准确率达99.08%,SHAP加权融合模型疲劳检测准确率达98.15%。研究结果可实现驾驶员面部疲劳状态的精确识别,为车载疲劳检测系统的轻量化、实时化部署提供方法参考。

papers.title: 数据驱动的消防服热防护性能预测及功能设计智能体构建
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 针对消防服热防护性能评估中实验周期长、成本高及难以覆盖复杂工况的不足,构建一种基于多物理场与机器学习的高精度预测模型。基于传统热湿传递数值模型,建立包含15项织物参数、环境参数及皮肤烧伤时间的多维度数据集,构建多元线性回归、随机森林、人工神经网络、卷积神经网络等模型。研究结果表明:CNN模型预测性能最佳,二级与三级烧伤时间的决定系数均达0.99、均方根误差分别为1.13与1.27,在不同烧伤时间下的精度更高; 特征重要性分析显示,空气层厚度、辐射温度、织物厚度对热防护性能影响最为显著,其中空气层厚度存在最优值(3 mm),超过最优值后烧伤时间下降并趋于平稳,且不同织物层厚度与烧伤时间呈强线性正相关; 提出的数据驱动预测方法显著提升复杂热环境下消防服性能评估的精度与效率,并基于该模型构建消防服功能设计智能体。研究结果可为消防服材料选型、结构优化及逆向设计提供技术基础。
papers.citation_text: 张乐仪, 张金凤, 徐梦娴, 郑子奕, 莫宇, 苏云. 数据驱动的消防服热防护性能预测及功能设计智能体构建[J]. 中国安全生产科学技术, 2026, 22(10): 149-156. DOI: 10.11731/j.issn.1673-193x.2026.10.018.

papers.title: 影响吹吸式通风系统捕集效率关键参数的研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为提高平行流吹吸式通风系统对气载污染物的控制效果,采用实验测试与CFD数值模拟相结合的方法,研究吹吸流量比、罩口间距及法兰宽度对捕集效率的影响规律。研究结果表明:吹吸流量比对系统捕集性能影响最为显著,当吹吸流量比K=1.7时系统捕集效率较高,且气流组织较为合理; 罩口间距次之,当罩口间距比d/c=2时流场组织较为稳定且捕集效率较高; 相较于吹吸流量比与罩口间距,法兰宽度L影响较弱,L=0.14 m时可以有效削弱无效气流。研究结果可为平行流吹吸式通风系统的优化设计提供参考。

papers.title: 融合多尺度上下文与轻量化结构的YOLOv8s烟火检测模型
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为提升火焰与烟雾目标在形态分散、尺度变化显著、纹理信息弱及边界模糊等情况下的检测效果,并兼顾实际部署中对模型轻量化与实时性的需求,提出1种改进YOLOv8s的烟火检测模型YOLOv8s-LD(lightweight detection,轻量化检测)。该模型在主干网络高层引入多尺度上下文门控机制,通过融合不同感受野下的上下文信息,并结合残差注意力与空间门控增强模型对烟火扩散区域及整体形态特征的表征能力; 在中低层构建基于Ghost结构的轻量化特征融合模块,通过通道注意力强化关键特征响应并抑制冗余背景信息; 同时,在主干网络部分引入重参数化卷积结构,利用其训练阶段多分支特征学习与推理阶段结构融合的特点,在增强特征表达能力的同时优化模型推理结构。研究结果表明:与原YOLOv8s模型相比,YOLOv8s-LD模型的R由69.9%提升至71.9%,mAP@0.5由76.5%提升至77.8%,计算复杂度降低约16.5%,帧率达到170 fps。研究结果可为资源受限场景下的智能火灾监测提供1种兼具检测性能、轻量化和实时性的参考方法。
papers.citation_text: 张昊煜, 王泉, 施珮. 融合多尺度上下文与轻量化结构的YOLOv8s烟火检测模型[J]. 中国安全生产科学技术, 2026, 22(10): 131-139. DOI: 10.11731/j.issn.1673-193x.2026.10.016.

papers.title: 基于物联网与大数据的高层建筑火灾风险动态评估模型研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为实现高层建筑火灾风险的精准实时评估,采用物联网与大数据融合技术,构建高层建筑火灾风险动态评估分层模型。通过物联网终端精准采集多区域数据,经融合处理后结合静态评分与动态修正完成评估,划分4级风险; 研发搭载B/S架构评估系统,并在4类高层建筑中开展30 d案例应用。研究结果表明:模型准确率88.6%、召回率87.2%、F1分数87.9%,精度指标均超85%; 系统采集延迟68 ms、评估更新周期3.2 min、稳定性99.7%。研究结果可为高层建筑消防安全精准管控、隐患整改及应急决策提供技术参考。
papers.citation_text: 孙爱民, 戴启超. 基于物联网与大数据的高层建筑火灾风险动态评估模型研究[J]. 中国安全生产科学技术, 2026, 22(10): 122-130. DOI: 10.11731/j.issn.1673-193x.2026.10.015.

papers.title: 基于视觉感知的既有建筑改造施工火灾危险距离估计方法
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为解决既有建筑改造施工中动火作业频繁、火灾危险源种类复杂等因素导致火灾危险源识别困难及危险源间空间距离难以准确获取的问题,提出一种基于视觉感知的既有建筑改造施工火灾危险距离估计方法。在识别阶段,构建YOLOv8-OMR模型,实现作业人员、施工器具、火花和可燃物等火灾危险源的准确识别; 在距离估计阶段,基于Depth Pro算法构建火灾危险距离估计模型,通过深度坐标提取、三维空间坐标转换及欧氏距离计算实现目标间的距离估计。研究结果表明:相较于基线模型,YOLOv8n-OMR的精确率P、召回率R和交并比阈值为0.5时的平均精度均值mAP@0.5分别提升7.6,11.3,6.4个百分点; 在切割和焊接作业场景下,危险距离估计模型的1.25阈值精度δ<1.25分别达到0.867 5和0.881 6,具有较高的距离估计精度。研究结果可为既有建筑改造施工火灾风险感知与预警提供技术支撑。

papers.title: 点火位置和附件对储罐油气爆炸发展影响的数值模拟研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为研究点火位置和附件对储罐油气爆炸的影响,采用数值模拟方法对1 000 m3立式拱顶储罐内部油气爆炸进行计算。研究结果表明:密闭环境下,点火位置对超压峰值影响有限,人孔处点火爆炸威力指数最大,较罐顶中心处和输油管道处点火分别增加27.94%和21.85%; 相比密闭环境,存在泄压附件时火焰湍流化更为严重,呼吸阀的存在对爆炸火焰传播以及超压峰值影响有限; 带分支管道下爆炸超压峰值相比密闭环境降低4.01%,爆炸威力指数降低5.51%,泄压过程中流场的急剧不稳定是分支管道下的火焰结构变化及超压振荡的主要原因。研究结果可为储罐弱顶结构及泄压装置结构设计提供量化参考。

papers.title: 典型工业金属粉尘火花输运与探测响应裕量研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为表征典型工业金属粉尘火花在除尘管道内的输运特征,并评估火花探测—熄灭响应裕量,在4种管道风速及3个粒径水平下开展60次高速摄影试验,提取火花发光区域,分析主体活动窗口(10%～90%发光时间分位窗口,q10-q90)、尾部占比、垂向分布宽度,并通过粒子追踪测速(particle tracking velocimetry,PTV)获得火花输运速度。研究结果表明:不同工况下q10-q90中位值为127.0～638.0 ms,PTV中位速度和90%分位速度分别为10.3～43.2 m/s和17.0～55.0 m/s; 固定126 μm粒径时,随管道风速由10 m/s提高至40 m/s,PTV中位速度由12.5 m/s增至43.2 m/s,PTV 90%分位速度由26.2 m/s增至55.0 m/s; PTV高分位速度与主体活动窗口可分别表征火花提前到达的距离需求和持续进入的时间特征。研究结果可为金属粉尘除尘管道火花探测—熄灭系统的响应裕量评估提供参数参考。
papers.citation_text: 苏星雨, 邰建友, 项广帅, 蒋关宇, 钟圣俊. 典型工业金属粉尘火花输运与探测响应裕量研究[J]. 中国安全生产科学技术, 2026, 22(10): 97-104. DOI: 10.11731/j.issn.1673-193x.2026.10.012.

papers.title: 在役公路避险车道改造提升技术与制动效能研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为了有效解决在役公路连续长下坡路段避险车道设施老化、制动性能衰减等突出问题,补齐重载交通下应急安全保障短板,以甘肃省5处连续纵坡、8个避险车道为研究对象,采用现场实测、理论建模与参数分析相结合的研究方法,构建涵盖入口线形、制动床性能等7项指标的适应性综合评价模型,并建立基于滚动阻力与纵坡阻力耦合的制动效能计算模型,提出了包含制动床翻新、纵坡调整、安全设施强化及智能预警系统完善在内的系统性改造提升技术。研究结果表明:基于所建制动效能计算模型,在典型重载货车以60 km/h速度驶入的工况下,改造后较改造前制动减速度由2.75 m/s2提升至4.12 m/s2(提升近50%),制动距离由50.6 m缩短至33.7 m(缩短33.4%),减速拦停效果显著增强; 所提综合评价模型可准确划分优良、合格、不合格3个等级,为改造优先级判定提供量化参考。研究结果可为在役公路避险车道的功能恢复、改造升级设计与安全评价提供理论参考。

papers.title: 高空甲烷排放扩散特性及危险区演化规律研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术

papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为了揭示高空甲烷排气过程中危险区的形成与演化规律,明确风速及排气方向对危险区范围的影响,采用计算流体力学(computational fluid dynamics,CFD)方法,建立箭体—起竖臂—底座简化三维模型,以甲烷体积分数5%作为可燃危险区外边界判据,模拟0,1,3,10 m/s风速下的常规双侧排气工况及3 m/s风速向上排气工况,分析不同风速下危险区演化,并对比常规双侧排气与向上排气的扩散差异。研究结果表明:无风和低风速下,危险区主要集中于排气高度附近; 3 m/s常规双侧排气时,危险区呈现早期水平拉伸、后期逐渐收敛的特征; 10 m/s强风增强混合稀释,使危险区明显缩小。与常规双侧排气相比,向上排气改变了危险区的扩散路径,60 s时危险区最高高度由54.2 m增至62.5 m,横向宽度由8.6 m减至3.4 m,减小了排气高度附近的横向影响范围,但气云向更高区域迁移的影响仍需关注。研究结果可为高空甲烷排气方式优化及安全防护提供参考。

papers.title: 围压作用下砂岩声发射频谱特征及破裂预测模型
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为解决矿山采动环境下围压对岩石破裂信号的掩盖效应及传统指标预警滞后的问题,提升砂岩破裂预测的准确性与时效性,开展不同围压(5～30 MPa)下砂岩的三轴压缩声发射试验,提出考虑“围压-裂纹动力学-频谱响应”的三元耦合模型,并计算广义破裂预测指数Pfail。研究结果表明:砂岩峰值强度随围压增加线性提升; 多尺度耦合函数能有效滤除背景噪声,且Pfail指数在归一化应力0.82～0.85处出现显著的非线性“突跳”,较传统振铃计数预警提前10%～15%的载荷空间; 在信号衰减50%时模型的预警偏差仅为3.6%。研究结果可为高应力环境下岩体工程的动力灾害监控与早期预警提供高精度、低误报的量化判据。

papers.title: 三轴压缩条件下尾砂基聚丙烯纤维增强填筑体力学响应机制研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为揭示尾砂基聚丙烯纤维增强填筑体在侧向约束条件下的力学响应、损伤演化及孔隙结构变化机制,以水泥胶结尾砂和聚丙烯纤维制备填筑体试样,开展0,0.5,1.0,1.5,2.0 MPa围压下的静三轴压缩试验,并结合声发射监测和X射线CT扫描,分析试样强度、裂隙发育阈值、能量演化和受载后孔隙结构特征。研究结果表明:随着围压增大,试样峰值强度由4.70 MPa提高至10.53 MPa,裂隙发育阈值应力和变形能力同步提高,峰值强度和阈值应力与围压呈良好线性关系; 相对损伤阈值总体降低,说明围压扩大裂隙发育至峰值破坏之间的稳定承载区间,使破坏过程由快速失稳向渐进损伤转变; 加载末期耗散能占比均超过82%,裂隙扩展、颗粒摩擦、界面滑移及纤维拔出是主要耗能机制; CT结果显示,较高围压可抑制裂隙张开和贯通,使孔隙趋于细小、分散。研究结果可为尾砂基纤维增强填筑材料在受约束条件下的承载稳定性评价、损伤识别和安全应用提供参考。

papers.title: 物模数模协同的尾矿库排洪系统水力特性研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为解决尾矿库排洪系统水力特性复杂、单一研究方法存在局限的问题,本文采用物理模型与数值模拟协同分析的方法,基于重力相似准则(λL=40)开展库内排水井系统水工模型试验,同时建立库外双排水井—长隧洞系统全三维数值模型,通过泄流量、水流流态、水面线、明满流现象4个维度的交叉验证,分析双井联泄干扰效应、明满流交替特性及空化风险。研究结果表明:库外双井联泄无相互干扰; 库内物模与库外数模均观察到明满流交替现象,临界水头受下游边界条件影响; 库内物模未见空蚀破坏,库外数模计算得到竖井直角连接处空化数σ=0.22<0.3,表明高水头工况下存在空化风险,需采取体型优化措施以满足规范要求。研究结果可为同类工程的方案设计与安全评估提供量化参考。

papers.title: 安全屏障自蚀性的概念辨析、作用机制与健康管理框架
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为识别重大危险源系统中安全屏障长期服役过程的功能弱化及隐患前移治理问题,提出安全屏障自蚀性概念。采用文献梳理、概念辨析、机制归纳和典型场景映射相结合的方法,界定其概念内涵、适用边界和作用机制,并构建屏障健康管理闭环。研究结果表明:安全屏障自蚀性是屏障受硬件退化、人员行为偏离和绩效影响因素支撑弱化等共同作用,导致预期安全功能随时间下降,并使潜在型危害因素外显为事故隐患的过程; 其演化具有隐蔽性、累积性、耦合性和路径依赖等特征,作用机制表现为功能需求与实际状态错配、维护验证不足、资源配置优先级偏移和信息反馈迟滞。基于此,提出由多源证据采集、健康状态表征、动态趋势推断、干预优化决策和验证复盘更新构成的健康管理闭环。研究结果可为重大危险源安全屏障持续有效性管理和隐患前移治理提供参考。
papers.citation_text: 胡瑾秋, 王妍妍, 胡月亭, 肖尚蕊, 马铭骏. 安全屏障自蚀性的概念辨析、作用机制与健康管理框架[J]. 中国安全生产科学技术, 2026, 22(10): 48-56. DOI: 10.11731/j.issn.1673-193x.2026.10.006.

papers.title: 基于复合灾害危险区域的抽采间距优化研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为防止非立体瓦斯抽采条件下采空区瓦斯与火复合灾害的发生并优选瓦斯抽采间距,采用数值模拟的方式,对抽采间距不同的瓦斯与火复合灾害危险区域范围进行研究。首先,通过现场实测,基于氧气体积分数指标对试验工作面采空区进行针对性分析,确定采空区自然发火三带的整体范围。其次,以矿井实际抽采间距50 m条件下采空区氧气体积分数、瓦斯体积分数为依据,分别模拟出无抽采、抽采间距30,70,90 m条件下的采空区三带范围及瓦斯爆炸区域范围。研究结果表明:随着瓦斯抽采支管间距的增大,复合灾害危险区域面积存在最小值12 134.1 m2,抽采支管间距存在最优值50 m,且该复合灾害面积比无抽采时减小48%。研究结果可为低瓦斯矿井瓦斯抽采支管间距优选提供一定的借鉴。

papers.title: 风障布置参数对上隅角低氧气体赋存差异性的影响
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为明确不同风障布置参数对上隅角区域低氧问题的调控效果,以山西某矿510工作面为研究背景,采用数值模拟软件构建工作面气体运移模型,对比开门式、吊拉式2种风障设置模式在不同布置角度下的氧气体积分数分布规律,并通过现场实测数据对模拟结果进行验证。研究结果表明:上隅角区域氧气体积分数呈边界低、中部高,近采空区低、远采空区高的分布特征; 2种风障最优布置角度均为60°,其中“开门式”风障调控效果更优。研究结果可为风障法解决上隅角区域低氧问题提供理论参考。

papers.title: 考虑粒径影响的含瓦斯水合物煤体本构模型研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为研究含瓦斯水合物煤体的力学特性,开展不同粒径((40,60],(60,80]目)、围压(6,7,8 MPa)下含瓦斯水合物煤体常规三轴压缩试验,获得不同工况下其偏应力-应变曲线、峰值强度及弹性模量,并与原有试验数据(粒径(20,40]目、围压6,7,8 MPa)一同对比,分析其力学特性影响规律; 基于试验结果,建立适用于含瓦斯水合物煤体修正的邓肯-张本构模型。研究结果表明:不同围压和粒径下试样偏应力-应变曲线均呈应变硬化型,且含弹性、屈服及强化3个阶段; 随着围压增大,(20,40]目,(40,60]目,(60,80]目3种粒径下的峰值强度增加率分别为43.28%、37.86%、38.15%,弹性模量增加率分别为37.75%、52.70%、58.26%; 修正的邓肯-张模型能较好地描述粒径影响下含瓦斯水合物煤体宏观力学响应。研究结果为瓦斯水合固化煤体的稳定性评估与灾害防控提供可靠的理论工具。

papers.title: 温压耦合对烟煤孔隙结构及瓦斯解吸机制研究
papers.journal_name: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_short: 中国安全生产科学技术
papers.journal_publisher: 中国安全生产科学研究院
papers.abstract: 为探明温压耦合作用下煤体孔隙结构与瓦斯解吸机制的关联,以鱼卡低渗烟煤为研究对象,结合低温氮气吸附、压汞实验、分形理论与Katz-Thompson模型,量化不同温压耦合条件下的孔隙结构与渗透率特征,并开展瓦斯解吸测试。研究结果表明:温压耦合作用下的孔隙响应具有阶段性特征。随着处理温度升高,3组压力下煤样的平均孔径增大,孔容和比表面积占比出现吸附孔衰减、渗流孔增大,总比表面积降低73.5%～87.1%,渗流孔分形维数下降3.3%～4.0%,累积解吸量和初始解吸速度分别增大28.9%～41.0%和37.3%～43.9%,其中2 MPa组煤样总孔容降低10.4%,Kseep提高20.3%,Ktotal降低14.5%,呈现出整体孔容减少、局部渗流输运能力增强的特征; 证明高压压缩并不必然导致多尺度孔隙的输运能力同步下降。研究结果可为解释带压热处理后煤样的孔隙变化与恒温解吸行为提供参考。
papers.abstract_en: In order to explore the relationship between coal pore structure and gas desorption mechanism under the temperature and pressure coupling,this paper takes Yuka low permeability bituminous coal as the research object,and combines low temperature nitrogen adsorption,mercury injection experiment,fractal theory and Katz-Thompson model to quantify the pore structure and permeability characteristics under different temperature and pressure coupling conditions,and carry out gas desorption test.The results show that the pore response under the action of temperature and pressure coupling has stage characteristics.With the increase of treatment temperature,the average pore size of coal samples under three groups of pressures increases,the proportion of pore volume and specific surface area shows the attenuation of adsorption pore and the increase of seepage pore.The total specific surface area decreases by 73.5%～87.1%,the fractal dimension of seepage pore decreases by 3.3%～4.0%,and the cumulative desorption amount and initial desorption rate increased by 28.9%～41.0% and 37.3%～43.9%,respectively.Among them,the total pore volume of coal samples in 2 MPa group decreases by 10.4%,Kseep increases by 20.3%,and Ktotal decreases by 14.5%,showing the characteristics of overall pore volume reduction and local seepage transport capacity enhancement.It is proved that high pressure compression does not necessarily lead to a simultaneous decrease in the transport capacity of multi-scale pores,which can provide a reference for explaining the pore change and constant temperature desorption behavior of coal samples after pressurized heat treatment.

papers.title: Lowering barriers to disaster housing recovery: A collaborative and action-based planning framework
papers.journal_name: International Journal of Disaster Risk Reduction
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Post-disaster housing recovery is a critical yet underdeveloped component of community resilience planning. The lack of a comprehensive plan for long-term housing recovery frequently leads to reactive decision-making after disasters, exacerbating existing vulnerabilities, reinforcing inequities, and delaying a return to normalcy. In the United States, local governments play a central role in connecting survivors to housing solutions, yet their capacity is frequently constrained by limited familiarity with disaster housing programs, fragmented institutional responsibilities, and insufficient planning resources. This paper presents findings from over seven years of action research that informed the development of the Anticipatory Disaster Assessment and Preparedness Toolkit (ADAPT): an interactive, web-based platform designed to strengthen local capacity for disaster-resilient housing recovery planning. ADAPT integrates policy, planning, and community engagement considerations into a structured, participatory process that links post-disaster recovery actions with long-term development and resilience goals. The platform supports risk-informed and equity-aware decision-making without requiring specialized technical expertise, enabling its application across jurisdictions with varying institutional capacities. Drawing on pilot implementations conducted through in-person and virtual workshops with planning teams from four U.S. localities, the paper documents lessons learned from deploying ADAPT in diverse contexts. The findings demonstrate how anticipatory, multi-actor recovery planning frameworks can function as resilience infrastructure, enhancing institutional preparedness, improving coordination across agencies, and embedding adaptive capacity into the disaster risk management cycle.

papers.title: Analysis of Temperature Distribution in Steel-Concrete Composite Beams with Concrete Hollow Core Slabs with Rectangular Openings Under Fire Conditions
papers.abstract: The structural contribution of slab in steel–concrete composite beams depends on the interaction between materials. Despite providing procedures for temperature evolution and strength reduction in composite beams with solid slabs, NBR 14,323 does not include specific recommendations for systems that incorporate hollow-core slabs. Towards addressing that knowledge gap, this manuscript reports on a comprehensive parametric numerical investigation of temperature distribution in steel–concrete composite beams that incorporate hollow-core concrete slabs with rectangular openings. Building upon previous research, the study evaluates rectangular openings, expands the range of concrete densities to six classes (1,750-3,000 kg/m³), and increases the numerical database from 60 to 120 thermal models. The expanded database enables a systematic assessment of the combined influence of opening geometry and concrete density on the thermal response of hollow-core slabs and provides new temperature distribution tables suitable for future code development. According to the results, six tables show the temperature variation along the slab depth for densities ranging from 1,750 to 3,000 kg/m³, indicating hollow-core slabs consistently develop higher temperatures than those prescribed by NBR 14,323 for solid slabs of same density. The results also show opening geometry substantially affects the temperature distribution, with differences of up to 85.8 °C between rectangular and circular openings in function of slab layer and fire exposure time. Therefore, both internal geometry and concrete density should be considered for the development of future structural fire design provisions for hollow-core slab systems. The aforementioned tables provide a preliminary technical basis for assessments of the thermal behavior of hollow-core slabs with rectangular openings and may support future improvements to structural fire design provisions for steel–concrete composite beams.

papers.title: Evaluation of Porosity and Pore Diameter of Gypsum Boards at Elevated Temperatures
papers.abstract: Gypsum boards are widely used as passive fire protection materials due to their ability to delay heat transfer through endothermic dehydration of calcium sulfate dihydrate (CaSO 4 ·2 H 2 O). Understanding the temperature-dependent evolution of porosity and pore size distributions in gypsum board is essential for defining microstructural parameters used in fire-scale thermal transport models. In particular, the evolution of pore structure during dehydration and high-temperature degradation influences heat transfer within the material and therefore affects its fire protection capability. Quantitative data describing how the pore structure evolves at high temperatures remain scarce, limiting the accuracy of multi-physics fire simulations. This work experimentally characterizes the temperature-dependent evolution of porosity and pore size distributions in gypsum board exposed to temperatures up to 1000°C. Samples subjected to controlled thermal treatments were analyzed using mercury intrusion porosimetry, optical microscopy, and large-area optical scanning in order to capture pore structures across multiple length scales. The resulting dataset provides a comprehensive description of pore structure evolution associated with dehydration, fragmentation, and high-temperature sintering processes. The experiments reveal a bimodal pore system consisting of micro-pores (< 10 μm) formed during dehydration and stable meso-/macro-pores (10–100 μm) generated by foaming agents. Total porosity increases with temperature, while the average pore diameter decreases, indicating pore multiplication rather than coalescence. The experimentally measured pore characteristics were incorporated into a microstructure-informed thermal transport model (GPRO: Gypsum PROperties) in order to evaluate the influence of representative pore length scales on the radiative component of heat transfer and to assess their impact on the effective thermal conductivity (k eff ). Model predictions were compared with literature data for the effective thermal conductivity of gypsum board at elevated temperatures to assess the consistency of the derived microstructural parameters with independently measured macroscopic properties. The results show that the evolution of total porosity strongly affects the conductive component of heat transfer, while the radiative conductivity predicted by diffusion-based radiation models is primarily controlled by pore lengths in the meso-scale range identified in the experimental measurements. Sensitivity analysis indicates that variations in representative pore diameter between 1 μm and 100 μm lead to changes in predicted effective thermal conductivity below 3%. Within diffusion-based radiative heat-transfer formulations, this behaviour reflects the dominance of meso-scale pore lengths in the radiative contribution. The temperature-resolved microstructural dataset presented in this work provides experimentally grounded parameters for thermal modelling of gypsum-based fire protection materials and contributes to improved representation of porous insulation behaviour in fire safety engineering simulations. The resulting temperature-resolved microstructural dataset, linking dehydration, microstructural evolution and temperature-dependent porosity, delivers experimentally grounded parameters for thermal modelling of gypsum-based fire protection materials and contributes to improved representation of porous insulation behavior in fire safety engineering simulations.

papers.title: The Relevance of Law and Economics for Fire Safety
papers.abstract: This article investigates how the discipline of Law and Economics (“L&E”) can guide legal frameworks for fire safety by aligning legal rules, economic incentives, and engineering practices. We first introduce core L&E concepts – externalities, information asymmetries, public-goods, and liability structures – and their relevance for fire safety. We then develop a mathematical model for the total cost of fire (for a design problem or building portfolio), and use this model to contrast prescriptive and performance-based regimes and compare three liability standards (strict liability, code-compliance negligence, and due-diligence negligence). When considering a full internalization of the cost of fire (i.e., when the private decision-maker carries all fire-related costs), our analyses show that prescriptive regimes generate over- or under-investment in preventive measures, resulting in sub-optimal societal outcomes. Performance-based regimes, on the other hand, provide private decision makers with the incentive to invest up to societally optimal safety investments. The comparison of liability regimes shows that the internalization of the cost of fire is most effectively achieved by the strict liability regime. A liability regime of negligence based on due diligence (professional standards) also pushes private decision-makers towards adopting societally optimum designs. However, when negligence is established by the (lack of) compliance with prescriptive fire safety codes, this results in societally suboptimal designs. These results imply that policymakers should favor adaptable, efficiency-oriented regulatory designs, and highlight that liability regimes should be calibrated to internalize fire safety related costs. In more general terms, the results demonstrate the power of L&E approaches for supporting discussions on fire safety legislation.

papers.title: Evaluating the Cost-Effectiveness of Interlinked Fire Alarm Systems in Scotland and England
papers.abstract: This paper applies the J value framework to assess when interlinked domestic fire alarm systems would be cost effective in Scotland and England. Pre policy national statistics pool dwellings with no alarms, standalone alarms (the vast majority), and some interlinked systems, so they do not identify the marginal effect of interlinking. We therefore present threshold (break-even) conditions: combinations of reductions in fatalities, injuries, and direct property damage that yield J ≤ 1 for self and professional installation, using historical statistics only as non-causal, illustrative anchors for sensitivity analyses. It was found that, across both countries, damage reduction is the dominant driver of cost-effectiveness, followed by fatality reduction; injury reduction has limited influence (assuming direct injury costs only). One-way thresholds indicate that achieving $$\:J\le\:1$$ typically requires around 30–60% reduction in direct property damage, with fatality thresholds generally around 40–80% depending on installation method and region. Two-factor (damage and fatality) thresholds show trade-offs between these reductions, with more demanding conditions in England due to higher expected damage per fire. Tornado analyses centred on an illustrative base case confirm that installation cost and damage-related inputs exert the greatest influence on $$\:J$$ , while societal discount rates have modest effects. Interlinked systems can be cost effective where installed costs are lower (for example self-installation) and reductions in property damage, and secondarily fatalities, are moderate to large. Improved data on alarm type and performance, property-damage costs, and near-misses would enable movement from threshold analysis to causal evaluation.

papers.title: Analysis of Thermohydraulic Spalling in Blended Cement Concrete
papers.abstract: Recently, the construction industry has increasingly focused on the development of more sustainable transport infrastructure, such as tunnels, driven by the growing use of clinker-reduced cements. One major challenge in this context is fire exposure, which can lead to severe structural damage through concrete spalling, thereby compromising the integrity of the structure. To date, the fire-induced spalling behavior of blended cement concrete remains insufficiently understood. This is particularly concerning, given the increasing adoption of blended cements with reduced clinker content, which are expected to see widespread use in the future. Consequently, a deeper understanding of how different cement types influence spalling susceptibility is of great importance. A comprehensive study was conducted to investigate spalling behavior and analyze the associated thermohydraulic effects in concretes made with CEM I, CEM II/A-LL, CEM III/A, and CEM II/B-Q. The findings revealed that the use of blended cements generally led to increased spalling susceptibility, even in normal-strength concrete. Additional analysis indicated that blended cement concretes exhibited lower permeability and higher moisture content, both of which are likely contributors to the elevated spalling risk. Furthermore, the study showed that moisture transport during heating closely follows the dehydration behavior of the cementitious matrix. Blended cement pastes were found to contain lower quantities of early-dehydrating AFt and AFm phases, as well as more thermally stable C-(A)-S-H phases. Moreover, the incorporation of polypropylene fibers into the concrete mix effectively mitigated spalling across all cement types. Therefore, demonstrating the continued effectiveness of polypropylene fibers as a spalling prevention strategy.

papers.title: Battery Abuse Testing and Thermal Runaway Propagation
papers.abstract: Thermal runaway (TR) propagation is an essential characteristic of larger lithium-ion battery fires. Cell- and module-level battery abuse tests have been conducted using large-format NMC pouch cells. In both test campaigns, heating was used to trigger TR. An electrical heater was used for the cell-level tests, and heat exposure to an external flame was used to trigger a cell-to-cell propagating TR in the modules. Cell surface temperatures were measured during both test campaigns to evaluate thermal runaway properties, including TR onset temperatures, TR max temperatures, and TR heating rates, as a function of local heating rates. The TR propagation characteristics in the modules were analysed based on the module’s temperature distribution and heat release rate. A comparison between the conditions during single-cell and full-module tests was conducted to evaluate their effects on TR and, ultimately, to determine whether cell tests are representative of the conditions during a passive propagation test or a real Lithium-ion battery fire scenario.

papers.title: Fire Dynamics and Surface Oxygen Measurement During Vertical, Buoyancy-Driven Turbulent Fire Spread
papers.abstract: Oxygen availability at a pyrolyzing surface during turbulent flame spread remains poorly understood, and the governing fire dynamics are not yet fundamentally resolved. A series of experiments was conducted using a wall-corner configuration to measure surface oxygen concentrations during flame spread at two distinct locations under a $${300}\,\textrm{kW}$$ hood, using both burner-generated and solid-fuel-generated flame conditions. In burner tests, a propane burner was positioned at the base corner, with mass flow adjusted to achieve steady HRRs. In solid-fuel tests (PMMA, Douglas Fir), ignition was initiated at a $${30}\,\textrm{kW}$$ propane HRR. Gas sampling tubes were flush-mounted to one of the panels at a vertical height of $${100}\,\textrm{cm}$$ above the burner and at lateral distances of $${10}\,\textrm{cm}$$ and $${20}\,\textrm{cm}$$ from the corner to extract combustion gases. A novel technique was introduced to non-intrusively estimate surface oxygen availability using a correlation between the measured oxygen volume fraction and the normalized image intensities. Radiation intensity measurements were used to quantify fire growth rates, which were, on average, 3.5 times greater in the vertical direction than in the horizontal. Flame sheet growth and acceleration were found to directly influence the measured surface oxygen volume fractions. Time-resolved surface oxygen fields were reconstructed for PMMA, providing new insight into oxygen depletion dynamics across distinct pyrolysis regimes during a turbulent fire spread.

papers.title: Developing Empirical and Graphical Indices for Fire-Induced Spalling of Concrete
papers.abstract: Fire-induced spalling remains an ongoing concern for concrete structures exposed to fire conditions as existing predictive methods struggle to achieve reliable predictions. To bridge this knowledge gap, this study proposes a methodology to develop empirically driven indices to predict the spalling phenomenon. The methodology comprises three approaches: systematic data transformations, logistic regression, and a data-informed boundary decision based on machine learning (ML). The obtained indices, evaluated over a comprehensive dataset of over 1,000 fire tests and 200,000 cases, exhibited an accuracy ranging from 71–82%. The proposed indices were then refined per concrete grade and achieved improved performance. These findings highlight the potential for developing empirical indices to arrive at simple and easy to use tools to predict fire-induced spalling of concrete. Such indices could set the stage for new predictive methods that go beyond simple statistical and ML inference approaches in the near future.

papers.title: Finding and Understanding the Limiting Oxygen Concentration for Oxygen Reduction Systems
papers.abstract: Automated storage systems and large-scale freezers can be challenging for conventional fire protection systems. Instead, an oxygen reduction system (ORS) could be a suitable option. In an ORS the design oxygen concentration is the key parameter for the level of protection achieved by the system. However, current methods for determining this concentration yield varying results and either require large and complex test setups or arrive at overly optimistic levels for protection. In this paper, an experimental method for using the controlled atmosphere cone calorimeter (CACC) to find the limiting oxygen concentration at extinction (LOC ext ) is proposed. The results from the CACC showed good agreement with limiting oxygen concentrations (LOC) determined by large-scale; indicating that the CACC could serve as a cost-effective alternative for determining the LOC of ordinary combustibles for ORS applications. Furthermore, thermal analysis and experiments using both nitrogen and carbon dioxide highlights that the thermal properties of the diluent gas, rather than oxygen displacement and chemical quenching, are the primary factors influencing the LOC. Hence, the findings in this paper increase the understanding of ORS systems and offer a way to determine the LOC for ORS based on small-scale testing.

papers.title: The Hidden Variable: How Data Gaps Shape Battery Fire Safety Engineering
papers.abstract: Lithium-ion battery systems are increasingly deployed across vehicles, buildings, and energy infrastructure, raising urgent fire safety challenges that are not yet fully addressed by existing codes and standards. This article presents findings from an international survey of fire safety professionals with experience in battery-related projects, designed to capture current practice, perceived gaps, and methodological limitations. The survey reveals strong reliance on heat release rate as a principal design parameter, yet limited recognition of the uncertainties associated with its measurement. Respondents emphasized the lack of validated, system-level test data, particularly on gas composition (primarily toxicity but also flammability), and concerns related to UL9540A goals, quality and interpretation. Concerns about transparency and unequal access to test data were repeatedly noted, alongside the absence of harmonized regulatory guidance across regions. Taken together, the results provide one of the first systematic insights into how fire safety engineers approach battery fire safety design/strategy in projects involving battery systems in practice and identify areas where research, regulation, and industry practice must converge to enable safe large-scale deployment of battery systems.

papers.title: A Hybrid FEM-Surrogate Enhanced Framework for Thermo-Mechanical Degradation in Concrete Beams Under Hydrocarbon Fire
papers.abstract: Concrete structures exposed to elevated temperatures undergo progressive thermal and mechanical degradation, compromising serviceability and safety. This study examines plain cement concrete (PCC) and reinforced cement concrete (RCC) beams across multiple grades subjected to hydrocarbon fire, integrating finite element modelling (FEM) with calibrated surrogate models. A curated dataset spanning temperature, grade, and beam type supports the training of Gaussian process regression (GPR), support vector regression (SVR), and gradient boosted machines (GBM). Cross validation with standardized residuals provides diagnostic calibration, while external benchmarking against independent FEM simulations ensures physical consistency. Results indicate that the effective thermal conductivity indicator $$k_{\textrm{eff}}$$ , derived from transient thermal field outputs under Eurocode-consistent temperature-dependent conductivity inputs, decreases with temperature in a manner consistent with moisture loss and microstructural evolution in heated concrete, while thermo-mechanical response reveals sharp escalation of displacements beyond $$500^{\circ }\textrm{C}$$ , rapid crack width expansion after $$350^{\circ }\textrm{C}$$ , and concentration of von Mises stresses at beam edges. Across most targets and materials, GPR achieves the strongest overall fidelity and provides calibrated predictive dispersion, while GBM yields the lowest PCC crack-width error and SVR exhibits the largest deviations in strongly nonlinear regimes. Design charts and three-dimensional response surfaces, overlaid with FEM samples, provide practitioner tools for risk-aware screening. The integrated FEM-surrogate framework offers computational efficiency while preserving accuracy, enabling rapid assessment of fire-induced behaviour and aligning with performance-based design strategies for resilient infrastructure.

papers.title: Reaction to Fire of Birch Plywood Bonded with Three Different Adhesive Systems at Multiple Scales
papers.abstract: This study investigates the reaction to fire of 9-layer birch plywood bonded with three industrially relevant adhesive systems: urea formaldehyde (UF), melamine urea formaldehyde (MUF), and phenol formaldehyde (PF). Panels were prepared under standardized conditions and evaluated at multiple scales—ranging from fuel property characterisation and thermogravimetric analysis to bench-scale cone calorimetry and ignition testing in the single flame test (SFT). A self-constructed Mini-SBI test (downscaled single burning item test) was developed to capture intermediate-scale reaction to fire with a focus on the orientation of the surface veneer layer. Results reveal that UF-bonded plywood, particularly with lengthwise-oriented surface veneers, exhibited the most critical fire response, including increased susceptibility to ignition during extended localized flame exposure and fire growth promoted by adhesive-controlled veneer separation. PF-bonded samples showed greater thermal stability and higher char formation. MUF-bonded samples exhibited comparatively favourable ignition behaviour, while smoke-production differences among the adhesive systems were not statistically significant. Differences in thermal degradation and flammability highlight the influence of adhesive chemistry and veneer orientation on the reaction to fire of the material. The Mini-SBI setup differentiated between material variants and demonstrated its potential as a material-efficient intermediate-scale method for comparative fire testing during product development. This work highlights the need for adhesive-specific consideration in fire safety assessments of engineered wood products.

papers.title: Risk‐Oriented Differentiated Governance for Ambiguous Information
papers.abstract: The rapid advancement of generative artificial intelligence has led to an exponential increase in false information, especially ambiguous information. Hampered by resource constraints, conventional governance approaches fall short of enabling efficient and precise risk management. In response, this paper innovatively proposes a risk-oriented tiered governance framework tailored to ambiguous information. Specifically, we quantify epistemic uncertainty via multi-level semantic features, combine it with network propagation features to determine latent influence scores, and construct a risk function capturing their synergy. Critical and acceptable boundaries are introduced to categorize ambiguous information into discrete risk levels, tier-specific governance strategies are devised, and a propagation throttling (limiting each user's successful forwards per ambiguous information) strategy is innovatively proposed for medium-risk information. Finally, we simulate differentiated governance strategies across risk levels of ambiguous information, systematically assess governance effectiveness, and offer a comparative discussion grounded in fairness and ethics. This study offers an operational analytical framework for refined risk governance of ambiguous information, contributes methodological innovations in risk quantification modeling and tiered governance strategies, and provides theoretical support and practical guidance for risk management authorities in designing differentiated measures.

papers.title: The Aftermath of Almost: Communicating Risk Amid Community Narratives of Near Misses
papers.abstract: Unpredictable weather means that serious threats do not always unfold as forecast. Hurricane near misses create an especially challenging communication context: The absence of harm may invite community explanations that make the event feel less threatening, even as future risk persists. This study examines how community narratives and post‐event risk messages shape risk perception, collective efficacy, preparedness intentions, message sharing, and credibility after hurricane near misses. In an online experiment, Florida residents ( N = 405) viewed social media posts about a hurricane that shifted away from a coastal community. The posts varied by explanation type, comparing a symbolic community narrative with a factual account, and by response source, comparing emergency management, peer, and control messages. Results show limits and leverage points for post‐event risk communication: In the primary analysis, neither community narratives nor risk messages significantly shifted perceived risk; however, supplementary analyses accounting for regional residence revealed a small reduction in perceived risk following narrative exposure. Risk messages increased sharing and collective efficacy, and organizational sources were more credible than peer sources. These findings suggest that post‐event risk communication after near misses may not readily recalibrate individual risk perceptions but can shape how risk information circulates and how communities perceive their capacity to respond. The study advances understanding of near misses as ambiguous risk events in which communication matters even when harm does not occur.

papers.title: Hybrid Semi‐Quantitative Risk Assessment for Aging Offshore Platforms: A HAZOP–FMEA–Bow‐Tie Framework With Sensitivity Analysis and KRI‐Based Governance
papers.abstract: Aging offshore installations increasingly operate beyond their original design life, yet conventional periodic risk assessments capture barrier degradation only intermittently. This study presents a barrier‐conditioned semi‐quantitative risk‐assessment workflow that integrates Hazard and Operability Study (HAZOP), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), and bow‐tie barrier analysis. The workflow combines decomposed residual likelihood and consequence scoring with threshold‐stability testing and a Key Risk Indicator (KRI)‐based update rule. Its principal contribution is the governance linkage: an explicit rule set that maps barrier condition and KRI threshold breaches to changes in residual likelihood, residual consequence, and risk band between formal safety‐case reviews. To ensure transparency and reproducibility, the workflow is demonstrated through a fully synthetic scenario representing a life‐extended semi‐submersible installation; all inputs are constructed and explicitly identified throughout as scenario assumptions. Under the illustrative scoring assumptions, a 19‐hazard register spanning seven hazard categories yields two high, nine medium, and eight low residual risks, with blowout/well‐control failure and hydrogen sulfide release remaining the highest residual risks. Per‐perturbation threshold‐stability analysis and distribution‐based Monte Carlo propagation indicate that 16 of the 19 residual risk ratings are sensitive to classification boundaries, suggesting that the reported scores should be interpreted as central estimates subject to uncertainty. The proposed workflow provides a transparent tool for risk screening and governance support, complementing full quantitative risk assessment (QRA) while preserving its essential analytical role.

papers.title: Identification and Governance Strategy of Urban Systemic Risk Induced by Extreme Rain–Snow–Ice Weather in Southern China
papers.abstract: China's rapid urbanization has expanded urban spatial scale and increased the concentration of population, wealth, and infrastructure. Against the background of climate change, urban systemic risk induced by extreme rain–snow–ice weather (USR–RSI) in southern China has repeatedly disrupted critical infrastructure and public services, generating cascading impacts across interconnected urban systems. This study examines the generation and evolution of USR–RSI and develops a corresponding resilience governance strategy. Building on conceptual analysis, complex network theory and system vulnerability theory are integrated to construct the theoretical framework. A causal loop diagram is used to characterize risk diffusion and feedback mechanisms based on the 2008 and 2024 RSI disaster cases. Semi‐structured interviews and documentary materials are further analyzed using a structured data analysis approach to identify sensitivity and adaptive factors associated with node and path vulnerability. On the basis of these findings, a whole‐process resilience governance framework is proposed, covering resilience construction, integration of warning and response, rapid recovery, and long‐term adaptive optimization and transformative reconfiguration. The study provides an empirical and analytical basis for understanding and governing USR–RSI from the perspective of interconnected urban socio‐technical systems.

papers.title: Integrated moving bed membrane bioreactor treating municipal wastewater under stepwise ciprofloxacin exposure: Nutrient removal, biotransformation pathways, and microbial responses
papers.abstract: Antibiotics present in wastewater can alter the structure and function of microbial communities, thereby affecting the efficiency of biological treatment processes. Accordingly, nutrient removal, membrane fouling, EPS characteristics, targeted bacterial responses, and ciprofloxacin (CIP) biotransformation were evaluated in an integrated moving bed membrane bioreactor (IMBMBR) treating synthetic municipal wastewater containing CIP. The results demonstrated that IMBMBR maintained stable organic matter removal under antibiotic stress. Although the removal efficiencies of NH₄⁺-N and PO₄³⁻-P decreased from 99.1% to 77.53% and from 29.53% to 20.80%, respectively, following exposure to 50 µg/L CIP, NH₄⁺-N removal partially recovered at 100 µg/L CIP, suggesting recovery of nitrification activity. However, the concomitant accumulation of NO₃⁻-N suggested that denitrification remained affected, while phosphorus removal remained lower than that observed during the blank phase. Furthermore, CIP altered extracellular polymeric substance (EPS) composition, including an increase in tightly bound EPS proteins. Targeted qPCR analysis showed that the relative abundance of α-Proteobacteria, β-Proteobacteria, and Actinobacteria decreased, whereas Nitrospira increased following CIP exposure. Transformation products consistent with decarboxylation, defluorination, dehydroxylation, oxidation, and piperazine-ring cleavage were detected. Distinct transformation-product profiles were observed between the IMBMBR and regular membrane bioreactor (RMBR) systems. Overall, this study demonstrated that the IMBMBR maintained comparatively stable treatment performance under CIP exposure and exhibited lower membrane fouling than the RMBR, while showing distinct CIP biotransformation behavior.

papers.title: 基于模糊C均值聚类算法的采空区自燃“三带”划分
papers.abstract: 针对采空区煤自燃危险区域边界模糊、传统划分方法难以有效处理不确定性的问题，基于模糊集理论，构建了一套完整的模糊C均值(Fuzzy C-Means, FCM)聚类分析框架，通过引入模糊隶属度机制，构建融合温度、氧气浓度等多维指标的评价体系，建立从模糊相似矩阵到等价矩阵的完整数学推导流程，并借助MATLAB实现算法编程与可视化分析。设计基于λ-截集的动态聚类机制。在聚类优化方面，提出结合F统计量的自适应粒度控制方法，实现对过渡区域边界的最优识别。结果表明，调节聚类参数λ可有效控制分类粒度，近工作面区域测点聚类结果对λ变化敏感，反映其空间差异性较大；远工作面区域测点分类稳定，体现环境均质特征。进一步利用F统计量确定最优λ值，获得的“三带”划分结果：进风侧氧化带范围为72～96 m、回风侧为36～72 m,与现场“灾害综合智能管控平台”基于氧气阈值的划分结果进风侧72～103 m、回风侧36～66 m相比，该方法在进风侧识别出7 m“次氧化区”,在回风侧延伸出6 m“潜伏风险区”,两侧偏差均小于10%,验证了划分结果的可靠性。研究不仅实现了与现场数据的一致性，更通过多指标融合揭示了单一氧气阈值法无法捕捉的风险细节，为采空区煤自燃危险区域识别提供了一种更精细、更可靠的数据驱动划分手段。

papers.title: 基于可解释GA-VR集成学习的爆破质点峰值振动速度预测
papers.abstract: 为提升爆破质点峰值振动速度(Peak Particle Velocity, PPV)的预测精度，提出了一种基于遗传算法(Genetic Algorithm, GA)优化的投票回归(Voting Regressor, VR)集成模型(GA-VR)。基于某露天矿实测数据，采用GA优化梯度提升回归、随机森林回归和决策树回归的超参数，并通过投票机制集成模型；同时利用夏普利加性解释(SHapley Additive exPlanations, SHAP)从全局和局部角度分别解释影响因素预测PPV的机制。结果表明：GA-VR模型在测试数据上R~2为0.948,预测性能优于6种对比模型及5类异质优化算法。通过SHAP分析可知影响因素中测点与爆破位置水平距离占主导因素，其次为最大段药量、测点与最小抵抗线夹角。提出的模型在保障高精度预测的同时提供了具有可解释的预测依据，可用于指导爆破参数的智能优化与安全控制。

papers.title: 碱性环境中烟煤的表观特征变化及氧化动力学研究
papers.abstract: 为实现矿山的安全生产与资源的可持续利用，将煤氧化自燃问题从被动治理转向主动预防，探究煤体在碱性环境中的氧化自燃现象，开展水质监测试验，检测原煤在碱性水溶液浸泡过程中pH值、氧化还原电位(Oxidation Reduction Potential, ORP)、电导率(Electrical Conductivity, EC)、总溶解固体(Total Dissolved Solids, TDS)各参数的变化趋势；通过程序升温试验，检测煤样受不同浓度碱性水溶液浸泡后气体的析出情况，分析煤样的氧化特性；运用分析计算得出表观活化能，探究不同碱性强度对煤氧复合反应所需突破的最低能量壁垒。结果表明：基于水质监测试验发现，碱性水溶液浸煤过程中会对煤体造成侵蚀，且溶液碱性越强侵蚀情况越严重；通过程序升温试验中所计算得到的耗氧速率和CO、CO_2生成速率及放热强度发现，溶液的碱性越强，煤氧复合反应的强度越剧烈，反应所产生的热量也随之增加；根据表观活化能计算结果发现，煤样在碱性越强的溶液浸泡下，煤氧复合反应所需突破的能量壁垒越低，煤的反应活性越强。

papers.title: 十二烷基活性剂对构造煤瓦斯扩散的抑制效应
papers.abstract: 煤层注入活性液不仅能改善煤体的润湿性，还会影响煤中瓦斯放散特性。为了探究十二烷基活性剂对构造煤瓦斯扩散的抑制效应，开展了构造煤外加不同质量分数的十二烷基苯磺酸钠(Sodium Dodecyl Benzene Sulfonate, SDBS)与十二烷基硫酸钠(Sodium Dodecyl Sulfate, SDS)单一及复配活性剂溶液的瓦斯扩散试验，分析了不同活性液对瓦斯扩散量、扩散速率、扩散系数及抑制率的影响规律。结果表明：随着溶液质量分数增大，活性液与煤的接触角呈现“V”形变化，SDBS溶液对煤的润湿效果整体优于SDS溶液；对于单一活性液，质量分数3%的SDBS与SDS瓦斯抑制效果最佳，扩散系数分别为2.059×10~(-6) cm~2/s和2.465×10~(-6) cm~2/s,较干燥煤分别降低62.9%和55.6%,但质量分数5%SDS溶液因疏水反转效应导致瓦斯抑制效果劣化；在复配体系中，SDBS与SDS体积比1∶1时对瓦斯的协同抑制效应显著，润湿煤扩散系数仅为2.241×10~(-6) cm~2/s,抑制率较单一SDS溶液提升10百分点以上；当SDBS与SDS体积比偏离1∶1时，胶束稳定性下降，瓦斯抑制效果减弱。

papers.title: 掘进机外吹吸耦合除尘系统数值分析与试验研究
papers.abstract: 为有效解决掘进工作面粉尘浓度过高问题，提出一种基于空气幕阻隔、喷雾降尘与负压集尘协同作用的吹吸耦合除尘系统。采用数值模拟与试验研究相结合的方法，通过建立掘进巷道与吹吸耦合除尘系统几何模型进行模拟计算，分析系统风流流场、速度切面及雾滴粒子运动轨迹的变化特性；最后通过流场观测试验和控尘试验，验证该系统的风流特性及降尘效率。结果表明，射流速度为30 m/s时，可形成有效的射流风幕，射流出口偏转角度为17°时流场卷吸效果、雾滴包裹裁割部和覆盖掘进壁面效果最优。基于数值模拟参数设置相似试验参数进行试验验证：流场观测试验结果表明，当射流出口偏转角度为17°时，风流卷吸效果最优；降尘试验结果表明，司机位置处的降尘效率最高为93.08%,可有效改善掘进工作面作业环境。

papers.title: 浅埋近距离煤层群工作面低氧致灾多参量影响机制
papers.abstract: 调研晋陕蒙地区30座煤矿，分析了该地区浅埋煤层群地质特征与低氧原因，以陕北矿区柠条塔煤矿为研究背景，建立了基于裂隙尺寸与压力周期变化的“三区”喘吸多元气体体积分数变化模型，揭示了采动多参变量对工作面低氧气体涌出量与采空区氧气体积分数整体趋势变化的影响机制。结果表明，采空区内氧气体积分数下降速度与正压差、漏风裂隙尺寸、漏风系数呈负相关，与负压差绝对值、温度、推进速度、临近采空区漏风量呈正相关，工作面低氧气体涌出流量上升速度与正压差、温度呈负相关，与负压差绝对值、漏风系数、推进速度、临近采空区漏风量呈正相关。研究结果对浅埋煤层群工作面低氧防治具有理论指导意义。

papers.title: 露天矿粉尘扩散机理研究进展及展望
papers.abstract: 为了有效防控露天开采产生粉尘的扩散问题，降低粉尘扩散对作业人员健康与周边生态环境的威胁，有力支撑露天矿山绿色转型，首先，系统梳理了不同生产工序条件下粉尘差异化扩散特性方面的研究进展；然后，总结了露天开放环境中风流、湿度、温度等气象条件对粉尘扩散的作用；最后，基于当前研究的局限性，展望了露天粉尘扩散机理研究的发展趋势。结果表明：现场实测受环境扰动影响显著，实验室试验和数值模拟常因过度简化而难以真实反映实际工况；针对呼吸性粉尘的扩散动力学行为及多因素耦合机制的研究尚待深入。未来应致力于研发大尺度、高精度数值仿真平台，构建多参数协同的粉尘连续监测体系，发展基于人工智能的粉尘质量浓度预测与智能预警方法，探究气象与地形条件对呼吸性粉尘迁移的耦合作用机制。

papers.title: Targeting flood resilience investments through a readiness gaps index: Evidence from Mississippi
papers.journal_name: International Journal of Disaster Risk Reduction
papers.abstract: Flooding is among the most costly and recurrent disasters globally, including in the United States. The Southeastern United States is vulnerable to billion-dollar climate disasters. In Mississippi, high flood exposure coincides with uneven institutional capacity and socioeconomic constraints, yet existing assessments largely emphasize hazard or social vulnerability in isolation while overlooking integrated readiness for resilience planning. Major limitations in resilience metrics include limited stakeholder engagement, transparency, sensitivity testing, validation, and multi-scalar assessment. This study developed a place-based Readiness Gaps Index (RGI) to identify where flood risk intersects with limited capacity for resilience action. A mixed-methods approach integrated 22 socioeconomic resilience indicators with 4 institutional capacity indicators identified through stakeholder consultations. Factor Analysis of Mixed Data (FAMD) derived data-driven indicator weights, which were compared with equal weighting through sensitivity analysis. A spatial overlay of the flood hazard and the readiness gaps index examined the co-occurrence of high risk and low readiness. Results reveal a pronounced spatial concentration of readiness gaps in the Yazoo-Mississippi Delta region, southeast, and parts of central Mississippi, while coastal counties exhibit comparatively stronger capacity despite high hazard exposure. Overall, 36.59% of counties and 37.02% of census tracts in the state were identified as candidates for prioritized intervention based on the co-occurrence of flood risk and elevated readiness gaps. The tract-scale analysis further revealed localized flood-risk hotspots. By integrating institutional dimensions with socioeconomic conditions, this study provides an adaptable analytical framework that can be locally recalibrated for prioritizing investments, targeting capacity-building efforts, and advancing equitable flood resilience planning.

papers.title: Virtual Flood Experience Enhances Preparedness Through Emotional and Neural Engagement
papers.abstract: As climate change intensifies flood risks, strengthening individual preparedness is essential for sustainable societies. This study tested whether first‐person three‐dimensional computer graphics (3DCG) flood videos can complement official flood maps in motivating preparedness. We used these materials as operationalizations of experiential and descriptive information, respectively. In a preregistered web experiment with 1000 participants, those who viewed flood videos showed a small but statistically significant increase in preparedness intentions compared with those who viewed flood maps. Mediation analyses showed that, among the measured psychological variables, only fear had a significant indirect effect, suggesting that stimulus‐evoked fear helped explain this increase. We also conducted a functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) study with 45 participants using a within‐subjects design. Flood videos elicited greater right amygdala activation than flood maps, consistent with fear‐related processing. Together, these findings provide convergent behavioral and neural evidence that first‐person 3DCG flood videos evoke stronger fear‐related responses than flood maps and that subjective fear helps account for their effect on preparedness intentions. The results suggest that visually vivid flood videos may complement map‐based communication by increasing emotional salience and promoting flood‐preparedness intentions.
